Go reconciler: import the aggregator settlement CSV + order export, match order-by-order, flag commission/levy overcharges, and show true per-order and per-dish margin net of commission, packaging and GST/VAT.

Go app: track each invoice's 45-day MSMED clock, auto-compute the accruing statutory interest, fire escalation notices, and assemble a ready-to-file MSME Samadhaan complaint packet.

tools.title: Job-Work ITC-04 Reconciler
tools.problem: Goods come in on job-work challans and must return within 1 year (inputs) / 3 years (capital goods) or become a deemed supply with tax liability, and the quarterly ITC-04 return must reconcile every challan out and in. Shops track this in Excel and lose the clock.
tools.who: GST-registered machining, plating and fabrication job-work shops that receive principals' goods on delivery challan
tools.solution: A register of inbound/outbound job-work challans per principal with the deemed-supply aging clock, part reconciliation, and one-click ITC-04 JSON export in the GST-portal schema.
tools.regulation: CGST Sec 143, Rule 45, ITC-04 quarterly return, Udyam

tools.title: Machining Quote Calculator
tools.problem: Quotes are guessed and usually underpriced: material + machine-time + setup + scrap + margin are never costed consistently, so profitable jobs subsidise loss-making ones.
tools.who: Owner-operators of CNC turning/milling and fabrication shops who quote jobs over WhatsApp from gut feel
tools.solution: A no-login calculator: pick material, size, machine rate/hr, cycle + setup time, qty, scrap % and margin; it returns a per-piece price with a transparent breakdown and a printable PDF quote.
tools.regulation: GST/VAT rate line optional; no filing dependency

tools.title: 43B(h) MSME Delayed-Payment Enforcer
tools.problem: Buyers now legally must pay registered MSMEs within 45 days or lose the income-tax deduction (43B(h)), plus mandatory interest, but shops don't track the clock or use the leverage, so they keep absorbing delays.
tools.who: Udyam-registered micro/small job shops whose large buyers routinely pay in 90-120 days
tools.solution: Track each customer invoice against the 15/45-day MSMED clock, auto-send statutory reminders with accruing interest, and generate a ready-to-file MSME Samadhaan complaint pack when a buyer breaches.
tools.regulation: MSMED Act Sec 15/16, Income Tax Sec 43B(h), MSME Samadhaan, Udyam

tools.title: Textile Unit-Costing Calculator
tools.problem: Small units price by gut, forgetting wastage, job-work and overhead, so they either sell below cost or lose orders by overpricing.
tools.who: Handloom weavers, powerloom units, small garment makers, dye houses.
tools.solution: Enter yarn cost and count, warp/weft consumption, wastage %, job-work (dye/print/embroidery), labour and overhead to get true per-meter/per-piece cost, break-even, margin and suggested price bands.
tools.regulation: GST input costing, Udyam/BMBE for formal invoicing

tools.title: Yarn Inventory by Count, Lot & Shade
tools.problem: Yarn is the biggest cost and a stockout halts every loom, yet units track it as loose kilos with no count/lot/shade granularity, so they over-buy or run dry.
tools.who: Weaving sheds, garment units, dye houses, cooperatives.
tools.solution: Track yarn by count (e.g. 2/60s), colour/dye-lot and supplier; record issue/receipt, compute consumption against production, and alert on reorder points.
tools.regulation: GST HSN on yarn, e-way bill on inward, Udyam

tools.title: FSSAI License Navigator
tools.problem: Food MSMEs don't know whether they need Basic Registration, a State License, or a Central License (driven by turnover, capacity, multi-state and exports), and routinely let licenses lapse, triggering penalties up to lakhs and shutdowns.
tools.who: Street vendors, home kitchens, small manufacturers, kirana-to-FMCG units applying for or renewing an FSSAI licence.
tools.solution: A 60-second decision-tree that takes turnover, activity, capacity, states and export status and outputs the exact licence tier, document checklist, govt fee, and an expiry watchdog that nags before renewal.
tools.regulation: FSSAI (FoSCoS) Schedule 1/2 licensing tiers; renewal rules.

tools.title: Compliant Food Label Studio
tools.problem: Packaged-food MSMEs get labels rejected or fined for missing mandatory declarations: ingredients in descending order, bold allergens, veg/non-veg symbol, FSSAI logo+licence no., net quantity, MRP, date marking and nutrition panel.
tools.who: Spice, snack, pickle and bakery units packing for retail; PH processed-food SMEs needing FDA-compliant labels.
tools.solution: A form-driven generator that produces a print-ready label and lints it: validates descending-order ingredients, allergen bolding, net-qty format and symbol placement, with an FSSAI-2020 / PH-FDA rule toggle.
tools.regulation: FSSAI Labelling & Display 2020, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules; PH FDA AO 2014-0030.

tools.title: Recipe Costing & Plate Pricing
tools.problem: Owners price dishes by gut feel and don't know true plate cost including yield loss and wastage, so food cost silently creeps past 40% and kills margin.
tools.who: Cafes, cloud kitchens, caterers and QSR operators.
tools.solution: Build recipes with purchase price, yield % and wastage to get exact plate cost, a suggested price for a target food-cost %, and instant repricing of every dish when any ingredient price changes.
tools.regulation: Optional GST/VAT rate field; no licensing hook.

tools.title: Aggregator Payout Reconciler
tools.problem: Swiggy/Zomato and GrabFood/Foodpanda deposits are a black box of commission, ads, cancellations and taxes netted out; MSMEs can't tell if they were paid correctly or which orders actually made money.
tools.who: Any restaurant or cloud kitchen living on delivery aggregators.
tools.solution: Import the aggregator settlement CSV plus the order export, reconcile order-by-order, flag commission/levy overcharges, and show true per-order and per-dish margin net of commission, packaging and GST/VAT.
tools.regulation: GST on restaurant supply via e-commerce operator (Sec 9(5)); PH VAT.

tools.title: WhatsApp Catalog & Order Book
tools.problem: Home bakers, pickle/snack makers and tiffin sellers take orders in chaotic WhatsApp threads with missed messages, no running total and lost payment follow-ups.
tools.who: Home-based food entrepreneurs and cottage/BMBE-scale units.
tools.solution: A shareable catalog link that captures structured orders (item, qty, slot, address), drops them into an order book with status, and nudges UPI/GCash payment while sending a bill.
tools.regulation: FSSAI Basic Registration (home/cottage); PH DTI/BMBE, FDA for processed goods.

tools.title: BoliKhata — Voice Credit Ledger
tools.problem: Corner-store owners record who-owes-what in paper notebooks or not at all, and most can't type English fast enough to keep a phone app current.
tools.who: Single-owner kirana (IN) and sari-sari (PH) shopkeepers who extend daily udhaar/pautang to neighbours.
tools.solution: An offline-first app where the owner taps once and says 'Ramu, 200 rupees, cooking oil' in Hindi/Tamil/Tagalog/Cebuano; on-device speech-to-text posts the ledger entry, running balances sync when signal returns.
tools.regulation: DPDP Act (IN) / Data Privacy Act (PH) consent for debtor phone numbers; no financial licence needed (informal credit record only).

tools.title: MarginMate — Landed Cost Calculator
tools.problem: Shopkeepers price by gut and routinely sell near or below true cost once scheme discounts, tax and freight are counted.
tools.who: Every kirana/sari-sari owner setting retail prices off a distributor invoice.
tools.solution: Enter purchase price, scheme/free-goods, GST/VAT and freight; instantly see true landed cost, break-even price and the margin % at any MRP/SRP.
tools.regulation: GST/VAT-inclusive pricing math; MRP (IN) and SRP (PH) ceilings.

tools.title: FPO Pooling & Split-Payment Ledger
tools.problem: When an FPO or coop aggregates members' produce and sells it in bulk, tying each member's contributed quantity and quality to their share of the final payout is a reconciliation nightmare done on paper slips.
tools.who: FPO/coop collection-center operators and their members
tools.solution: A mobile app that records each member's deposit (quantity, grade, moisture) at the collection center, pools lots for sale, then splits net proceeds back by contribution minus shared costs, with a per-member passbook.
tools.regulation: Producer Company norms (IN), CDA/RA 9520 (PH), e-invoice on bulk sale

tools.title: Fleet Document Expiry Vault
tools.problem: Every truck carries RC, insurance, PUC, fitness, national/state permit, road tax and the driver's DL, each expiring on a different date; one lapse means a seized vehicle and a fat fine.
tools.who: Fleet owners and transport managers running 2-50 vehicles.
tools.solution: Per-vehicle document locker with all expiry dates, scanned copies, WhatsApp/SMS reminders at 30/15/3 days, a renewal checklist, and VAHAN/Parivahan/SARATHI deep-links to action the renewal.
tools.regulation: Motor Vehicles Act documents (RC, insurance, PUC, fitness, permit, road tax, DL), VAHAN/Parivahan/SARATHI.

tools.title: Export Price Builder (EXW to DDP)
tools.problem: Exporters set a USD price by gut and discover too late that freight, insurance, bank charges and port fees erased the margin, or they lose deals by padding blindly.
tools.who: Micro and small exporters preparing their first quotations.
tools.solution: Builds price up from ex-works cost through inland haulage, THC, freight, insurance (CIF+10%), bank/LC charges and target margin, then outputs the correct number for each Incoterm (FOB/CFR/CIF/DDP) with a clean shareable breakdown.
tools.regulation: Incoterms 2020; marine-insurance CIF+10% convention.

tools.title: LC Discrepancy Pre-Checker (UCP 600)
tools.problem: Banks reject export documents over tiny UCP 600 discrepancies (name spelling, late shipment, description mismatch, missing endorsement), delaying payment and charging discrepancy fees.
tools.who: SMEs shipping under Letters of Credit without an in-house trade-finance desk.
tools.solution: Enter the LC's key fields and your draft documents; it runs the ~25 classic UCP 600 discrepancy checks (dates, amounts, descriptions, cross-document consistency) and lists exactly what to fix before presentation.
tools.regulation: UCP 600; documentary credits.

tools.title: One-Entry Export Document Set
tools.problem: Re-typing the same order into a proforma, commercial invoice and packing list breeds mismatches in quantities, HS codes and values that stall customs and break LCs.
tools.who: Small exporters producing shipment paperwork by hand in Word/Excel.
tools.solution: Enter the order once; generate a numerically consistent proforma invoice, commercial invoice and packing list (matching HS codes, Incoterm, net/gross weights, marks) as clean PDFs.
tools.regulation: Commercial-invoice/packing-list norms; HS/HSN; Incoterms.

tools.title: 8% Flat vs Graduated-Rates Decision Tool (PH)
tools.problem: Every self-employed Filipino and professional must elect early each year between the 8% flat tax on gross over ₱250k and graduated rates plus percentage tax — and most choose blind.
tools.who: Freelancers, online sellers, professionals and sole proprietors.
tools.solution: Enter expected gross and expenses; it computes total tax both ways, shows the breakeven, and warns when nearing the ₱3M VAT threshold that kills the 8% option.
tools.regulation: NIRC as amended by TRAIN; 8% option; ₱250k exemption; ₱3M VAT threshold.

tools.title: BIR SLSP (.dat) Generator from CSV
tools.problem: VAT taxpayers must submit the Summary List of Sales & Purchases in BIR's exact RELIEF .dat format; hand-building that file is painful and rejection-prone.
tools.who: VAT-registered SMEs and their bookkeepers.
tools.solution: Map a simple sales/purchases CSV to the required fields and emit a validated, BIR-RELIEF-compliant .dat ready to submit.
tools.regulation: VAT SLSP requirement; BIR RELIEF data format.

tools.title: MSME 45-Day Payment Clock (Sec 43B(h))
tools.problem: Under Income Tax Sec 43B(h) (effective FY2024-25) a buyer can only deduct a purchase from a registered micro/small supplier if it is paid within 45 days (15 if no written agreement). MSMEs don't know which invoices give them this statutory leverage, and buyers don't track exposure.
tools.who: Udyam-registered micro/small suppliers and their accountants
tools.solution: Upload the invoice register + Udyam status; the tool runs the 45/15-day clock per invoice, flags invoices about to trip the buyer's deduction, and auto-drafts a buyer-facing nudge citing 43B(h) plus the MSMED Act compound interest (3x bank rate).
tools.regulation: Income Tax 43B(h); MSMED Act 2006 Sec 15/16; Udyam

tools.title: GSTR-2B vs Purchase ITC Reconciler
tools.problem: MSMEs silently lose input tax credit (real cash) when suppliers don't file or file wrong, and mismatches between GSTR-2B and the purchase register go unnoticed until too late.
tools.who: GST-registered MSMEs and their accountants
tools.solution: Upload GSTR-2B JSON + the purchase register; the tool matches invoice-by-invoice, flags missing or mismatched ITC, totals the blocked cash, and drafts supplier follow-ups to recover it.
tools.regulation: GST ITC rules Sec 16; GSTR-2B / GSTR-3B

tools.title: Cheque-Bounce (S.138) Case Clock
tools.problem: A S.138 NI Act dishonour case runs on a rigid deadline cascade (notice within 30 days of the dishonour memo, drawer gets 15 days to pay, complaint filed within 30 days after that); miss one window and the case dies.
tools.who: Solo advocates and small litigation firms with cheque-bounce dockets
tools.solution: Enter the dishonour date; the app auto-computes every downstream deadline, generates the statutory demand notice, and fires WhatsApp/SMS reminders before each window closes.
tools.regulation: NI Act s.138/142, Limitation Act

tools.title: Small Claims & Barangay Demand Kit
tools.problem: Filipino MSMEs chasing unpaid debts must first exhaust barangay (Lupon) conciliation and can file small claims up to P1M without a lawyer, but don't know the forms or the mandatory sequence.
tools.who: MSME owners, collection staff, paralegals
tools.solution: A guided kit producing the demand letter, the barangay complaint, the Certificate to File Action checklist, and the small-claims Statement of Claim with its attachment list.
tools.regulation: Katarungang Pambarangay Law, 2022 Rules on Expedited Procedures/Small Claims

tools.title: Freelancer/VA Tax Co-Pilot (8% vs Graduated)
tools.problem: PH freelancers and VAs must register with BIR, choose the 8% flat vs graduated regime, and file quarterly 1701Q/annual 1701; most get it wrong or don't file.
tools.who: Solo VAs, freelance marketers, home-based BPO workers
tools.solution: A guided tool that picks 8% vs graduated by income, tracks quarterly gross, computes the tax and percentage-tax position, and preps the 1701Q figures.
tools.regulation: NIRC, TRAIN Law, BIR 1701Q/2551Q, EOPT

tools.title: MSME 45-Day Payment Clock & Samadhaan Builder
tools.problem: Buyers must pay registered MSMEs within 45 days or owe compound interest at 3x the bank rate, but MSMEs don't track the clock or know how to file on the Samadhaan portal.
tools.who: Udyam-registered MSME service firms and their accounts teams
tools.solution: Track each invoice's 45-day clock, auto-compute the statutory interest accruing, send escalation notices, and assemble the MSME Samadhaan complaint packet.
tools.regulation: MSMED Act 2006 s.15-16, Udyam, MSME Samadhaan

tools.title: Living-Wage Craft Pricing Calculator
tools.problem: Artisans chronically underprice: they count materials but omit their own labour hours, skill premium, wastage, and overhead, then sell near cost and stay poor.
tools.who: Individual artisans, SHG leaders, and D2C craft founders setting prices.
tools.solution: Enter materials, hours, a chosen fair hourly wage (benchmarked to regional minimum/living wage), wastage, and overhead to get costed retail, wholesale, and export prices with the margin shown.
tools.regulation: Regional minimum-wage schedules (IN state boards / PH DOLE regional wage orders) as the wage floor reference.

tools.title: Schedule H1 Sale Register
tools.problem: Pharmacies are legally required to keep a separate 3-year register of Schedule H1 drug sales (antibiotics, habit-forming drugs) with prescriber and patient details, but most keep messy paper books that fail drug-inspector audits.
tools.who: Retail pharmacy owners and registered pharmacists
tools.solution: Single-binary app that logs each H1 sale (drug, batch, qty, prescriber reg no, patient) in the exact statutory field set, enforces 3-year retention, and prints the inspector-ready bound-register format with search.
tools.regulation: Drugs & Cosmetics Rules, Schedule H1 register

tools.title: Batch & Near-Expiry Guardian
tools.problem: Independent pharmacies lose 2-5% of stock value to expiry because they track quantity but not batch+expiry, and distributors refuse short-dated returns past the window.
tools.who: Independent pharmacy owners
tools.solution: Batch intake (barcode or manual) with expiry dates, a dashboard of items expiring in 30/60/90 days, FEFO picking order, and alerts before the distributor return-window closes.
tools.regulation: FDA-PH retail drug outlet license (PH); D&C storage norms (IN)

tools.title: Verifiable Skill Certificate Issuer + Public Verify
tools.problem: Certificates are plain PDFs anyone can forge, so employers distrust them and institutes get no credit for genuine training.
tools.who: Skilling providers, coaching centres and TVET centres issuing completion or competency certificates.
tools.solution: Issue cryptographically signed certificates (QR plus optional W3C Verifiable Credential) with a free public verify page that confirms authenticity, course and date without contacting the institute.
tools.regulation: DigiLocker/NAD alignment (IN); TESDA certificate integrity (PH).

tools.title: Offline Phone-Camera OMR Scanner & Grader
tools.problem: Weekly paper OMR tests are graded by hand or via per-sheet services and clunky dedicated scanners, so results and analytics lag days.
tools.who: Coaching centres, review centres and schools running bubble-sheet tests.
tools.solution: A phone app that scans standard OMR sheets with the camera, grades against an answer key fully offline, and produces instant rank lists with per-question and per-topic analytics.

tools.title: RAbill — Running-Account Bill Generator
tools.problem: Contractors bill clients progressively but prepare RA bills (previous vs up-to-date quantities, retention, recoveries, tax) by hand, causing disputes and delayed payment.
tools.who: civil contractors, sub-contractors, PMCs
tools.solution: Go app: load BOQ items + cumulative measured quantity, generates an RA bill (previous/present/up-to-date columns), retention %, mobilization-advance recovery, TDS/EWT deduction and net payable as a PDF.
tools.regulation: TDS 194C (IN), EWT 2% (PH BIR), retention / defect-liability norms

tools.title: Senior/PWD Discount Compliance Till
tools.problem: PH law mandates a 20% discount AND VAT exemption for seniors and PWDs computed off the VAT-net base; businesses routinely miscompute it (overcharging customers or losing the tax deduction) and must keep a substantiating logbook for BIR.
tools.who: Restaurants, caterers, homestays, small hotels and tour operators serving walk-in guests.
tools.solution: Enter gross price and headcount; it strips the 12% VAT, applies the 20% discount in the correct sequence, prints a compliant line-itemised receipt, and keeps the mandated digital discount logbook with BIR-ready monthly totals.
tools.regulation: RA 9994 (Senior Citizens), RA 10754 (PWD), BIR VAT rules

tools.title: Geo-Tagged Visit Proof
tools.problem: Service firms face payment disputes and 'the technician never came' complaints with no verifiable proof of the visit or the work done.
tools.who: Field technicians on AMC and warranty visits
tools.solution: Offline-first mobile app where the technician captures geo-tagged, timestamped before/after photos and a customer e-signature on completion, then generates a shareable service-report PDF that syncs when back online.

tools.title: PM Surya Ghar Solar Payback Calculator
tools.problem: Homeowners and small installers cannot quickly turn a bill into a system size, generation estimate, the PM Surya Ghar subsidy slab, and payback, so warm leads go cold.
tools.who: Rooftop solar installers (as a lead magnet) and homeowners
tools.solution: Static calculator: bill to kW size to annual kWh by state irradiance to the PM Surya Ghar subsidy slab (30k per kW up to 3 kW) to net cost and payback, emitting a one-page proposal.
tools.regulation: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, DISCOM net-metering

tools.title: AQL Finished-Garment Inspection Logger
tools.problem: Final inspection uses ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 AQL tables that staff read off dog-eared printouts; they pull the wrong sample size or accept/reject number, and a buyer audit that catches wrong sampling can reject a whole shipment.
tools.who: Garment QC inspectors, buying-house QA and factory final-inspection desks.
tools.solution: Enter lot size, inspection level and AQL (e.g. 2.5 major / 4.0 minor); the app returns the exact sample size and accept/reject numbers, then logs defects by critical/major/minor with photos and renders a pass/fail inspection report the buyer will accept.
tools.regulation: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4; ISO 2859-1 (AQL acceptance sampling)

tools.title: Apparel Export Time & Action (T&A) Critical-Path Calendar
tools.problem: Each export order is a chain of deadlines - fabric in-house, trims in, cutting, sewing, finishing, final inspection, ex-factory, on-board - and one silent slip cascades into an airfreight bill or a cancelled order.
tools.who: Garment export merchandisers and production planners juggling many buyer POs.
tools.solution: From the ship date and PO, auto-build a backward critical-path T&A plan with standard lead times per stage, flag amber/red as stages slip, and show a portfolio view of every order's health so planners chase the one task that actually threatens delivery.

tools.title: Axle-Load & Overload Penalty Calculator
tools.problem: Loading past the registered gross/axle weight triggers steep penalties and mandatory offloading at check-posts and weighbridges (Section 194 in India, anti-overloading charges in the Philippines), yet the person loading rarely knows the remaining safe payload or the fine exposure.
tools.who: Tipper and truck owners, loaders and dispatchers deciding how much to load.
tools.solution: Enter the RC/OR-CR gross and axle ratings, unladen weight and the load, and get the remaining safe payload per axle, the overload tonnage, and the penalty exposure under the right regime (IN Sec 194 per-tonne scale, PH anti-overloading), with a clear load/don't-load verdict before dispatch.
tools.regulation: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 Sec 194 (India); RA 8794 / DPWH anti-overloading (Philippines)

tools.title: Volumetric Weight & Carton-Cube Optimizer
tools.problem: Couriers bill the higher of actual and volumetric weight, so an oversized carton quietly inflates every shipment's cost, and sellers also guess how many units fit a carton and how many cartons fit a pallet.
tools.who: D2C/online sellers, 3PLs and exporters' domestic legs packing parcels for couriers.
tools.solution: Enter item and carton dimensions to get the volumetric weight, the chargeable weight, the best-fit box from your own box library, units-per-carton and cartons-per-pallet, with an alert when a smaller box would cut the chargeable weight and cost.

tools.title: UDIN Register & Attestation Guard
tools.problem: Every certificate, audit report and attestation must carry a UDIN generated within 60 days, and a missing, late or un-revoked UDIN draws ICAI disciplinary action and client-side rejection, yet firms track them on scattered Excel sheets.
tools.who: Practising CA/CS/CMA firms and their article and audit staff
tools.solution: A firm-wide register that logs every signed document, records its UDIN or flags it missing, counts down the 60-day window, maps each UDIN to client/engagement/partner, and keeps a revocation and verification trail for regulator queries.
tools.regulation: ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI UDIN mandate (Unique Document Identification Number; 60-day generation window)

tools.title: SEC Reportorial Autopilot (GIS & AFS)
tools.problem: Every SEC-registered entity owes a General Information Sheet within 30 days of its annual meeting and an AFS on a schedule keyed to its registration number, and missing them compounds penalties into the hundreds of thousands.
tools.who: PH corporations and professional partnerships (law, accounting, consulting firms) and their bookkeepers
tools.solution: A per-entity SEC calendar that computes the AFS window from the registration number, schedules the GIS from the annual-meeting date, pre-fills the GIS, and tracks penalty exposure for late filing.
tools.regulation: Revised Corporation Code (RA 11232); SEC GIS & AFS filing rules

tools.title: Gadget Repair Job-Ticket & Device Intake
tools.problem: Counters take in devices with no record of condition, passcode or quoted price; disputes erupt at pickup ('it was scratched / you lost my data') and unclaimed devices pile up.
tools.who: Mobile-phone, laptop and electronics repair shops
tools.solution: Device intake captures IMEI/serial, reported fault, passcode/pattern and condition photos; produces a signed intake receipt; tracks estimate to approval to parts to ready; and sends a ready-for-pickup SMS/WhatsApp with the warranty-on-repair terms.
tools.regulation: E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022 (responsible disposal)

tools.title: Rider COD Remittance Reconciler (GCash/Maya)
tools.problem: Philippine last-mile is COD-heavy; riders collect a mix of cash and e-wallet payments and shops lose track of who remitted what, so money leaks and end-of-day disputes are constant.
tools.who: Small delivery fleets, hyperlocal couriers and reseller shops in Metro Manila and Cebu.
tools.solution: Rider app: scan parcel, mark delivered with photo + OTP, record whether paid in cash, GCash or Maya, and auto-build an end-of-day remittance sheet; the shop dashboard shows outstanding cash on hand per rider with a shortfall alert.
tools.regulation: BSP e-money / QR Ph; BIR official-receipt reference capture.

tools.title: Dispute-Proof ePOD (OTP + Photo + e-Sign)
tools.problem: Proof of delivery is paper slips that get lost, leading to 'it never arrived' disputes with no timestamp, photo or location.
tools.who: Last-mile couriers, 3PLs and distributors.
tools.solution: Driver captures recipient e-signature, a photo of the delivered goods and an OTP confirmation, stamped with GPS and time; the POD auto-emails to the shipper and lands in a searchable archive.
tools.regulation: BIR delivery receipt (PH), GST delivery note (IN), IT Act e-signature.

tools.title: Digital Consignment Note (Bilty/LR)
tools.problem: GTAs are legally required to issue consignment notes, but many still handwrite carbon-copy bilty books that are illegible, easily lost and disconnected from GST/RCM records.
tools.who: GTAs and small transport booking offices.
tools.solution: Generate numbered digital consignment notes (LR) with consignor/consignee, goods, freight and RCM flag, print or share as PDF, and keep a searchable register.
tools.regulation: GTA consignment note (mandatory under GST), reverse charge.

tools.title: OTA Calendar Sync Guard
tools.problem: Properties listed on Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip and Airbnb double-book because calendars don't talk, and commercial channel managers are priced for larger hotels.
tools.who: Small hotels and homestays on two or more OTAs.
tools.solution: Self-hosted single binary that ingests each OTA's iCal feed, merges them into one master calendar, pushes a unified availability feed back, and alerts on conflicts.

tools.title: Commission-Free Direct Booking Page
tools.problem: Every OTA booking skims commission, but small properties have no simple way to take direct enquiries and deposits.
tools.who: Homestays, small hotels and resorts wanting direct bookings.
tools.solution: A zero-backend brochure page with rooms, rates and policies that fires a structured WhatsApp enquiry (dates, guests, room) and shows a UPI/GCash QR for the deposit.
tools.regulation: UPI (IN), BSP e-money/GCash (PH); DPDP/Data Privacy for enquiry data

tools.title: Factory Electricity Bill Decoder (Max-Demand & Power-Factor Penalty)
tools.problem: Industrial tariffs bill contract demand, recorded maximum demand (with penalty if it exceeds sanctioned load), power-factor incentive/penalty, Time-of-Day slabs and fuel surcharge, all buried in a dense bill. Owners can't tell if they are paying penalties, whether to revise contract demand, or how much a capacitor bank would save.
tools.who: Small and medium factory owners on HT/LT industrial connections who can't read their own electricity bill and quietly overpay on demand and power-factor penalties.
tools.solution: Enter the bill's key figures (sanctioned/contract demand, recorded MD, units by ToD, power factor, rate slabs) and it decodes every line, quantifies MD-exceedance and low-PF penalties in rupees, recommends a revised contract demand, sizes the APFC capacitor bank to reach target PF with payback months, and charts a 12-month MD/PF trend.
tools.regulation: Electricity Act 2003; state DISCOM HT/LT industrial tariff orders (maximum-demand & power-factor clauses)

tools.title: Sheet-Metal Bend Deduction & Flat-Pattern Calculator
tools.problem: Cut the flat blank wrong, ignoring bend allowance/deduction and the K-factor for the material and radius, and every bent part is oversize or undersize: scrap, rework, wasted sheet. Operators guess the blank size or learn by ruining parts.
tools.who: Press-brake operators and sheet-metal fabricators cutting blanks before bending.
tools.solution: Enter material, thickness, bend angle(s), inside radius and the flat dimensions; it computes bend allowance/bend deduction with a material/K-factor table, returns the exact flat-blank length and the bend-line positions / back-gauge settings, and saves a per-part bend sheet; works offline on a phone at the machine.

tools.title: Machine Hour-Rate & Shop-Overhead Costing Calculator
tools.problem: Quotes rest on a made-up 'Rs 300/hour' that ignores real depreciation, power, labour, floor, interest and true utilization, so some jobs are quoted below cost and the shop can't see which work actually makes money. The existing quote calculator needs this rate as an input; most shops guess it.
tools.who: Job-shop owners who quote using a machine rate they have never actually calculated.
tools.solution: Enter each machine's capital cost, life, power draw and local tariff, assigned and indirect labour, floor area and rent, consumables and expected productive hours; it computes a defensible machine-hour rate per machine and a blended shop rate, shows the full currency build-up, and does break-even utilization, giving a rate you feed straight into quoting.

tools.title: EPCG & Advance Authorisation Export-Obligation & EODC Tracker
tools.problem: An EPCG licence carries a 6x-duty-saved export obligation over 6 years (average plus specific EO), and Advance Authorisation ties duty-free inputs to a matching export quantity under SION norms; MSMEs lose track of how much EO is left, miss block-wise deadlines, and face duty plus 15% interest and penalty when they cannot produce an EODC at redemption.
tools.who: Small manufacturer-exporters who imported machinery under EPCG or inputs under Advance Authorisation against an export obligation.
tools.solution: Register each licence with its duty saved, EO value/quantity, blocks and validity; log every export shipping bill against it (with the licence number endorsed), auto-compute average and specific EO fulfilled vs balance, alert before each block and the final date, and assemble the EODC/redemption file (shipping bills, BRCs, installation certificate) for DGFT.
tools.regulation: EPCG Scheme & Advance Authorisation (FTP 2023); Export Obligation; EODC; SION

tools.title: Rule 37 180-Day ITC-Reversal Guard
tools.problem: If you don't pay a supplier within 180 days of their invoice, the ITC you already claimed must be reversed with interest. Buyers forget, get caught in audit, and pay interest and penalty on credits they'd already used, a different law and threshold from the 43B(h) 45-day supplier rule.
tools.who: GST-registered MSMEs that claim ITC on credit purchases
tools.solution: Ingest the purchase register plus payments made; per invoice it runs the 180-day clock from invoice date, nets part-payments, flags invoices nearing day 180 with the ITC at risk and the interest if missed, and either prompts a payment or stages the exact reversal entry (and re-claim once paid).
tools.regulation: CGST Rule 37; Sec 16(2) second proviso (180-day payment condition)

tools.title: NGO/Trust 80G-12A & FCRA Compliance Suite
tools.problem: The post-2021 regime piled on obligations (5-year 12AB/80G re-registration, Form 10BD donation statements with 10BE certificates, FCRA FC-4 returns, CSR-1) and one slip can cost 80G status and donor trust.
tools.who: NGOs, charitable trusts, Section 8 companies and the CAs who serve them
tools.solution: A per-entity suite with the full statutory calendar, a donor register that generates the Form 10BD upload file and issues 10BE certificates, and checklists and reminders for FCRA FC-4 and CSR-1.
tools.regulation: Income-tax Sec 12AB/80G; Form 10BD/10BE; FCRA 2010 (Form FC-4); CSR-1

tools.title: PCPNDT Form F Register & Monthly Filing
tools.problem: Every obstetric scan legally requires a completed Form F with referrer, indication and signed declarations; one missing or inconsistent field can mean the machine is sealed and the sonologist prosecuted. Clinics keep these as loose paper, dread the quarterly inspection, and miss the monthly report to the District Appropriate Authority.
tools.who: Ultrasound clinics, radiology/sonography centers and imaging-equipped OB-GYN practices
tools.solution: A guided Form F for each scan that enforces every statutory field, links the referring doctor and indication list, captures declarations and the sonologist's sign-off, stores records for the mandated retention, and auto-compiles the month's Form F count into the report format the Appropriate Authority expects, with a one-click inspection pack.
tools.regulation: PC-PNDT Act 1994 (Form F, monthly report to Appropriate Authority, record retention)

tools.title: Boat Passenger Manifest & Coast Guard Logger
tools.problem: The Philippine Coast Guard requires a signed passenger manifest before every departure; operators scribble names on paper, can't prove headcount vs authorised capacity or life-vest counts, and lose the records they need after an incident or audit.
tools.who: Island-hopping, ferry, bangka and dive-boat operators carrying tourists.
tools.solution: Offline-first phone/tablet app to build a per-trip manifest (passenger name, age, nationality, address, contact, fare), check boarded count against the vessel's authorised capacity and life-vest count, capture the captain's sign-off, print/share the PCG-format manifest, and keep a searchable trip log with daily and per-vessel summaries, all without a connection at the dock.
tools.regulation: Philippine Coast Guard passenger-manifest requirement; MARINA small-vessel rules

tools.title: Hotel Room GST Rate & Tax-Invoice Helper
tools.problem: Post-2025 rules confuse owners over which room sells at which GST slab, whether to opt into 'specified premises', transaction-value vs declared-tariff, and how to invoice advances, so invoices carry the wrong rate and ITC is lost or disputed.
tools.who: Small and mid hotels, resorts and homestays registered under GST.
tools.solution: Enter room rate, discounts and whether the property is a specified premises; it returns the correct GST rate and tax treatment, generates a SAC-9963 compliant tax invoice (and advance receipt) with the right CGST/SGST split, and keeps a yearly rate-decision log for the auditor.
tools.regulation: GST on hotel accommodation (SAC 9963; 'specified premises' declaration; transaction-value basis)

tools.title: QR Job Traveler & Live WIP Board
tools.problem: Owners spend the day answering 'where is my part?' because work-in-progress is invisible once the route card leaves the office; parts stall between operations unnoticed.
tools.who: Multi-operation job shops where a part hops across cutting, turning, milling, QC and dispatch
tools.solution: Print a QR on the route card/traveler; operators scan at the start/end of each operation; a live board shows every open job, its current operation, and idle time.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Tap-to-Log Downtime & OEE Tracker
tools.problem: Machines sit idle for 'no material', 'tool change', 'no power', 'breakdown', 'no operator' and nobody records it, so OEE and the real bottleneck are unknown.
tools.who: Shops with 3-30 machines whose owners have no idea why output is low
tools.solution: A tablet at each machine (or the operator's phone) where downtime is logged with one tap on a reason code; the app computes OEE = availability x performance x quality and a Pareto of loss reasons.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Shop Machine Preventive-Maintenance Scheduler
tools.problem: Paper PM charts on the wall get ignored, machines fail mid-job, and ISO auditors find no maintenance history.
tools.who: Small factories running lathes, VMCs, compressors and presses on reactive 'fix-when-broken' maintenance
tools.solution: An asset register with PM schedules by calendar or spindle-hours, checklists, due alerts, breakdown logging, and auto-computed MTBF/MTTR per machine.
tools.regulation: ISO 9001 clause 7.1.5 maintenance evidence

tools.title: Gauge Calibration Due-Date Register
tools.problem: Measuring instruments must be calibrated on schedule, but the due dates live in a spreadsheet that never alerts, so auditors catch overdue gauges and reject the quality system.
tools.who: Any ISO 9001 / IATF shop with micrometers, verniers, plug gauges and a CMM
tools.solution: A register of instruments with calibration frequency, due alerts, certificate attachments, and printable calibration-status labels + an ICS reminder export.
tools.regulation: ISO 9001 clause 7.1.5.2, IATF 16949

tools.title: First Article Inspection (FAI) Report Builder
tools.problem: Customers require a ballooned-drawing first-article report; shops hand-build it in Excel, mis-number characteristics, and get the submission bounced.
tools.who: Precision job shops whose OEM/aero/auto customers demand a FAIR with every new part or revision
tools.solution: Balloon the drawing, enter each characteristic's nominal/tolerance and measured value, auto flag pass/fail, and export a clean AS9102-style FAIR PDF.
tools.regulation: AS9102 / IATF customer PPAP dimensional requirements

tools.title: Heat-Number Material Traceability Ledger
tools.problem: Raw material arrives with a heat/lot number and mill test certificate, but the link from heat number to finished part and job breaks the moment it enters a spreadsheet; a recall or audit then can't trace the metal.
tools.who: Shops machining for auto, aerospace, oil-&-gas or defence where every part must trace to a mill cert
tools.solution: Log raw material by heat/lot with the mill cert attached, consume it against jobs, and generate a per-shipment traceability certificate plus retained mill certs.
tools.regulation: Customer PPAP, EN 10204 3.1 mill certificates

tools.title: Udyam Benefit & Tender-Eligibility Checker
tools.problem: Udyam category (micro/small/medium) unlocks dozens of benefits and public-tender concessions, but owners can't map turnover + investment to what they're actually entitled to.
tools.who: MSME factory owners who don't know which schemes, subsidies and tender concessions they qualify for
tools.solution: Enter turnover and plant-&-machinery investment to get the Udyam category, then a filtered list of eligible schemes (ZED, CLCSS, CGTMSE collateral-free loan, TReDS, GeM) and tender price-preference/EMD-exemption rights.
tools.regulation: Udyam classification, Public Procurement Policy for MSEs, ZED, CGTMSE, CLCSS, GeM

tools.title: Bar-Stock & Sheet Nesting Optimizer
tools.problem: Manual cut planning wastes 10-20% of material in offcuts, and material is the single largest job cost.
tools.who: Sawing, laser, waterjet and press shops cutting parts from bar stock and sheet
tools.solution: A 1D bar-cutting and 2D rectangular sheet-nesting solver that lays out the day's parts to minimise scrap and reports material cost per part.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Rejection PPM & Pareto Analyzer
tools.problem: Rejections and rework are noted on scraps of paper, so the shop can't state its PPM to customers or see which defects actually cost the most.
tools.who: Suppliers whose customers demand a rejection-PPM figure they can't currently produce
tools.solution: Log rejections by defect code and quantity, auto-compute PPM to each customer, Pareto the top defects, and estimate cost of poor quality.
tools.regulation: Customer quality agreements, IATF 16949 metrics

tools.title: PPAP/APQP Package Builder
tools.problem: A PPAP submission bundles up to 18 elements (PSW, FMEA, control plan, MSA, dimensional, material certs) across chaotic folders and revisions; incomplete or mis-revisioned packs get rejected and delay payment.
tools.who: Tier-2/3 auto-component suppliers assembling PPAP binders for OEM/Tier-1 customers
tools.solution: A structured builder that holds each PPAP element with revision control, enforces the submission level, and compiles a complete, indexed package per part/customer.
tools.regulation: IATF 16949, AIAG PPAP, customer-specific requirements

tools.title: Drawing Revision Control & Controlled-Copy Register
tools.problem: Making a part to a superseded drawing revision means scrap and a customer penalty, but drawings live in email threads and shared folders with no current-revision enforcement.
tools.who: Job shops making parts to customer drawings that get revised frequently
tools.solution: Upload customer drawings, track revisions, mark old revisions obsolete, log every controlled copy issued to the floor, and bind the active revision to the job.
tools.regulation: ISO 9001 clause 7.5 documented-information control

tools.title: PH Subcontractor Accreditation Doc-Pack & Capability Profile
tools.problem: Small shops lose subcontracts because their accreditation document pack (DTI/SEC registration, BIR 2303, mayor's permit, ISO, capability statement) is incomplete or expired, and they have no professional capability profile.
tools.who: Small Philippine machine/fab shops seeking subcontracts from PEZA exporters and large OEMs
tools.solution: A checklist and document vault for supplier-accreditation requirements with expiry alerts, that also generates a polished one-page capability statement to send to prospective buyers.
tools.regulation: PEZA accreditation, DTI/SEC registration, BIR Form 2303, mayor's/barangay permits

tools.title: SPC Control Chart & Cp/Cpk Calculator
tools.problem: Customers want X-bar/R charts and Cp/Cpk on critical characteristics, but dedicated SPC suites are expensive and overkill for a small shop.
tools.who: Shops asked to hold process capability on key dimensions but priced out of SPC software
tools.solution: Enter subgroup measurements and get live X-bar/R charts, Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk, and out-of-control flags per characteristic, exportable as a report.
tools.regulation: Customer SPC requirements, IATF 16949

tools.title: Handloom Piece-Rate Wage Register
tools.problem: A master weaver pays dozens of home-based weavers per saree/meter, issues yarn and cash advances, and tracks it all in an error-prone diary invisible to welfare schemes.
tools.who: Master weavers, handloom societies, powerloom owners with outworkers.
tools.solution: Register each weaver (with Pehchan/e-Shram ID), issue yarn, record pieces received, compute piece-rate dues net of advances, and print a payment slip.
tools.regulation: e-Shram, Pehchan weaver ID, Handloom Weavers' Welfare, piece-rate/minimum-wage norms

tools.title: GI Textile Authenticity QR Passport
tools.problem: GI-tagged handloom (Banarasi, Kanjeevaram, Pochampally / T'nalak, Inabel) is swamped by powerloom and imported fakes, so genuine weavers can't prove authenticity or command a premium.
tools.who: GI-registered weaver clusters, cooperatives, authorised GI users.
tools.solution: Issue a per-product QR resolving to a provenance page (weaver, cluster, GI registration, loom type, date) that a buyer scans before paying.
tools.regulation: GI Act (IN) / IP Code GI (PH), Handloom Mark, Silk Mark

tools.title: Dye House Recipe & Batch-Lot Manager
tools.problem: Dye recipes and shade cards live in a stained notebook, so when a buyer reorders a shade the dyer can't reproduce it and eats rejects.
tools.who: Small dye houses, hand-dyers, printing units.
tools.solution: Store recipes (dye %, auxiliaries, liquor ratio, temp/time), generate batch cards, log actual vs target, and search by shade for reproducibility.
tools.regulation: OEKO-TEX / ZDHC chemical limits, GST on dyes/auxiliaries

tools.title: Loom Production & Efficiency Tracker
tools.problem: Owners don't know real output per loom or why looms sit idle; the whiteboard shows today's picks but no efficiency or downtime pattern.
tools.who: Powerloom/handloom shed owners and supervisors.
tools.solution: Log per-loom daily picks/meters, weaver, warp beam and downtime reason, then compute loom efficiency, idle causes and output trends.
tools.regulation: Factories Act record-keeping, Udyam

tools.title: Boutique Measurement & Fitting Memory
tools.problem: Tailors and boutiques re-measure repeat customers because slips get lost, and style preferences and past fits aren't remembered, hurting fit and loyalty.
tools.who: Boutique tailors, bespoke dressmakers (modista), alteration shops.
tools.solution: Store each customer's measurements, body notes, style/fit preferences and order history, recalled instantly for the next order or a remote relative's order.
tools.regulation: BIR/GST invoicing on the linked order, DPDP Act (IN) / Data Privacy Act (PH)

tools.title: Reed & Warp Calculator
tools.problem: Setting a loom needs reed count, ends, warp length and yarn-weight math; weavers do it by hand and one slip wastes an entire warp's yarn.
tools.who: Handloom weavers, warpers, weaving masters, textile students.
tools.solution: Enter reed count, fabric width, EPI/PPI, warp length and yarn count to get ends, a denting plan, warp/weft yarn weight and a yarn purchase figure.
tools.regulation: None (pure tool); supports yarn purchase under GST

tools.title: Apparel Export Document Pack Generator
tools.problem: A first export order drowns a small garment unit in paperwork (proforma, commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes), and one wrong field delays the shipment.
tools.who: Small garment exporters, merchandisers, handloom export aspirants.
tools.solution: Enter buyer, style and carton data once to generate consistent proforma, commercial invoice and packing list with HS codes and AEPC/HEPC-friendly fields.
tools.regulation: AEPC/HEPC, HS codes, GST LUT/export, DGFT IEC

tools.title: 4-Point Fabric Inspection Logger
tools.problem: Export buyers demand 4-point fabric inspection, but small units record defects on paper and can't compute points per 100 sq yd or prove AQL pass/fail.
tools.who: Garment exporters, fabric QC staff, buying-house vendors.
tools.solution: Log defects per roll by size and position, auto-compute penalty points per 100 sq yd, grade pass/fail against the buyer's threshold, and export the report.
tools.regulation: Buyer AQL/4-point standard, export QC, OEKO-TEX where specified

tools.title: Fabric Consumption & Marker Calculator
tools.problem: Fabric is 60-70% of garment cost, so mis-estimating consumption or marker efficiency wrecks the quote and the margin.
tools.who: Garment makers, merchandisers, quoting staff.
tools.solution: Compute fabric consumption per garment from marker efficiency and measurements, total fabric for the order, and the cost impact of a 1-2% efficiency change.
tools.regulation: GST costing inputs

tools.title: Cluster Shared-Order Splitter
tools.problem: A cluster lands a bulk order too big for one weaver; splitting it across members and tracking each sub-order happens on chaotic WhatsApp threads.
tools.who: Handloom clusters, cooperatives, OTOP groups, aggregators.
tools.solution: Split a master order across members by capacity and skill, track each sub-order's status and quality, then consolidate for delivery and payout.
tools.regulation: GST on member supplies, cooperative norms, Udyam

tools.title: Lab-Dip Approval Tracker
tools.problem: Buyers send Pantone references and the lab-dip approval cycle drags through email and couriers, with no record of which recipe got approved.
tools.who: Dye houses, mills, merchandisers serving brand buyers.
tools.solution: Log each buyer colour reference, link the trial dye recipe, and track lab-dip submissions with approve/reject status, dates and comments.
tools.regulation: Buyer colour standards, OEKO-TEX/ZDHC, export QC

tools.title: Food Permit & License Renewal Tracker
tools.problem: Food MSMEs juggle many expiring permits (FSSAI, GST, trade licence in IN; Mayor's/sanitary/barangay, BIR, fire, FDA LTO in PH) and miss renewals, incurring penalties and forced closure.
tools.who: Any food MSME holding multiple statutory permits.
tools.solution: A permit register with issue/expiry dates, a document vault, and escalating 60/30/7-day reminders, shipped with IN and PH jurisdiction presets including the PH January renewal rush.
tools.regulation: FSSAI/GST/trade licence; PH Mayor's permit, sanitary permit, fire safety, FDA LTO, BIR.

tools.title: Catering Quote & BEO Builder
tools.problem: Caterers quote events on paper and WhatsApp; headcount-to-menu math, per-plate pricing and the kitchen's prep/staff plan are error-prone and slow, losing bids and margin.
tools.who: Caterers, banquet/event cooks and tiffin units scaling to events.
tools.solution: Enter guests and menu for an itemized quote (per-plate costing with margin), then one click explodes it into a Banquet Event Order: prep sheet, staffing and timeline.
tools.regulation: GST/VAT field; no licensing hook.

tools.title: Nutrition Panel Builder
tools.problem: FSSAI/FDA require a nutrition information panel, but lab testing costs thousands per SKU and takes weeks, blocking small packaged-food launches.
tools.who: Snack, bakery, beverage and ready-to-eat MSMEs needing a nutrition panel for their labels.
tools.solution: Enter a recipe and get per-100g and per-serve values (energy, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, sodium) plus RDA %, computed from a bundled IFCT + PH food-composition + USDA ingredient database.
tools.regulation: FSSAI nutrition labelling; PH FDA nutrition facts.

tools.title: GST Restaurant & Composition Helper
tools.problem: Restaurant GST is uniquely confusing: 5% without input credit vs 18% for AC/room-attached, e-commerce-operator liability, and a 5% composition scheme for eateries under 1.5cr turnover; owners mis-charge and mis-file.
tools.who: Standalone restaurants, dhabas, small eateries and cloud kitchens.
tools.solution: A calculator and explainer that determines the correct GST treatment for the business type, computes monthly liability, flags composition eligibility, and produces a GSTR-ready sales summary.
tools.regulation: GST 5%/18% restaurant rules, Composition Scheme, ECO Sec 9(5).

tools.title: BIR Receipt & SC/PWD Discount Engine
tools.problem: PH F&B must issue BIR-registered receipts and correctly apply the mandatory 20% Senior Citizen / PWD discount with VAT exemption, a specific net-of-VAT-then-discount computation owners get wrong, risking BIR penalties.
tools.who: Cafes, carinderias, restaurants and caterers in the Philippines.
tools.solution: A point-of-bill tool that computes VAT, the SC/PWD 20%+VAT-exempt discount in the legally correct order, service charge, and a BIR-compliant invoice/OR with sequential numbering plus a daily sales book.
tools.regulation: BIR invoicing/EIS, RA 9994 (senior) & RA 10754 (PWD) discount, VAT.

tools.title: FDA-PH Product Registration Dossier
tools.problem: Getting an FDA LTO and a Certificate of Product Registration for a processed food is opaque; fixers charge heavily and SMEs don't know the document pack or the timeline.
tools.who: Philippine packaged/processed-food micro-manufacturers.
tools.solution: A guided dossier assembler with a product-type classifier, the exact document checklist (GMP, label, notarized docs), a fee estimate, and a tracker for the LTO-then-CPR stages with reminders.
tools.regulation: PH FDA LTO and CPR (AO 2014-0029/0030), GMP.

tools.title: Batch Traceability & Mock-Recall Register
tools.problem: Food law requires one-up-one-down traceability, but when a batch is contaminated MSMEs can't trace which supplier lots went in or which customers got output, failing recalls and audits.
tools.who: Packaged-food, dairy, spice, snack and catering units.
tools.solution: Log incoming supplier lots into production batches into outgoing dispatch; one click traces any batch up and down and runs a timed mock-recall drill that produces an auditable report.
tools.regulation: FSSAI Schedule 4 traceability/recall; PH FDA GMP; Codex.

tools.title: FIFO/FEFO Batch & Expiry Inventory
tools.problem: Generic inventory apps ignore expiry, so perishable and packaged-food MSMEs lose stock to spoilage and sell near-expiry goods because nothing tracks batch dates.
tools.who: Cafes, cloud kitchens, packaged-food units and tiffin services.
tools.solution: Track stock by batch with mfg/expiry, enforce FEFO picking order, raise near-expiry alerts, show dead-stock value, and surface a daily 'use first / mark down now' action list.
tools.regulation: FSSAI/FDA shelf-life and date-marking.

tools.title: Par-Level Reorder & Supplier Order Pad
tools.problem: Kitchens run out mid-service or over-buy, and ordering is a nightly WhatsApp scramble across several vendors with no record of what or at what price.
tools.who: Cafes, restaurants, cloud kitchens and caterers.
tools.solution: Set par levels and the app generates today's purchase list grouped by supplier, sends each order via WhatsApp/SMS, and logs it to build price history.
tools.regulation: No direct hook; UPI/e-wallet payment optional.

tools.title: Per-Brand Cloud-Kitchen P&L
tools.problem: Cloud kitchens can't tell which virtual brands make money because rent, labour and shared prep aren't allocated per brand, hiding a loss-maker inside a profitable kitchen.
tools.who: Cloud kitchen operators running two or more virtual brands.
tools.solution: Allocate shared costs by configurable drivers (order share, prep time) over per-brand revenue net of aggregator commission, giving a monthly per-brand contribution and a keep/kill view.
tools.regulation: No direct hook.

tools.title: Tiffin & Meal-Subscription Manager
tools.problem: Subscription meal sellers drown in pause/skip/extend requests, pro-rata billing and daily who-gets-what-where logistics, all handled in a notebook.
tools.who: Tiffin services, meal-prep kitchens and office-lunch caterers.
tools.solution: Manage plans, pauses/skips with cut-off logic, auto pro-rata invoices, and a daily per-route delivery roster, with customer self-serve pause via link.
tools.regulation: FSSAI; GST/UPI (IN); BIR/e-wallet (PH).

tools.title: Commission-Free Dine-In QR Ordering
tools.problem: Aggregator commissions of 18-30% crush margins even for dine-in and pickup that never needed a middleman, yet small cafes have no own-channel ordering.
tools.who: Cafes, QSR, dessert/juice bars and food courts.
tools.solution: Table or stall QR opens a mobile menu with allergen/veg filters, sends the order to the kitchen, and collects payment via UPI/QR Ph with no per-order commission.
tools.regulation: UPI (IN); QR Ph / BSP (PH).

tools.title: Daily Cash-Up & Z-Report Book
tools.problem: At day-end owners can't reconcile the cash drawer against UPI/card/aggregator sales, so shortages and skimming go unnoticed and books don't tie to GST/BIR filings.
tools.who: Cafes, restaurants, bars and QSR.
tools.solution: A guided end-of-day close: expected vs counted cash, tender-wise sales, a variance log, and a daily Z-report that rolls up into a GST/BIR-ready monthly sales book.
tools.regulation: GST sales records (IN); BIR books of accounts / daily sales book (PH).

tools.title: Process-Food Batch Yield Ledger
tools.problem: Masala, pickle and snack units don't know real cost per kg because roasting/frying moisture loss and grinding wastage change yield, so pricing and margins are guesses.
tools.who: Spice/masala, pickle, namkeen/snack and roastery micro-units.
tools.solution: Log each production batch (inputs, process losses, output weight) to compute true yield %, cost per finished kg, and batch-to-batch consistency, with the batch code feeding traceability.
tools.regulation: FSSAI mfg licence; PH FDA LTO; batch coding.

tools.title: Menu Engineering Matrix
tools.problem: Owners don't know which dishes to promote, reprice or cut because the menu is designed by taste, not by margin times popularity.
tools.who: Cafes, restaurants and cloud kitchens.
tools.solution: Feed item sales and plate cost to classify each dish as Star, Plowhorse, Puzzle or Dog, with specific actions (promote, reprice, reposition, drop) and a menu-placement suggestion.
tools.regulation: No direct hook.

tools.title: Baki Reminder Autopilot
tools.problem: Chasing small dues is awkward and time-consuming, so owners let baki/utang pile up rather than nag neighbours.
tools.who: Shopkeepers with 20-150 credit customers who dread face-to-face collection.
tools.solution: A single-binary service that schedules polite vernacular WhatsApp/SMS nudges at set intervals, each carrying a UPI / GCash / QR Ph pay link so the customer settles in two taps.
tools.regulation: TRAI DLT template registration for SMS (IN); WhatsApp BSP template approval; UPI/QR Ph payment-link standards.

tools.title: Khatam — Reorder Predictor
tools.problem: Shops run out of fast movers between distributor visits and overstock slow ones, because reorder is from memory.
tools.who: Owners who track 50-300 core SKUs and buy on a weekly FMCG beat or distributor run.
tools.solution: From the daily sales/ledger log it computes days-of-cover per SKU and prints a 'buy before next beat' list sized to lead time, not a fancy forecast.
tools.regulation: None material (internal operations tool).

tools.title: Load Margin Tracker
tools.problem: Selling mobile e-load/prepaid recharge is a top sari-sari earner but the thin per-denomination commission is invisible, so owners don't know if it pays.
tools.who: Sari-sari owners reselling GCash/telco load (PH) and IN retailers doing prepaid recharge/DTH top-ups.
tools.solution: Log each load sale by telco and denomination; the app tracks commission %, the load-wallet float balance and daily/weekly profit from load alone.
tools.regulation: BSP e-money / cash-in-cash-out agent rules (PH); telco retailer commission terms; UPI/wallet KYC for agents (IN).

tools.title: Din-Close — Daily Cash Tally
tools.problem: At day's end owners can't reconcile cash drawer against sales, digital payments, credit given and expenses, so leakage goes unnoticed.
tools.who: Owners and the family member who 'closes the shop' each night.
tools.solution: A one-screen flow: opening cash + cash sales + UPI/GCash − purchases − expenses − credit extended = expected closing; count the drawer and see the gap.
tools.regulation: None material; separates personal vs shop cash for cleaner tax posture (BIR/GST).

tools.title: BeatBook — Route & Secondary Sales
tools.problem: FMCG beat salesmen work off paper beat-books and WhatsApp, so distributors are blind to route coverage and secondary sales.
tools.who: Small FMCG distributors/super-stockists and their 2-20 field salesmen.
tools.solution: A salesman app with the ordered day's route, per-store order form, in-store stock check and productivity metrics (calls, productive calls, lines sold) rolled up for the owner.
tools.regulation: None material; feeds GST sales records and secondary-sales reporting to principals.

tools.title: Scheme Settle — Trade Claim Tracker
tools.problem: Distributors lose large sums in unclaimed or short-settled FMCG trade schemes because accruals are tracked in a chaotic Excel.
tools.who: FMCG sub-distributors and super-stockists running dozens of concurrent company schemes.
tools.solution: Model each scheme (slabs, buy-X-get-Y, QPS/payout), auto-accrue the claim as sales post, then reconcile against the credit notes the company actually settles.
tools.regulation: GST treatment of trade discounts/credit notes; principal scheme circulars as the source of truth.

tools.title: OrderList — Stockist Catalog-to-PO
tools.problem: Retailers order from super-stockists via messy WhatsApp text that staff re-key by hand, causing errors and disputes.
tools.who: Super-stockists/wholesalers serving dozens of retailer accounts, and the retailers who order from them.
tools.solution: The stockist publishes a live price-and-stock catalog link; retailers tap quantities to build an order that lands as a structured, priced purchase order.
tools.regulation: WhatsApp BSP for order confirmations; GST/VAT-ready line items on the PO.

tools.title: CMP-08 Composition Filer
tools.problem: GST composition dealers overpay CAs for trivial quarterly CMP-08 and annual GSTR-4 filings that need little more than a sales total.
tools.who: Composition-scheme kirana and small retailers under the ₹1.5cr turnover cap.
tools.solution: Enter the quarter's turnover; the tool computes the composition tax, preps CMP-08 and annual GSTR-4 payloads, and warns as turnover nears the cap.
tools.regulation: GST composition scheme, CMP-08 (quarterly), GSTR-4 (annual), ₹1.5cr turnover cap, 1%/5% category rates.

tools.title: Threshold Watch — GST Readiness
tools.problem: Growing retailers blunder across GST registration, composition, e-invoice and e-way-bill thresholds without realising their compliance just changed.
tools.who: Kirana and small distributors whose turnover is climbing toward a regime change.
tools.solution: Log rolling turnover; the service tracks it against the ₹40L/₹20L registration, ₹1.5cr composition, ₹5cr e-invoice (IRN) and e-way-bill limits and warns before each line is crossed.
tools.regulation: GST registration thresholds, composition cap, e-invoice IRN ₹5cr threshold, e-way-bill ₹50k consignment rule.

tools.title: PayMatch — UPI / QR Ph Reconciliation
tools.problem: Digital payments mix shop and personal money, and owners can't tell which transactions actually settled versus failed or were disputed.
tools.who: Shops taking UPI (IN) or GCash/Maya/QR Ph (PH) alongside cash.
tools.solution: Import the UPI/wallet statement; the tool matches payments to the day's sales, flags failed/pending/duplicate settlements and separates personal from shop inflows.
tools.regulation: UPI/NPCI settlement, BSP e-money and QR Ph standard, merchant vs personal account rules.

tools.title: ScanCat — Barcode to Price List
tools.problem: Building a digital price list by hand is so tedious that shops never digitise their catalog at all.
tools.who: Owners who want a digital catalog for ordering, ONDC, or a storefront but have hundreds of SKUs.
tools.solution: Scan EAN/UPC barcodes; the app auto-fills product name and pack from a barcode dictionary, you set your price, and it exports a clean catalog/price list in minutes.
tools.regulation: Legal Metrology net-qty/MRP fields (IN), DTI price-tag fields (PH) captured for compliant catalogs.

tools.title: Mandi Deduction Transparency Calculator
tools.problem: At sale, farmers face a stack of deductions, commission, hamali, weighing, market fee, moisture and dockage, and rarely verify the net they are actually paid.
tools.who: Farmers selling at APMC mandis
tools.solution: Enter gross rate, quantity and each deduction to get the correct net payable, with a shareable itemized breakdown slip.
tools.regulation: APMC market-fee and commission norms

tools.title: Spray Diary & MRL Compliance Log
tools.problem: Export and premium buyers require a spray diary proving each application's product, date, dose and pre-harvest interval; without it the lot is rejected, and PHI breaches are caught too late.
tools.who: Export-oriented growers, FPOs and packhouses
tools.solution: Log every spray on mobile, warn when a planned harvest date would violate any product's PHI, and export a buyer/GAP-ready residue-compliance report per lot.
tools.regulation: APEDA/MRL and GLOBALG.A.P-style buyer norms (IN), BPI/Codex export (PH)

tools.title: Milk Collection Fat/SNF Payout System
tools.problem: Village milk collection centers must price each farmer's milk by fat and SNF against a rate chart, twice daily, and settle on a short cycle with a member passbook, all currently on paper.
tools.who: Dairy collection centers and their member farmers
tools.solution: Capture volume, fat and SNF per farmer per shift, compute the rate from the chart, and run the payout cycle with a member passbook, offline at the village.
tools.regulation: FSSAI (IN), NDA/FDA-PH (PH)

tools.title: Fertilizer DBT PoS Reconciler
tools.problem: Fertilizer retailers sell under DBT through mandatory iFMS/mFMS PoS devices but must separately keep an FCO stock register; closing stock on the PoS and in the register drift apart and trigger inspection penalties.
tools.who: FCO-licensed fertilizer retail dealers
tools.solution: Import PoS sales and O-form receipt CSVs, auto-reconcile opening/received/sold/closing per product and batch, and flag negative or implausible stock before officers do.
tools.regulation: Fertilizer DBT, iFMS/mFMS PoS, Fertilizer Control Order stock register

tools.title: Agri-Input Licence Renewal Tracker
tools.problem: A single dealer juggles seed, fertilizer (FCO) and pesticide (CIB&RC) licences in India, or an FPA dealer licence in the Philippines, each with different validity and paperwork; a lapsed licence halts trade mid-season.
tools.who: Agri-input retail and wholesale dealers
tools.solution: Store each licence with scanned docs, compute renewal dates, send staged reminders, and generate a jurisdiction-specific renewal checklist and document pack.
tools.regulation: Seed licence, FCO, CIB&RC/Insecticides Act (IN); Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority dealer licence (PH)

tools.title: Pesticide Dose & PHI Calculator
tools.problem: Dose, water volume, pre-harvest interval and re-entry period are buried in tiny label text; wrong dosing wastes product or leaves residues that fail buyer MRL tests.
tools.who: Input dealers advising farmers, and farmers themselves
tools.solution: Pick crop, pest and registered product to get label dose per tank and per acre, spray volume, PHI days to safe harvest and re-entry interval, with a printable advisory slip.
tools.regulation: CIB&RC labels / Insecticides Act (IN), FPA registration (PH), Codex/MRL

tools.title: FCO & Seed Statutory Stock Register
tools.problem: Fertilizer and seed dealers must maintain prescribed stock registers (O-form/invoice receipts, sales, batch, closing balance) ready for surprise inspection; most keep messy paper books.
tools.who: FCO fertilizer and seed-licensed dealers
tools.solution: A batch-and-expiry inventory that outputs the exact statutory register layout, tracks O-form source and lot, and prints inspection-ready pages.
tools.regulation: Fertilizer Control Order, Seeds Act/Rules stock registers

tools.title: FPO Member & Shareholding Registry
tools.problem: Producer Companies must maintain a statutory member register, share allotment and board records under Part IXA of the Companies Act, but run it on loose spreadsheets that fail audit.
tools.who: Farmer Producer Companies and their CEOs/accountants
tools.solution: Manage members with land/KYC, share issue and transfer, board and AGM records, and generate the statutory registers and AGM attendance/voting lists.
tools.regulation: Companies Act Part IXA (Producer Companies), NABARD/SFAC FPO norms

tools.title: CDA Coop Compliance & Surplus Ledger
tools.problem: Agri cooperatives registered with the CDA must file annual reports, audited statements and a social audit, and allocate net surplus and patronage refunds per RA 9520, or lose good standing.
tools.who: Agri cooperative secretaries and treasurers
tools.solution: A CDA reporting calendar with reminders, a member share-capital ledger, and a net-surplus allocation and patronage-refund calculator.
tools.regulation: Cooperative Development Authority, Cooperative Code RA 9520

tools.title: Cold-Room Temp Log & Excursion Alerts
tools.problem: Small cold stores and reefer operators must prove continuous temperature control to buyers and food-safety auditors, but keep paper logs that are lost or back-filled.
tools.who: Micro cold-storage and reefer-van operators
tools.solution: A PWA/app that logs temperature (manual or via cheap Bluetooth sensors), charts each chamber, flags excursions in real time, and exports a tamper-evident audit log.
tools.regulation: FSSAI (IN), FDA-PH, HACCP/cold-chain norms

tools.title: Cold Store Occupancy & Rent Manager
tools.problem: Potato and produce cold stores rent space by the bag/lot per month; tracking what's in which chamber, whose it is, and accruing rent is done in error-prone ledgers.
tools.who: Standalone cold-storage operators
tools.solution: Manage chamber occupancy, lot in/out with owner and grade, auto-accrue rent per bag-month, and issue the storage receipt and exit bill.
tools.regulation: State cold-storage licensing, WDRA where applicable

tools.title: Mandi Net-Realization Advisor
tools.problem: Agmarknet and eNAM list gross mandi prices across markets, but a farmer can't tell where they'll actually net the most after freight and commission.
tools.who: Farmers and FPOs deciding where to sell
tools.solution: Pull public daily mandi prices, let the user pick commodity and nearby markets, and rank them by net realization after freight, commission and fees, with trend charts.
tools.regulation: eNAM/Agmarknet public data, model APMC

tools.title: Weighbridge Slip Digitizer
tools.problem: At collection centers and mandi gates, gross-tare-net is scribbled on paper kanta slips, breaking the link to farmer, lot and rate and wrecking reconciliation.
tools.who: Collection-center and trader gate staff
tools.solution: Capture the weighbridge slip (photo or manual gross/tare/net), tie it to farmer, lot and agreed rate, print or share a slip, and feed the payout ledger, offline-first.
tools.regulation: Legal Metrology weighment (IN), DTI weights-and-measures (PH)

tools.title: RSBSA Registry & Subsidy Eligibility
tools.problem: Philippine farm subsidies, RCEF seed/fertilizer vouchers and fuel discounts, gate on RSBSA registration, but coops track member RSBSA status and claims in scattered sheets.
tools.who: Farmer coops and LGU agriculture offices
tools.solution: Maintain member RSBSA IDs, parcels and crops, and check per-program eligibility and claim status for RCEF and related benefits.
tools.regulation: RSBSA, RCEF, Rice Tariffication Law RA 11203

tools.title: Rule-Based Produce Grading App
tools.problem: Grading at the collection point is subjective, so farmers dispute the grade and price they're assigned.
tools.who: Collection-center graders and procurement staff
tools.solution: Capture a sample photo and measurable parameters (size, moisture, defect count) and apply published grade rules to assign a grade, price band and evidence record to the lot.
tools.regulation: AGMARK (IN), DA/BPI grading standards (PH)

tools.title: Commission-Agent Consignment Ledger
tools.problem: Mandi commission agents run running accounts with farmers and traders, consignments, advances, deductions, sales and commission, that generic accounting software simply can't model.
tools.who: APMC commission agents (arhtiyas)
tools.solution: A purpose-built ledger for farmer consignments, advances, deductions, trader sales and commission, producing clean account statements for both sides.
tools.regulation: APMC licensing, commission and market-fee norms

tools.title: Soil Health Card to Fertilizer Buy-List
tools.problem: Farmers get a Soil Health Card with NPK recommendations in kg/ha that they can't convert into how many bags of urea, DAP or complex to actually buy.
tools.who: Farmers and the dealers advising them
tools.solution: Enter the card's recommendation and plot size to get a buy list in bags of locally available fertilizer grades, with substitution options.
tools.regulation: Soil Health Card scheme, FCO grades

tools.title: Truck Trip Cost & 44AE Tax Calculator
tools.problem: Fleet owners quote freight on gut feel with no idea of true per-km cost (diesel, driver bata, tyre, EMI, maintenance, tolls), so they underprice trips and quietly bleed cash.
tools.who: One-to-twenty truck fleet owners and owner-drivers.
tools.solution: Zero-login browser calculator: enter truck specs, EMI, mileage, diesel price, tolls, driver salary and bata to get per-km cost, breakeven freight and trip profit, with a Section 44AE presumptive-tax estimate (Rs 1,000/ton/month) on the same screen.
tools.regulation: Section 44AE presumptive taxation for goods carriages; GTA RCM note.

tools.title: Driver Bata & Advance Ledger
tools.problem: Driver pay is base + per-trip bata + halt allowance minus advances (udhaar) plus/minus fuel adjustments, all computed by hand, so payday disputes are routine.
tools.who: Fleet owners and transport managers.
tools.solution: Per-driver ledger of trips, bata rates, halt allowance, advances and deductions that produces a monthly payslip over WhatsApp, with a running advance balance.
tools.regulation: TDS 194C note; minimum-wage reference.

tools.title: E-Way Bill Bulk Generator & Expiry Guard
tools.problem: Traders and small transporters create e-way bills one at a time on the clunky NIC portal; wrong PIN-to-PIN distance, a missed Part-B vehicle update, or an expired bill means roadside detention and penalties.
tools.who: Traders, GTA transporters and small manufacturers moving consignments above Rs 50k.
tools.solution: Single-binary tool that wraps the taxpayer's own NIC EWB API credentials to bulk-create and update e-way bills, auto-fill PIN-to-PIN distance, generate consolidated EWBs for multi-consignment trucks, and run an expiry countdown that prompts validity extension before the truck rolls.
tools.regulation: GST e-way bill (Rule 138), NIC EWB API, consolidated EWB, Part-B vehicle update.

tools.title: Branded Consignment Tracking Link
tools.problem: Small transporters have no 'track your shipment' page, so customers call all day asking where the truck is; big 3PLs offer tracking and MSMEs look amateur by comparison.
tools.who: Small transporters, 3PLs and household movers.
tools.solution: Generate a public tracking URL per LR/consignment note; the transporter updates status by replying to a WhatsApp bot message or a one-tap form, and the customer sees a clean status timeline with ETA.
tools.regulation: GTA consignment note (IN); BIR delivery receipt reference (PH).

tools.title: Cold-Chain Temperature Log with Excursion Proof
tools.problem: Reefer trucks and cold rooms log temperature on paper; excursions are found too late and there's no audit trail for FSSAI/FDA or for customers.
tools.who: Reefer transporters, cold storages and ice-cream/pharma distributors.
tools.solution: Operator logs temperature at set intervals (manual entry or Bluetooth probe) with a timestamped, geo-tagged photo of the gauge; excursions auto-flag and a tamper-evident cold-chain certificate is generated per trip or shipment.
tools.regulation: FSSAI cold chain (IN), FDA-PH good distribution practice, pharma GDP.

tools.title: Freight E-Invoice IRN Maker (GTA)
tools.problem: Logistics firms crossing the e-invoice turnover threshold must generate an IRN and signed QR on every freight invoice, but the portal is painful and their billing tool may not support it.
tools.who: GTAs, 3PLs and freight forwarders above the e-invoice threshold.
tools.solution: Create freight invoices with SAC 9965/9967, push them to the IRP for IRN plus signed QR, attach both to the PDF, and apply the correct reverse-charge logic.
tools.regulation: GST e-invoice IRN (IRP/NIC), SAC 9965/9967, GTA RCM, e-invoice threshold.

tools.title: BIR Serial-Compliant Receipt Book (PH)
tools.problem: Philippine logistics MSMEs must issue BIR-registered receipts and sales invoices with ATP/serial control; handwritten books are error-prone and the shift to e-invoicing (EIS) is coming.
tools.who: Trucking, 3PL and courier businesses registered with the BIR.
tools.solution: Issue serialized delivery receipts, billing statements and official receipts in BIR format, track the number series, auto-produce the BIR sales/collection summary, and export EIS-ready data.
tools.regulation: BIR ATP/serial control, EIS e-invoicing, Form 2307 CWT.

tools.title: Detention & Demurrage Claim Capturer
tools.problem: Trucks wait hours at loading and unloading; detention charges are genuinely owed but rarely claimed because no one logs in/out times with proof.
tools.who: Fleet owners, 3PLs and container haulers.
tools.solution: Log gate-in and gate-out per trip with geo-timestamp and photo, auto-compute free-time breach against the contract, and generate a ready-to-send detention claim statement.
tools.regulation: Commercial contract free-time; port/CONCOR demurrage reference (IN).

tools.title: Odometer-Based Preventive Maintenance Planner
tools.problem: Maintenance is done reactively, so breakdowns happen mid-route with costly downtime and there's no service history per vehicle.
tools.who: Fleet owners.
tools.solution: Set service schedules by km and time (oil, brakes, tyres), get odometer-based due alerts, log full service history, and see maintenance cost per vehicle.
tools.regulation: Fitness-certificate tie-in (IN).

tools.title: Fuel Log & Mileage-Theft Detector
tools.problem: Diesel is 40-50% of running cost; drivers can siphon or inflate fuel and owners can't see real mileage per trip.
tools.who: Fleet owners and owner-drivers.
tools.solution: Log each fill (litres, amount, odometer, photo of pump/receipt) to compute km/litre per tank and cost/km, with anomaly flags when mileage drops abnormally.
tools.regulation: None.

tools.title: Incoterms 2020 Explorer & Clause Writer
tools.problem: SMEs quote 'CIF' or 'FOB' without knowing exactly where their cost and risk end, then eat freight/insurance they never priced or fight disputes when goods are damaged in transit.
tools.who: Small exporters quoting overseas buyers and sales staff drafting proformas.
tools.solution: Pick any of the 11 Incoterms and see an animated cost/risk hand-off across the shipment legs (dock to port to vessel to destination), plus the exact responsibility matrix and a paste-ready contract clause for the proforma.
tools.regulation: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); used alike in GST export invoices and BOC export declarations.

tools.title: Demurrage & Detention Deadline Guard
