tools.problem: Free-time on containers quietly expires and demurrage (port) and detention (line) charges pile up, a silent profit-killer the shipping line will never remind you about.
tools.who: Exporters and importers handling their own container logistics.
tools.solution: Record each container's free-time per BL, get escalating phone alerts before charges start, and log disputes and evidence against wrongful charges.
tools.regulation: Carrier free-time/detention tariffs; port demurrage; India shipping-line charge guidelines.

tools.title: LUT Autopilot (annual RFD-11 pack)
tools.problem: Exporters must re-file the LUT (RFD-11) on the GST portal every financial year to ship zero-rated without paying IGST; miss it and every export invoice suddenly attracts IGST, choking working capital.
tools.who: First-time and small GST-registered exporters and their part-time accountants.
tools.solution: Tracks each entity's LUT validity, alerts in March before the new FY, and generates the complete RFD-11 submission pack (undertaking text, two witnesses, prior-year reference) ready to paste/upload.
tools.regulation: GST LUT / RFD-11, IGST zero-rating, financial-year validity.

tools.title: HS & AHTN Code Finder
tools.problem: Picking the wrong tariff code misdeclares duty, forfeits export incentives and triggers customs queries, yet SMEs guess the HS code off a web search.
tools.who: Exporters classifying new products and first-time shippers.
tools.solution: Keyword search to candidate ITC-HS (India) / AHTN (Philippines/ASEAN) codes with plain-language descriptions, chapter notes, and hints on India's RoDTEP rate or the FTA preferential tariff at destination.
tools.regulation: ITC-HS (India), AHTN/ASEAN HS, RoDTEP schedule, FTA tariff schedules.

tools.title: Export Proceeds Radar (EDPMS/eBRC)
tools.problem: If export payment is not realized and reported within the FEMA window, the shipping bill sits as overdue in RBI's EDPMS and the exporter risks being caution-listed, usually discovered only when the bank freezes new exports.
tools.who: Small exporters juggling many shipping bills and staggered buyer payments.
tools.solution: Logs each shipping bill with expected proceeds and due date, flags bills nearing the EDPMS overdue threshold, and nudges eBRC generation/closure once remittance lands.
tools.regulation: FEMA realization timeline, RBI EDPMS, DGFT eBRC.

tools.title: RoDTEP & Drawback Incentive Vault
tools.problem: Export incentive scrips (RoDTEP) and duty drawback are real money, but SMEs under-track them, forget to claim, or let transferable scrips expire unsold.
tools.who: Small merchant and manufacturer exporters operating on ICEGATE.
tools.solution: Estimates RoDTEP and drawback per shipping bill, tracks scrip generation and expiry on ICEGATE, and reminds you to utilize, sell or transfer before the deadline.
tools.regulation: RoDTEP, Duty Drawback, ICEGATE scrips.

tools.title: RCMC & Export-Council Compass
tools.problem: Scheme benefits and many CoO/incentive claims require a valid RCMC from the right Export Promotion Council, but SMEs don't know which council they need and let RCMCs lapse.
tools.who: Exporters of agri/APEDA, engineering, textiles and marine products.
tools.solution: Maps your product and target schemes to the correct council/RCMC (APEDA, FIEO, EEPC, MPEDA, Spices Board), tracks IEC and RCMC validity, and reminds before renewal.
tools.regulation: RCMC, Export Promotion Councils, IEC, DGFT schemes.

tools.title: PH Export Clearance Navigator (TradeNet)
tools.problem: A Philippine exporter must work out which agency clearances a given commodity needs (BPI phyto, BFAR, FDA, SRA, PCA) and route them through TradeNet plus the right CoO form, a maze that stalls first shipments.
tools.who: First-time and small PH exporters of agri, food, fishery and processed goods.
tools.solution: Enter commodity and destination; get the exact list of required licenses/clearances/permits, the responsible agency, the TradeNet steps, and whether you need Form D/E/RCEP or a PCCI non-preferential CoO.
tools.regulation: TradeNet/National Single Window; BPI, BFAR, FDA-PH, SRA, PCA; ATIGA Form D / ACFTA Form E / RCEP CoO.

tools.title: FTA Origin Qualifier (RVC/CTC)
tools.problem: To claim an FTA tariff cut the product must actually qualify under rules of origin, but exporters over-claim (risking denial and penalty) or under-claim (losing the duty saving) because they never do the math.
tools.who: Exporters using India's FTAs and ASEAN/RCEP from the Philippines.
tools.solution: Enter the bill of materials with each input's origin and value; it computes Regional Value Content (e.g. 40%) and checks change-in-tariff-classification to say whether the product qualifies and under which agreement.
tools.regulation: FTA rules of origin: RVC/CTC; CEPA/ECTA/AITIGA (IN), ATIGA/ACFTA/RCEP (PH).

tools.title: Denied-Party & Sanctions Screener
tools.problem: Shipping to a sanctioned buyer or restricted end-use brings severe penalties and bank refusals, yet SMEs do zero screening because enterprise compliance tools are priced for banks.
tools.who: Any exporter onboarding a new overseas buyer or agent.
tools.solution: Screens buyer/consignee name and country against OFAC SDN, UN, EU and UK consolidated lists (and flags India SCOMET/dual-use concerns), with a timestamped screening log for audit.
tools.regulation: OFAC/UN/EU/UK sanctions lists; India SCOMET; bank KYC/AML expectations.

tools.title: Phytosanitary & Fumigation Organizer
tools.problem: Perishable agri shipments rot while phytosanitary certificates and fumigation records lag, and exporters don't always know which destinations require phyto or methyl-bromide treatment.
tools.who: Agri and processed-plant-product exporters.
tools.solution: Tells you the destination's phyto/treatment requirement, generates the plant-quarantine application, logs fumigation/treatment certificates, and reminds you to book inspection in time for the vessel.
tools.regulation: India Plant Quarantine / IPPC phytosanitary; PH Bureau of Plant Industry; ISPM-15 wood packaging.

tools.title: GST Export Refund Reconciler (6A/RFD-01)
tools.problem: IGST and accumulated-ITC refunds on exports get stuck for months because GSTR-1 Table 6A, the shipping bill on ICEGATE and the invoice don't match on invoice number, value or date.
tools.who: Exporters claiming IGST refunds or unutilized-ITC refunds.
tools.solution: Reconciles export invoices against GSTR-1 Table 6A and shipping-bill data, pinpoints the exact mismatch blocking each refund, and tracks RFD-01 claim status.
tools.regulation: GST refunds, GSTR-1 Table 6A, RFD-01, ICEGATE shipping-bill matching, IGST zero-rating.

tools.title: First-Export Onboarding Wizard (IN+PH)
tools.problem: Becoming an exporter at all (the very first registrations) is undocumented and sequence-sensitive, so domestic MSMEs stall before their first shipment.
tools.who: Domestic MSMEs doing their first-ever export.
tools.solution: A guided, ordered walkthrough: India (IEC on DGFT, link GST, Udyam MSME, open an AD-code export bank account); Philippines (DTI/SEC registration, BIR, EMB export accreditation via CPRS), each step with the portal link and what to prepare.
tools.regulation: IEC/Udyam/GST/AD code (IN); DTI/SEC/BIR/EMB CPRS (PH).

tools.title: BIR Alphalist (.dat) Generator — 1604-C/E
tools.problem: Withholding agents must file the year-end Alphalist of employees/payees in BIR's DAT schema via the clunky Alphalist Data Entry tool.
tools.who: Employers and payors filing 1604-C and 1604-E.
tools.solution: Take a payroll/payee CSV and generate the schema-correct Alphalist .dat for 1604-C and 1604-E submission.
tools.regulation: BIR 1604-C/1604-E; Alphalist DAT schema.

tools.title: MSME Samadhaan Delayed-Payment Interest Claim Builder
tools.problem: MSMEs are legally owed compound interest at 3x the RBI bank rate on payments delayed beyond 45 days, but almost none compute or claim it.
tools.who: Micro/small suppliers chasing overdue buyer payments.
tools.solution: Enter invoice date, due date, amount and payment date; it computes the statutory monthly-rest compound interest and generates a ready Samadhaan claim narrative + annexure.
tools.regulation: MSMED Act §15–16; MSME Samadhaan portal.

tools.title: TDS Section & Rate Picker (PAN/206AB flags)
tools.problem: Payers routinely apply the wrong TDS section/rate or miss the higher rate for no-PAN or non-filer payees, causing short-deduction demands.
tools.who: Small-business accounts staff and freelancer-hiring SMEs.
tools.solution: Pick the payment type (contractor, professional, rent, commission, etc.) to get the correct section, threshold, rate, and the doubled/20% logic when PAN is absent or payee is a specified non-filer.
tools.regulation: Income-tax Act §194C/194J/194I/194H; §206AA; §206AB.

tools.title: Presumptive Advance-Tax Estimator (44AD/ADA/AE)
tools.problem: Freelancers and small professionals under presumptive taxation misjudge quarterly advance-tax installments and get hit with 234B/234C interest.
tools.who: Freelancers, consultants, small transporters and traders on the presumptive scheme.
tools.solution: Enter gross receipts and regime; it computes presumptive income, tax and the 15/45/75/100% installment schedule with due dates, flagging shortfall interest.
tools.regulation: Income-tax Act §44AD/44ADA/44AE; §234B/§234C.

tools.title: GSTIN Bulk Validator + Vendor Filing-Risk Check
tools.problem: Claiming ITC from a vendor who is cancelled or chronically non-filing gets the credit reversed later with interest.
tools.who: Procurement and accounts teams, CAs vetting vendor masters.
tools.solution: Paste a list of GSTINs to get validity, active/cancelled status and last GSTR-1/3B filing status, ranked by ITC risk.
tools.regulation: GST portal; GSTR-1/3B filing status; Rule 36(4) ITC conditions.

tools.title: Offline HSN/SAC + GST-Rate Finder (PWA)
tools.problem: Putting the wrong HSN/SAC or rate on an invoice is a common, penalty-attracting error, and lookups usually sit behind logins.
tools.who: Anyone raising GST invoices — shopkeepers, freelancers, small manufacturers.
tools.solution: A keyword-searchable, offline-first PWA mapping goods/services to HSN/SAC + current rate + cess, including common misclassification warnings.
tools.regulation: GST rate schedules; mandatory HSN/SAC on invoices by turnover slab.

tools.title: GSTR-9/9C Annual Reconciliation Prep
tools.problem: The annual return and reconciliation statement require tying books to 12 months of GSTR-1/3B — a tedious, error-prone chore for firms crossing the turnover threshold.
tools.who: Businesses above the ₱2cr/₱5cr annual-return thresholds and their CAs.
tools.solution: Ingest the year's returns plus trial balance; auto-populate GSTR-9 tables, reconcile turnover and ITC for 9C, and list the differences to explain.
tools.regulation: CGST Act §44; GSTR-9/9C.

tools.title: ROC/MCA + LLP Filing Deadline & Penalty Tracker
tools.problem: Small companies and LLPs miss MCA filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, DIR-3 KYC, DPT-3, LLP Form 8/11) whose per-day penalties dwarf the fees.
tools.who: Directors/partners of small private companies and LLPs, and their compliance help.
tools.solution: Enter incorporation type and year-end to get a dated calendar of every MCA filing with document checklists and escalating-penalty warnings.
tools.regulation: Companies Act (AOC-4/MGT-7/DIR-3 KYC/DPT-3); LLP Act (Form 8/11).

tools.title: BIR 2307 Scanner -> Withholding Matcher -> SAWT Builder
tools.problem: Filipino businesses receive stacks of 2307 certificates from customers who withheld tax; each must be captured, matched to income and summarised as a SAWT to claim the credit — by hand it's slow and lossy.
tools.who: Bookkeepers, accountants and withholding-heavy suppliers (contractors, agencies, professionals).
tools.solution: Photograph or import 2307s; OCR pulls payor TIN, period, ATC and amount withheld, reconciles the total to booked income, and exports a filing-ready SAWT.
tools.regulation: BIR Form 2307 (creditable withholding); SAWT; eFPS/eBIRForms attachment.

tools.title: BIR Deadline Calendar by Taxpayer Type
tools.problem: The BIR filing calendar is a maze of monthly/quarterly returns that differ by taxpayer type and are staggered by industry group under eFPS.
tools.who: All registered SMEs and self-employed, plus their bookkeepers.
tools.solution: Pick your profile (8% self-employed, VAT, non-VAT percentage, corporation) and eFPS group to get a clean year calendar of exactly your forms and dates.
tools.regulation: BIR filing calendar; eFPS staggered-filing groups.

tools.title: P3M VAT-Threshold Gross-Receipts Monitor
tools.problem: Crossing ₱3M gross forces mandatory VAT registration; many non-VAT MSMEs blow past it unknowingly and face back-VAT and penalties.
tools.who: Fast-growing non-VAT sole props and small corporations.
tools.solution: Log or import receipts and watch a YTD gauge toward ₱3M with alerts as you near the line and a checklist to shift to VAT cleanly.
tools.regulation: NIRC §109(BB)/§236(G); ₱3M VAT threshold.

tools.title: EOPT-Compliant Sales Invoice Generator (PH)
tools.problem: Under the Ease of Paying Taxes Act the Sales Invoice is now the primary document for both goods and services, with specific fields and series control, and old OR habits no longer comply.
tools.who: Post-EOPT MSMEs issuing invoices without a registered accounting system.
tools.solution: Generate BIR-compliant Sales Invoices with all mandated fields and controlled series numbering, aligned to ATP/CAS rules.
tools.regulation: RA 11976 (EOPT); invoice-as-primary-document; ATP/CAS.

tools.title: PH Payroll Statutory Contributions + 1601-C Calculator
tools.problem: Computing SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG shares plus withholding tax on compensation each payroll trips up small employers whenever the tables change.
tools.who: Micro/small employers running payroll manually.
tools.solution: Enter salary and status to get employee and employer contributions on the current tables plus the 1601-C withholding, per cutoff.
tools.regulation: SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG contribution tables; BIR 1601-C compensation withholding.

tools.title: EWT Rate Finder + QAP/2307 Prep (payor side)
tools.problem: Payors must withhold the right expanded rate on supplier payments, remit via 0619-E/1601-EQ, issue 2307s and file a Quarterly Alphalist of Payees — easy to misrate and under-document.
tools.who: Businesses that withhold on suppliers (the payor side of 2307).
tools.solution: Look up the correct ATC/EWT rate per payment type, track amounts withheld, and prepare the QAP and the 2307s to issue.
tools.regulation: RR 2-98 expanded withholding; 0619-E/1601-EQ; QAP; 2307 issuance.

tools.title: Quarterly Tax Set-Aside 'Tax Jar' (IN+PH)
tools.problem: Freelancers under-save for taxes and scramble at each quarterly deadline, in both India and the Philippines.
tools.who: Freelancers, online sellers and independent professionals in IN and PH.
tools.solution: Log income as it lands; the app sets aside the right percentage (IN: 44ADA advance tax + GST if registered; PH: 8% or percentage + income tax) and nags before each quarterly due date.
tools.regulation: Income-tax §234C advance-tax (IN); BIR quarterly 1701Q/2551Q (PH).

tools.title: 13-Week Cash-Flow Forecaster
tools.problem: MSMEs run on the current bank balance and have no rolling short-term liquidity view, so a predictable crunch still arrives as a surprise.
tools.who: Owner-operators and part-time bookkeepers
tools.solution: Import a bank statement CSV plus known receivables/payables; it builds a rolling 13-week cash projection with low-balance alerts and best/worst-case scenario toggles.
tools.regulation: None specific

tools.title: WhatsApp Collections Sequencer
tools.problem: Overdue invoices get chased one ad-hoc message at a time with no escalation discipline and no record of what was said.
tools.who: MSMEs with recurring B2B customers
tools.solution: Define a dunning ladder (polite to firm to final); it schedules per-invoice WhatsApp/SMS copy with an embedded UPI pay-link and captures a promise-to-pay, tracking state per invoice.
tools.regulation: NPCI UPI intent; TRAI commercial-communication norms

tools.title: Paluwagan (ROSCA) Manager
tools.problem: Paluwagan rotating-savings circles run on a notebook and trust; missed turns, unclear payout order and disputes are routine.
tools.who: Co-worker and barkada savings circles, sari-sari networks
tools.solution: Create a circle, set the contribution and payout order, track who paid each cycle, fire GCash collect reminders, and keep a shared immutable ledger every member can see.
tools.regulation: BSP (framed as non-deposit-taking informal savings); Data Privacy Act

tools.title: Udyam Loan-Scheme Matcher
tools.problem: Micro entrepreneurs don't know which government credit scheme (MUDRA, CGTMSE, PMEGP, Stand-Up India) fits their case, so they rely on paid middlemen.
tools.who: Micro entrepreneurs and first-time borrowers
tools.solution: A static wizard: Udyam category + sector + loan purpose + amount returns a ranked list of eligible schemes with limits, subsidy, collateral rules and a document checklist.
tools.regulation: Udyam; MUDRA; CGTMSE; PMEGP; Stand-Up India

tools.title: Flat-vs-Reducing APR Exposer
tools.problem: Lenders quote flat rates and comfortable EMIs, so MSMEs cannot see the true effective cost of a loan, BNPL plan or advance.
tools.who: Any MSME comparing loan or financing offers
tools.solution: Enter principal, tenor and the flat rate or EMI; it computes the true reducing-balance APR, total interest and a full amortization table, and compares offers side by side.
tools.regulation: RBI fair-lending / APR disclosure norms (IN); BSP Truth in Lending Act (PH)

tools.title: BIR 2307 Withholding Tracker
tools.problem: PH businesses receive creditable-withholding certificates (BIR Form 2307) from corporate customers; a missing cert means a lost tax credit, i.e. lost cash at filing.
tools.who: PH MSMEs and freelancers billing corporates
tools.solution: Log each 2307 expected and received per customer and period, reconcile them against the sales that should have generated them, and alert on missing certificates before the quarterly filing deadline.
tools.regulation: BIR creditable withholding tax; Form 2307; quarterly ITR

tools.title: Invoice with Embedded UPI/GCash Pay Button
tools.problem: MSMEs email a PDF invoice and the customer then has to hunt for how to pay, adding days of delay.
tools.who: Freelancers and small B2B service firms
tools.solution: Generate a clean web + PDF invoice with a live UPI deep-link (IN) or GCash / QR Ph pay button (PH) and a reference that ties the payment back for reconciliation.
tools.regulation: NPCI UPI intent (IN); BSP QR Ph standard (PH)

tools.title: DSO & Receivables Aging Tracker
tools.problem: MSMEs cannot see which customers are strangling their cash because aging lives in a fragile spreadsheet pivot.
tools.who: Owner-operators and bookkeepers
tools.solution: Import invoices; it computes Days Sales Outstanding, aging buckets, worst-offender customers and the trend, with one-click export of the overdue list for collections.
tools.regulation: None specific

tools.title: Sari-Sari Utang (Store-Credit) Ledger
tools.problem: Sari-sari stores extend utang (store credit) tracked in a notebook, so limits are fuzzy and bad debts quietly pile up.
tools.who: Sari-sari store owners
tools.solution: A per-customer utang ledger with credit-limit flags, GCash collect-request reminders, receivables aging and a 'safe to extend?' indicator at the counter.
tools.regulation: BSP e-money (collection only); Data Privacy Act

tools.title: Merchant-Advance/BNPL True-Cost Decoder
tools.problem: Revenue-based advances and merchant BNPL hide their price behind factor rates and daily holdbacks, so MSMEs can't judge how expensive they really are.
tools.who: MSMEs offered merchant cash advance or revenue-based financing
tools.solution: Enter the advance amount, factor rate, holdback % and expected daily sales; it returns the effective APR, the payback date and a cash-flow-drag simulation.
tools.regulation: RBI lending disclosure (IN); BSP Truth in Lending (PH)

tools.title: UPI/GCash Statement Categorizer
tools.problem: MSMEs burn hours categorizing bank, UPI and GCash transactions into income/expense heads for books and tax.
tools.who: Bookkeepers and owner-operators
tools.solution: Import a bank/UPI/GCash CSV; rules plus fuzzy matching auto-categorize transactions, learn from each correction, and export to a standard accounting format.
tools.regulation: None specific

tools.title: Composition vs Regular Tax Decider
tools.problem: Small businesses can't tell whether the GST Composition Scheme (IN) or percentage-tax-vs-VAT (PH) would save them money, a high-leverage choice made blindly.
tools.who: Sub-threshold small businesses and new registrants
tools.solution: Enter turnover, B2B-vs-B2C buyer mix and input costs; it compares net tax and lost input credit between Composition and Regular (IN) or 3% percentage tax and 12% VAT (PH) and recommends.
tools.regulation: GST Composition Scheme (IN); BIR percentage tax vs VAT (PH)

tools.title: PoSH Act Compliance Box
tools.problem: Every employer with 10+ workers must constitute an Internal Committee, keep a confidential case register, and file an annual report to the District Officer under the PoSH Act; most MSMEs are silently non-compliant.
tools.who: HR consultants, small-company admins, IC members
tools.solution: IC constitution documents, a policy generator, a confidential complaint register with the 90-day inquiry clock, and the District-Officer annual-report format.
tools.regulation: PoSH Act 2013

tools.title: ROC/MCA Annual Compliance Calendar
tools.problem: Company secretaries and small companies miss MCA filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, DIR-3 KYC, DPT-3) whose late fees compound at Rs 100/day with no cap.
tools.who: Practising company secretaries, small Pvt Ltd/LLP founders
tools.solution: A per-entity compliance calendar seeded with all ROC due dates, live penalty-exposure estimates, and a document checklist per form.
tools.regulation: Companies Act 2013, LLP Act, MCA21

tools.title: Notarial Register (PH 2004 Rules)
tools.problem: PH notaries public must keep a bound notarial register and submit a monthly report of notarized documents to the RTC Executive Judge; manual registers are error-prone and audits sting.
tools.who: Notaries public and their secretaries
tools.solution: A digital register capturing every required field (document type, parties, competent evidence of identity, fees) that prints register pages and generates the monthly RTC report.
tools.regulation: 2004 Rules on Notarial Practice (PH)

tools.title: Advocate Billing with RCM-Correct Invoicing & TDS
tools.problem: Legal services fall under GST reverse charge (the client pays GST, not the advocate) and clients deduct TDS u/s 194J, so advocates routinely bill wrong and reconcile painfully.
tools.who: Advocates, small law firms, their accountants
tools.solution: Billing that issues RCM-correct invoices (no GST charged where RCM applies), tracks TDS deducted per client, and reconciles receipts against 26AS/AIS.
tools.regulation: CGST RCM Notification 13/2017, Income-tax s.194J

tools.title: Micro-Payroll IN (PF/ESI/PT/TDS single binary)
tools.problem: Payroll SaaS prices out the sub-20-employee shop, but PF/ESI/PT/TDS math is unforgiving and error penalties are steep.
tools.who: Micro-firms and the lone HR/accounts person
tools.solution: A single-binary payroll that computes PF, ESI, state Professional Tax and TDS, and generates payslips plus ECR/challan inputs.
tools.regulation: EPF Act, ESI Act, state Professional Tax, Income-tax TDS

tools.title: PH Semi-Monthly Payroll (SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG + WT)
tools.problem: PH payroll is semi-monthly with three mandatory contributions on shifting tables plus withholding tax, and contribution schedules change yearly, so micro-employers fall behind.
tools.who: Micro-enterprises, bookkeepers, HR of 5-50-person firms
tools.solution: Semi-monthly payroll with current SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG tables and BIR withholding, payslips, and the R-3/RF-1/MCRF remittance schedules.
tools.regulation: SSS, PhilHealth, HDMF (Pag-IBIG), BIR withholding (TRAIN)

tools.title: 13th-Month Pay Calculator & Release Register
tools.problem: 13th-month pay is a legal mandate due by Dec 24, pro-rated by months worked, and small employers scramble every December and mishandle pro-ration and the DOLE compliance report.
tools.who: PH MSME owners and HR staff
tools.solution: Compute each employee's 13th-month from basic-pay records, handle mid-year joiners/leavers, and produce the payout register plus the DOLE compliance report.
tools.regulation: PD 851 (13th Month Pay Law), DOLE reporting

tools.title: Final Pay & COE Generator (PH)
tools.problem: DOLE requires final pay within 30 days and a Certificate of Employment within 3 days of request; money claims explode when employers botch the computation or quitclaim.
tools.who: PH HR and small-firm owners
tools.solution: Compute final pay (unpaid wages, pro-rated 13th month, leave conversion, tax refund) and generate the quitclaim and COE within the statutory windows.
tools.regulation: Labor Code, DOLE Labor Advisory 06-20

tools.title: WhatsApp Attendance & Leave for Micro-Teams
tools.problem: 5-30-person field and hybrid teams have no attendance system; biometric is overkill and dedicated apps go uninstalled.
tools.who: Micro-firm owners with field or hybrid staff
tools.solution: Staff check in/out via a WhatsApp message or link with a geo/selfie stamp; the owner gets a daily roster and a monthly sheet that feeds payroll.
tools.regulation: Shops & Establishments (IN), DOLE timekeeping (PH)

tools.title: Retainer Burn & Scope-Creep Meter
tools.problem: Small agencies bleed margin to scope creep because they don't see retainer hours burning until the month is over.
tools.who: Agency owners and account managers
tools.solution: Log tasks and hours against each client's monthly retainer, see live burn %, and auto-flag overage with a pre-drafted change-order.

tools.title: Export-of-Services GST & LUT Helper
tools.problem: Agencies serving foreign clients must file a Letter of Undertaking to zero-rate exports, match FIRCs/BRCs, and report correctly in GSTR-1, or refunds stall.
tools.who: Agencies and freelancers with overseas clients
tools.solution: LUT filing checklist and renewal reminder, a FIRC/BRC-to-invoice matcher, and the zero-rated export reporting worksheet.
tools.regulation: IGST Act (zero-rated supply), LUT (RFD-11), FEMA FIRC

tools.title: Shift Roster & Adherence for Micro-BPO
tools.problem: Small PH BPO/VA shops juggle 24x7 coverage, night differential and client-timezone shifts on spreadsheets, producing gaps and payroll disputes.
tools.who: Micro-BPO ops leads and team captains
tools.solution: Build rosters by client/timezone, track login adherence, and compute night-differential and overtime feeding payroll.
tools.regulation: Labor Code (night shift differential, OT)

tools.title: Multi-Currency Timesheet & Billing for VA Teams
tools.problem: VA teams bill international clients hourly but reconcile hours, FX and Wise/Payoneer/GCash payouts by hand.
tools.who: VA agency owners and offshore teams
tools.solution: A cross-platform tracker that captures hours (with idle/activity detection) per client, raises multi-currency invoices, and reconciles payouts into a BIR-ready income log.
tools.regulation: BIR income reporting, BSP e-wallet remittance

tools.title: NPC Privacy Compliance Pack for BPO
tools.problem: Any PH BPO processing personal data must register with the NPC, appoint a DPO, keep records of processing and run breach drills; SMEs are largely unregistered and exposed.
tools.who: Micro and small BPOs and VA agencies handling client PII
tools.solution: NPC registration checklist, a privacy-manual and records-of-processing generator, a DPO appointment pack, and a 72-hour breach-notification runbook.
tools.regulation: Data Privacy Act 2012, NPC circulars

tools.title: BIR Sales Invoice / Official Receipt Issuer
tools.problem: Under the EOPT Act the sales invoice is now the primary document and must carry BIR-registered details and numbering; manual booklets and generic invoice apps aren't compliant.
tools.who: PH professionals, agencies and service MSMEs
tools.solution: Issue sequentially-numbered, BIR-compliant sales invoices with the required fields (TIN, business style, VAT/non-VAT breakdown, ATC) and export to the books of accounts.
tools.regulation: NIRC, EOPT Act 2024, BIR invoicing regulations

tools.title: Form 16 & 24Q/26Q TDS Return Prep
tools.problem: Quarterly TDS returns (24Q salary, 26Q non-salary) and year-end Form 16 generation are fiddly, and defaults trigger notices and interest.
tools.who: Small firms' accountants and payroll processors
tools.solution: Ingest salary and vendor-payment data to produce the 24Q/26Q return files and the merged Form 16 Part-B, with challan reconciliation.
tools.regulation: Income-tax TDS s.192/194, TRACES

tools.title: Offline Mela/Bazaar POS
tools.problem: Artisans make a big share of annual sales at exhibitions and melas with patchy or no connectivity, yet have no POS, so they lose stock counts, GST/BIR receipts, and sales data.
tools.who: Stallholders at craft fairs, melas, bazaars, and OTOP events.
tools.solution: Offline-first POS taking cash, UPI, and GCash, printing a simple receipt, tracking stock sold per stall, and syncing sales and tax data once back online.
tools.regulation: GST/HSN receipts (IN); BIR official receipt (PH); UPI/GCash reconciliation.

tools.title: GI Tag Eligibility & Filing Navigator
tools.problem: Clusters rarely know if their craft qualifies for a Geographical Indication or how to file, and consultants charge heavily, so most GIs go unregistered or are held by traders rather than the artisans.
tools.who: Cluster society secretaries, NGO facilitators, proposed GI producer associations.
tools.solution: A guided decision-tree (origin, reputation, link-to-territory, producer group) that returns an eligibility verdict, the correct form, an evidence checklist, and the authorized-user registration path.
tools.regulation: India GI of Goods Act 1999 + GI Registry (Form GI-1, authorized-user GI-3); Philippines IPOPHL GI Rules 2022.

tools.title: Wholesale Linesheet Generator
tools.problem: Boutique and export buyers expect a linesheet (photo, SKU, wholesale price, MOQ, lead time), but artisans send WhatsApp photos and lose the order to someone who looks professional.
tools.who: Craft wholesalers and D2C makers pitching retail buyers.
tools.solution: Upload photos and product rows to produce a clean, print-ready PDF linesheet and lookbook with SKUs, wholesale/MSRP, MOQ, and lead times, entirely client-side.
tools.regulation: n/a (B2B sales collateral); optional HSN/HS code column for downstream invoicing.

tools.title: Client-Side Craft Photo Studio
tools.problem: Poor product photos (cluttered backgrounds, no scale, inconsistent look) sink craft listings, and background-removal SaaS charges per image.
tools.who: Any artisan shooting product photos on a phone.
tools.solution: Browser/WASM tool that removes backgrounds, places items on a consistent marketplace-ready backdrop, adds an optional scale reference, and exports square and lifestyle crops in a batch.
tools.regulation: n/a; no image upload leaves the device (privacy).

tools.title: Artisan Payment & Wage Ledger
tools.problem: Collectives juggle advances, materials issued on credit, and piece payments across many artisans, and reconciling against UPI/GCash transfers is chaos.
tools.who: Cooperative treasurers and D2C brands paying a maker panel.
tools.solution: Track per-artisan advances, material debits, and piece credits, then reconcile against UPI/GCash payout references and produce a clean per-artisan statement.
tools.regulation: UPI (NPCI) / PH InstaPay-GCash references; minimum-wage proof; TDS/withholding where applicable.

tools.title: Deposit-Protected Commission Manager
tools.problem: Bespoke craft commissions (a custom saree, a carved door, a commissioned painting) fall apart over fuzzy scope, no deposit, and disputes about milestones and final payment.
tools.who: Artisans who take made-to-order and bespoke commissions.
tools.solution: A commission workflow: structured quote and scope, deposit collection, milestone photo approvals by the buyer, and final-payment release, with a shared record both sides trust.
tools.regulation: UPI/GCash payment capture; GST/BIR invoicing on completion; consumer-contract clarity.

tools.title: India Artisan Formalization Navigator
tools.problem: To sell on marketplaces, access credit, or export, an artisan needs Udyam, GST, and sometimes a GI/mark, but the sequence and thresholds are bewildering and consultants overcharge.
tools.who: Informal Indian artisans and micro-units going formal.
tools.solution: A guided path that asks turnover and sales channels, then lays out exactly which of Udyam, GST (and when it's actually required), HSN, and relevant marks to get, with links and document lists.
tools.regulation: Udyam registration (MoMSME); GST Act thresholds and HSN; GI/handmade marks.

tools.title: First-Export Documentation Kit
tools.problem: A first craft export order stalls because the maker doesn't know they need an IEC/AD code, a Certificate of Origin, a commercial invoice, packing list, and a shipping bill in the right format.
tools.who: First-time craft exporters and cooperatives in India and the Philippines.
tools.solution: A wizard that identifies the required documents for the shipment and generates drafts (commercial invoice, packing list, CoO request, shipping-bill data sheet) from product and buyer details.
tools.regulation: India DGFT IEC + AD code + shipping bill + EPCH/Certificate of Origin; PH export declaration and clearances.

tools.title: Lab Report Generator + QR Verify
tools.problem: Small diagnostic labs type reports in Word with inconsistent reference ranges and no way for a doctor to confirm a report is genuine, while forged reports circulate on WhatsApp.
tools.who: Diagnostic lab owners and pathologists
tools.solution: Test catalog with age/sex reference ranges, result entry with automatic high/low flagging, and a branded PDF carrying a QR that verifies the report against the lab's record online.
tools.regulation: NABL 112 / ISO 15189 (IN); DOH/RITM lab licensing (PH)

tools.title: ABHA-Linked Solo Clinic EMR
tools.problem: Solo doctors want a lightweight patient record, but full EMRs are desktop-bound, per-seat priced, and do not link to ABHA/ABDM.
tools.who: Single-doctor clinics
tools.solution: Offline-first phone/tablet EMR for demographics, visit notes and prescriptions that scans and links the patient's ABHA number and shares records over ABDM consent.
tools.regulation: ABDM / ABHA, DPDP Act 2023

tools.title: Clinic Token & Queue Board
tools.problem: Walk-in clinics have chaotic waiting rooms where patients crowd the front desk asking whose turn it is.
tools.who: Single-doctor and small walk-in clinics
tools.solution: A browser kiosk that issues sequential tokens (printed or by SMS) and drives a now-serving display on any TV or laptop — no accounts, no install.

tools.title: Bio-Medical Waste Manifest Tracker
tools.problem: Clinics and labs must track bio-medical waste by color-coded category, log handover to the common treatment facility, and file an annual return, but most keep no records and risk penalties.
tools.who: Clinics, diagnostic labs and dispensing pharmacies
tools.solution: Daily waste entry by category (yellow/red/white/blue) with weight, a CBWTF pickup manifest, and an auto-generated annual Form-IV return.
tools.regulation: Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules 2016

tools.title: PhilHealth Konsulta Claim Helper
tools.problem: Primary-care clinics enrolled as PhilHealth Konsulta providers struggle with member registration, profiling data, and the claim submission package.
tools.who: PH primary-care / Konsulta provider clinics
tools.solution: Capture the member PIN, required profiling data and rendered services, validate completeness against Konsulta rules, and export the claim package.
tools.regulation: PhilHealth Konsulta Package

tools.title: Lab Sample Barcode Chain-of-Custody
tools.problem: Small labs mix up samples because there is no firm link between patient, tube and worklist, causing retests and wrong reports.
tools.who: Diagnostic labs
tools.solution: Register the patient, print barcode labels per tube, and scan at each station (receipt, centrifuge, analyzer, report) to build a timestamped custody log.
tools.regulation: NABL 112 pre-analytical controls (IN)

tools.title: Immunization Due-Date Tracker
tools.problem: Pediatric clinics and parents lose track of multi-dose vaccine schedules, and missed doses hurt coverage.
tools.who: Pediatric/GP clinics and parents
tools.solution: Enter a child's date of birth to auto-generate the schedule (IAP/UIP or PH EPI), get due and overdue alerts, and hold a digital immunization card with QR.
tools.regulation: UIP / IAP schedule (IN); DOH EPI schedule (PH)

tools.title: Narcotics & Dangerous Drugs Register
tools.problem: Dispensing narcotic or psychotropic drugs requires a strict running-balance register, and any discrepancy becomes a criminal matter.
tools.who: Pharmacies and clinics dispensing controlled drugs
tools.solution: Maintain a per-drug running balance (receipt/issue/balance) with prescriber and patient capture, a tamper-evident log, and a regulator export.
tools.regulation: NDPS Rules (IN); PDEA / FDA dangerous drugs rules (PH)

tools.title: Chronic Refill Reminder
tools.problem: Pharmacies lose chronic patients (hypertension, diabetes) to competitors because nobody reminds them to refill before they run out.
tools.who: Independent pharmacies
tools.solution: On sale of a chronic medication, compute days-of-supply and auto-send a refill reminder just before run-out, with simple loyalty points to retain the patient.
tools.regulation: Patient-data consent (DPDP / DPA)

tools.title: FDA-PH License & Renewal Tracker
tools.problem: PH pharmacies, labs and clinics juggle FDA-PH LTO, DOH, DTI/SEC and mayor's-permit renewals, and a single lapsed license can shut the shop.
tools.who: PH pharmacies, diagnostic labs and clinics
tools.solution: Register each license with its expiry, then get a dashboard plus 90/60/30-day renewal alerts by email/SMS and a document vault for every permit.
tools.regulation: FDA-PH License to Operate, DOH licensing, DTI/SEC registration, LGU mayor's permit

tools.title: TESDA UTPRAS Program Registration Assistant
tools.problem: Registering each TVET program under UTPRAS demands a TR-aligned competency-based curriculum, shop layout, tools/equipment list and trainer NTTC proof, a paperwork maze that stalls small centres for months.
tools.who: Owners and registrars of private TVET/TESDA training centres.
tools.solution: A guided builder that walks a provider through the chosen Training Regulation, assembles the UTPRAS document packet, validates trainer NTTC validity and equipment-vs-TR gaps, and outputs the submission bundle.
tools.regulation: TESDA UTPRAS; Training Regulations; NTTC trainer requirement.

tools.title: Skilling-Scheme Batch Milestone & Payment Reconciler
tools.problem: PMKVY and state-scheme payments to providers are milestone-linked to portal uploads, and providers lose track of which tranche is stuck on which missing document.
tools.who: Project Implementing Agencies and skilling providers running government-funded batches.
tools.solution: A per-batch tracker mirroring SDMS milestones that flags missing attendance, assessment or placement evidence and computes expected versus received tranche payments.
tools.regulation: PMKVY / Skill India SDMS; state skill-mission MIS.

tools.title: PRC Board-Exam Mock & Pass-Probability Platform
tools.problem: Generic quiz apps ignore how PRC licensure exams actually pass candidates (weighted subject averages, no-grade-below rules), so review centres cannot give realistic readiness signals.
tools.who: PRC licensure review centres for nursing, engineering, CPA, LET and criminology.
tools.solution: Deliver timed board-format mock exams, score them under real PRC weighting and disqualifier rules, and give per-subject diagnostics with a calibrated pass-probability.
tools.regulation: PRC licensure examination rules.

tools.title: Fee-Installment & Dropout-Risk Tracker
tools.problem: Course fees are paid in installments, and missed payments plus falling attendance are the earliest dropout signal, yet owners notice only once a student is already gone and the fee unrecoverable.
tools.who: Coaching centres and vocational institutes with installment fee plans.
tools.solution: Track each student's installment schedule, auto-send WhatsApp/SMS reminders, and flag at-risk students by combining overdue payments with attendance and test dips.

tools.title: TVET Competency-Based Assessment Recorder
tools.problem: TESDA competency assessment demands evidence (rating sheets, observation checklists, portfolio photos) mapped to each CBC unit, but assessors capture it on paper and lose evidence.
tools.who: TESDA assessment centres and accredited competency assessors.
tools.solution: A tablet app that loads the CBC checklist per qualification, records competency ratings, captures photo and video evidence inline, and generates the Competency Assessment Result Summary.
tools.regulation: TESDA competency-based assessment; CBC / Training Regulations.

tools.title: Trainee Placement & Retention Outcome Tracker
tools.problem: Skilling providers must prove placements for scheme payments and credibility, but placement data lives in scattered call logs and screenshots, and three-month retention is rarely checked.
tools.who: NSDC/PMKVY providers and TESDA centres with placement mandates.
tools.solution: Log each trainee's placement (employer, role, salary, offer-letter upload), run automated three-month retention check-ins, and produce honest outcome dashboards and scheme-ready reports.
tools.regulation: NSDC placement reporting (IN); TESDA outcome reporting (PH).

tools.title: QP-NOS / TR Curriculum Coverage Mapper
tools.problem: Affiliation requires proving that content covers every NOS performance criterion (IN QP-NOS) or TR competency (PH), but providers re-read 60-page PDFs and guess at gaps.
tools.who: Curriculum heads at skilling providers and TVET centres.
tools.solution: Import the QP/TR criteria, map each lesson and assessment item to specific criteria, and get a coverage heatmap plus the compliance matrix needed for affiliation.
tools.regulation: NCVET QP-NOS (IN); TESDA Training Regulations (PH).

tools.title: Audit-Grade Attendance (QR + Selfie + Geofence)
tools.problem: Scheme audits demand genuine time-stamped attendance, yet paper muster rolls are trivially faked and get entire batches disqualified.
tools.who: Government-funded skilling and TVET batches and their centre coordinators.
tools.solution: A phone app marking attendance via QR plus selfie plus geofence, producing tamper-evident time-stamped logs that work offline and sync for audit export.
tools.regulation: Scheme attendance norms (PMKVY/state; TESDA scholarship).

tools.title: Scholarship-Test to Fee-Waiver & Enrollment Engine
tools.problem: Coaching centres run branded scholarship-cum-admission tests to acquire students and assign fee-waiver slabs by rank, but running, ranking, waiver assignment and conversion is a manual scramble.
tools.who: Test-prep coaching centres running acquisition tests.
tools.solution: Configure the scholarship test, deliver and rank it, auto-assign waiver slabs by rank band, and convert scorers into enrollments with the discounted fee locked in.

tools.title: TESDA Scholarship Enrollment & Fund-Liquidation Packager
tools.problem: Delivering TWSP/STEP scholarships means enrolling scholars, tracking training hours and liquidating funds with exacting documentation, a frequent cause of delayed or disallowed reimbursement.
tools.who: TVET providers delivering TESDA scholarship programs.
tools.solution: Enroll scholars, track attendance and training hours against the program, and assemble the liquidation document packet (attendance, receipts, outcomes) in TESDA's required format.
tools.regulation: TESDA TWSP/STEP scholarship; fund liquidation rules.

tools.title: Blueprint Question-Bank Tagger & Paper Generator
tools.problem: Faculty keep question banks in scattered Word files and hand-build each exam to a topic/difficulty blueprint, a slow and inconsistent chore.
tools.who: Academic teams at coaching, vocational and review centres.
tools.solution: Import and tag questions by topic, difficulty and Bloom's level, then auto-generate balanced papers to a blueprint with print-ready layout and answer keys, avoiding recent-repeat questions.

tools.title: QuickQuote — Contractor Quotation Builder
tools.problem: Small contractors lose jobs by quoting slowly and inconsistently, lacking a fast way to turn a client brief into a priced, professional quote.
tools.who: finishing, renovation and small-build contractors
tools.solution: Go app: pick work packages (rooms, finishes, waterproofing), auto-expand to quantities against your saved rates, and output a branded quote PDF with terms, advance % and timeline.
tools.regulation: GST (IN) / VAT (PH) line handling

tools.title: RebarCalc — BBS & Steel Weight
tools.problem: Small RCC contractors and bar-benders compute cutting lengths, hooks, bends and steel weight by hand, over-ordering and wasting 5-10% on costly TMT steel.
tools.who: RCC contractors, bar-benders, site engineers
tools.solution: Static web/phone tool: pick bar shape + diameter + dimensions, get cutting length with IS 2502 bend deductions, unit weight (d²/162), total weight per diameter, and a printable Bar Bending Schedule.
tools.regulation: BIS IS 1786 (TMT) + IS 2502 (bar bending)

tools.title: MixMate — Concrete & Mortar Calculator
tools.problem: Builders guess cement bags, sand and aggregate for slabs, footings and plaster, causing short-supply stoppages or cash tied up in surplus material.
tools.who: small builders, masons, finishing contractors
tools.solution: Static calculator: element + grade/mix (M15/M20 or NSCP class) + dimensions, returns cement bags, sand, aggregate, water, using the 1.54 dry-volume factor and an adjustable wastage slider.
tools.regulation: IS 456 / IS 10262 mix proportions (IN); NSCP class mixes (PH)

tools.title: TileTally — Tile, Paint & Flooring Estimator
tools.problem: Dealers and finishing contractors mis-estimate tiles and paint at the counter, causing dye-lot mismatches, repeat trips and returns.
tools.who: tile/paint/hardware dealers, finishing contractors
tools.solution: Static tool: room dimensions + tile size or paint coverage + pattern + wastage, outputs boxes, pieces, paint litres by coat, grout and adhesive, and a printable dealer-branded customer quote.
tools.regulation: Coverage per brand datasheets; no statutory hook

tools.title: DUPAdesk — DPWH Detailed Estimate Builder
tools.problem: PH contractors build Detailed Unit Price Analysis by hand from the DPWH Blue Book, which is slow and error-prone for every bid.
tools.who: PH contractors, estimators
tools.solution: Go single-binary app: pick pay items, get labour/equipment/material breakdowns with OCM and profit markups, output a DUPA plus an abstract of bid ready for submission.
tools.regulation: DPWH Blue Book / DUPA format; RA 9184 procurement

tools.title: DigiMB — Digital Measurement Book
tools.problem: Govt/PWD-facing contractors keep Measurement Books on paper; recording, abstracting and reconciling with RA bills is slow and dispute-prone, and auditors reject loose MBs.
tools.who: PWD contractors, site engineers
tools.solution: Go app: record measurements (nos × L × B × D) per item, auto-abstract to quantities, lock completed pages, export the MB and feed quantities straight into the RA bill tool.
tools.regulation: CPWD/PWD Measurement Book conventions

tools.title: MusterSite — Labour Attendance & Wages
tools.problem: Site supervisors track daily headcount and wages on paper and WhatsApp; errors, ghost workers and wage disputes abound where connectivity is poor.
tools.who: contractors, site supervisors
tools.solution: Offline-first Flutter app: photo/selfie check-in by gang, half/full day marking, skill-rate wage computation, weekly payout sheet, syncing when signal returns.
tools.regulation: BOCW wage/muster norms + minimum-wage boards (IN); DOLE labour standards (PH)

tools.title: DPRsnap — Daily Progress Report
tools.problem: Owners and PMs get inconsistent or no daily site reports, so disputes over progress and delay claims lack any evidence.
tools.who: small builders, PMCs, project owners
tools.solution: Flutter app: one-tap DPR capturing manpower by trade, equipment, work done per block, materials received, weather and geotagged photos, output as a PDF to the client.
tools.regulation: Supports delay/EOT contractual claims; no hard statute

tools.title: SubLedger — Sub-Contractor Work-Order Tracker
tools.problem: Builders juggle many petty/sub-contractors (steel, shuttering, plumbing) on verbal rates; advances, measured work and balances go untracked.
tools.who: builders, main contractors
tools.solution: Go app: issue work orders (scope, rate, unit), log measured work and advances, auto-compute balance with retention, and produce a final settlement statement.
tools.regulation: TDS 194C (IN) / EWT (PH) hooks on payouts

tools.title: GateReco — Delivery-Challan Reconciliation
tools.problem: Materials arrive at site against challans, but short-supply, quality rejects and over-billing go unnoticed without a gate register.
tools.who: site storekeepers, contractors
tools.solution: Flutter app: photo/scan the challan, record received vs ordered, capture reject quantity, link to the PO, flag mismatches and maintain running site stock.
tools.regulation: e-way bill cross-check (IN)

tools.title: FormworkReturn — Formwork & Scaffolding Rental Tracker
tools.problem: Plywood, props, cuplock and formwork go out to sites and never fully return; losses surface only at year-end reconciliation.
tools.who: formwork/scaffolding rental dealers, contractors
tools.solution: Go app: issue items per site with photos, track days-on-rent, log returns and damages, and auto-generate rental billing plus shortage penalties.
tools.regulation: GST rental SAC (IN), VAT (PH)

tools.title: QuoteBlast — Multi-Dealer Material RFQ
tools.problem: Contractors phone around for cement, steel and tile prices; comparing quotes is manual and time-boxed deals slip away.
tools.who: contractors, builders, estimators
tools.solution: Go app: build a material list, broadcast an RFQ to saved dealers via WhatsApp/link, collect structured quotes with no dealer login, and auto-compare into a best-basket.
tools.regulation: None hard

tools.title: SnagPin — Punch List & Handover Sign-off
tools.problem: At handover, defects are noted on paper walkthroughs; tracking fixes and getting client sign-off drags on, delaying final payment.
tools.who: builders, PMCs, interior contractors
tools.solution: Flutter app: pin snags on a floor plan or photo, assign to a trade, track status, re-inspect, capture client digital sign-off and produce a closure report.
tools.regulation: Defect-liability / handover norms

tools.title: PettyFloat — Site Petty-Cash & Expenses
tools.problem: Site advances and petty cash (tea, tools, transport, labour top-ups) leak with no vouchers, so owners can't reconcile what each site actually spent.
tools.who: site supervisors, contractors
tools.solution: Flutter app: log each expense with a photo voucher, category and site, maintain a running imprest balance, raise replenishment requests, and roll up to an owner dashboard.
tools.regulation: Expense/GST input capture (IN)

tools.title: OTA True-Net & Direct-Price Calculator
tools.problem: Owners see the OTA's headline rate, not the 15-25% commission plus payment fees and tax-on-commission, so they don't know their real take or what to offer direct guests.
tools.who: Homestays and small hotels selling through OTAs.
tools.solution: Enter rate, commission, fees and taxes per channel; it shows true net per booking and the direct price that beats the OTA for both guest and owner.
tools.regulation: GST on OTA commission (IN); VAT (PH)

tools.title: C-Form Auto-Filer for Foreign Guests
tools.problem: Small hotels and homestays must report every foreign guest to the Bureau of Immigration via Form C within 24 hours; staff re-key passport and visa data into a clunky government portal and risk penalties for errors or delay.
tools.who: Homestays, guesthouses and small hotels hosting foreign tourists.
tools.solution: Phone-camera scan of the passport MRZ and visa auto-maps to Form C fields, stores a searchable foreigner register, and batch-exports/submits to the immigration portal.
tools.regulation: Registration of Foreigners Act, Form C, Bureau of Immigration (FRRO)

tools.title: Group-Tour Per-Pax Margin Calculator
tools.problem: Operators quote groups by gut, split fixed costs (vehicle, guide, permits) and variable costs (hotel, meals, entries) poorly, and lose money when the group shrinks.
tools.who: Tour operators and destination agencies quoting groups.
tools.solution: Enter fixed and per-pax costs and desired margin; it shows per-pax price at each group size and the break-even headcount.

tools.title: Caterer Per-Plate Cost & Quote Engine
tools.problem: Caterers quote per plate but rarely cost the menu's ingredients at current market prices, so they under-price and erode margin on every event.
tools.who: Caterers and cloud kitchens quoting events.
tools.solution: Build the menu, map each dish to an ingredient bill-of-materials priced from current market rates, and get a per-plate cost and a marked-up quote with GST/VAT and headcount.
tools.regulation: GST (IN) / VAT (PH) on catering; FSSAI/FDA menu notes

tools.title: Travel-Tax All-In Quoter (TCS/TIEZA)
tools.problem: Tour operators mis-quote statutory add-ons (India's 20% TCS on overseas packages and the Philippines' TIEZA travel-tax tiers and exemptions), causing counter disputes and margin leaks.
tools.who: Outbound and inbound tour operators and travel agents.
tools.solution: Dual-mode calculator that applies India TCS (with the 7-lakh/LRS nuances) or PH TIEZA travel-tax tiers and exemptions, then prints a transparent all-in price plus the exemption paperwork.
tools.regulation: India TCS u/s 206C(1G); PH TIEZA travel tax and reduced/exempt categories

tools.title: FSSAI Licence Tier & Display Kit
tools.problem: Caterers and cloud kitchens don't know whether they need Basic Registration, State or Central licence (it depends on turnover and scale), often run under the wrong tier, and miss mandatory display and hygiene requirements.
tools.who: Caterers, cloud kitchens, homestay kitchens and small-hotel F&B.
tools.solution: Determines the correct licence tier from turnover/scale, generates the application checklist, and produces the mandatory display board and a hygiene self-audit.
tools.regulation: FSSAI (FSS Act 2006), licence tiers, display and hygiene norms

tools.title: RevPAR From Your Booking Log
tools.problem: Small hotels keep a booking spreadsheet but never compute occupancy, ADR or RevPAR, so they can't see seasonality or channel mix.
tools.who: Small hotels and homestays with a booking spreadsheet.
tools.solution: Upload the booking log as CSV and get occupancy %, ADR, RevPAR, channel mix and month-by-month seasonality, entirely in the browser.

tools.title: Itinerary-to-PDF Quote Builder
tools.problem: Tour operators assemble itineraries in Word, producing inconsistent, slow, unbranded quotes that omit statutory tax lines.
tools.who: Inbound and outbound tour operators and travel agents.
tools.solution: Drag day-by-day blocks with inclusions/exclusions, pricing and T&C into a branded PDF plus a WhatsApp summary, auto-adding the TCS/travel-tax line.
tools.regulation: India TCS and PH travel-tax disclosure on quotes

tools.title: Timed-Entry Ticketing for Small Attractions
tools.problem: Small museums, heritage homes, caves and viewpoints sell paper tickets for cash with no capacity control and no record.
tools.who: Privately or community-run small attractions and experiences.
tools.solution: Timed-entry QR tickets with per-slot capacity caps and UPI/GCash payment, plus a simple gate-scan check-in.
tools.regulation: UPI (IN), BSP e-money/GCash (PH)

tools.title: Multilingual Dietary-Tagged QR Menu
tools.problem: Printed menus go stale and don't serve tourists who need language options and clear dietary/religious information (veg/Jain, Halal, beef/pork flags).
tools.who: Restaurants, homestay kitchens and small-hotel F&B serving tourists.
tools.solution: A QR menu in local languages plus English with dietary and religious tags (FSSAI veg/non-veg dot, Jain, Halal, allergen) and a daily availability toggle.
tools.regulation: FSSAI veg/non-veg declaration (IN); Halal certification labeling

tools.title: GST e-Invoice IRN Service Billing
tools.problem: GST-registered electrical/plumbing/AMC firms doing B2B work raise invoices with wrong SAC codes and no IRN; their business clients then lose input tax credit and push back.
tools.who: GST-registered field-service contractors doing B2B maintenance/repair
tools.solution: Single-binary invoicer pre-loaded with field-service SAC codes (9987/9954), auto CGST/SGST/IGST, mints e-invoice IRN+QR via the IRP for B2B invoices over the mandated turnover, and exports GSTR-1 JSON.
tools.regulation: GST, SAC 9987/9954, e-invoice IRN/IRP, GSTR-1

tools.title: AMC Renewal Revenue Engine
tools.problem: Small AMC firms lose renewals because contract end-dates live in a diary, and they cannot prove the visit cadence they promised.
tools.who: AMC operators (aircon, RO, lift, DG) running 50 to 2000 contracts
tools.solution: Contract registry that generates a per-asset visit schedule from the plan, fires WhatsApp/SMS renewal nudges at 30/15/7 days before expiry, shows a visit-due calendar, and runs a renewal pipeline.

tools.title: IS 732 Load & Cable-Size Calculator
tools.problem: Small electricians size cables and breakers by thumb rule, causing failures or over-spend, and cannot justify a quote number to the customer.
tools.who: Residential/commercial electricians and solar installers
tools.solution: Offline static calculator: appliance-wise load estimation, diversity factor, cable size per IS 732, breaker rating, voltage drop and earthing, producing a printable load schedule to attach to the quote.
tools.regulation: IS 732, National Electrical Code (BEC)

tools.title: DISCOM Net-Metering Tracker
tools.problem: Solar installers juggle net-metering applications across DISCOMs with different forms, fees and inspection stages; delays stall commissioning and the final payment.
tools.who: Rooftop solar installers with 10 to 100 pending connections
tools.solution: Tracker modelling each application's DISCOM, stage (feasibility to agreement to meter install to commissioning), document checklist, SLA clock, and a per-customer status link.
tools.regulation: DISCOM net-metering regulations, CEA

tools.title: Service-Van Parts Inventory
tools.problem: Technicians run out of common spares mid-job (capacitors, valves, MCBs), forcing a second trip, and owners have no idea what stock sits in each van.
tools.who: Multi-van appliance/HVAC/electrical service firms
tools.solution: Per-van stock tracking with consumption logged against each job, low-stock reorder alerts, simple supplier purchase orders, and QR/barcode part scans.

tools.title: Fire Extinguisher Refill & Compliance Tracker
tools.problem: Fire-safety firms track thousands of extinguishers' refill and hydro-test due dates across client sites; a missed date is both a liability and a lost renewal.
tools.who: Fire-safety AMC contractors
tools.solution: QR-tag each extinguisher, log type/capacity/last refill/hydro-test, roll up due dates per client site, and fire renewal reminders (FSIC in PH, fire NOC cadence in IN).
tools.regulation: IN fire NOC / IS 2190; PH Fire Code RA 9514, FSIC, BFP

tools.title: Daily Route & Job Sequencer
tools.problem: Dispatchers assign jobs by phone, technicians crisscross the city wasting fuel and time, and customers get no ETA.
tools.who: Service firms with 3 to 20 field technicians
tools.solution: Drag jobs onto technicians, auto-sequence by locality and time window, send the customer an ETA link by SMS/WhatsApp, and capture job start/stop.

tools.title: 24/7 Self-Booking Page
tools.problem: Firms take bookings on calls and WhatsApp, lose after-hours leads, and get unstructured job intake with no address, appliance or issue detail.
tools.who: Any field-service MSME wanting structured inbound bookings
tools.solution: A branded, login-free booking page capturing service type, slot, an address pin and issue photos, then dropping a structured lead to WhatsApp or email.

tools.title: Inspection Checklist App
tools.problem: Firms doing safety or commissioning inspections use paper checklists; results are illegible, unsearchable and easy to lose.
tools.who: Inspection and commissioning technicians
tools.solution: Build checklist templates, run a per-site inspection with pass/fail/NA and photo evidence, and auto-generate a signed inspection-report PDF.

tools.title: Asset QR Service History
tools.problem: On a repeat visit the technician does not know the AC, pump or panel's model, past faults or warranty, so they re-diagnose from scratch.
tools.who: AMC and service firms managing installed equipment
tools.solution: Stick a QR on each asset; a scan reveals model, install date, full service history and open issues, and the technician logs today's work against it.

tools.title: UPI/QRPH Collection Board
tools.problem: Technicians collect cash or ad-hoc UPI, owners do not know who paid, and reconciliation is a nightmare.
tools.who: Field-service firms collecting payment at the doorstep
tools.solution: Generate a per-invoice dynamic UPI/QRPH QR, mark paid on confirmation, show a daily collection board by technician, and list pending dues.
tools.regulation: UPI, BSP QRPH

tools.title: Doorstep Trust & OTP Close
tools.problem: Customers, especially women and the elderly, fear letting an unknown technician in, and firms have no identity assurance or tamper-proof job close.
tools.who: Service firms wanting a trust edge on home visits
tools.solution: The customer gets the technician's name, photo, ID and a visit OTP in advance; the job closes only when the customer shares the OTP, with a share-live-location link to a family member.

tools.title: Aircon Cleaning Subscription Manager
tools.problem: PH households need recurring aircon cleaning three to four times a year, but technicians sell it ad hoc and forget to rebook, losing recurring revenue.
tools.who: PH aircon cleaning and servicing technicians and small firms
tools.solution: A per-unit cleaning subscription with auto-rebook reminders, GCash/Maya collection, per-unit service history and referral capture.
tools.regulation: BSP e-wallets (GCash/Maya)

tools.title: BIS/ISI QCO Licence & Marking Compliance Tracker
tools.problem: QCOs are expanding fast and sweep in shops that never needed ISI. A factory must suddenly hold a valid BIS licence, mark every unit correctly, keep lab test reports current and renew on time, or goods are seized and unsellable. Owners don't know which IS standard applies, when the licence/marking fee lapses, or when the next factory sample test is due.
tools.who: MSME manufacturers of products newly pulled under mandatory BIS certification by Quality Control Orders (toys, footwear, electrical goods, steel, kitchenware, fasteners).
tools.solution: Register each product to its IS standard and QCO, store the BIS licence (CM/L number) with validity and annual marking-fee date, schedule the periodic factory sample testing, hold lab reports with expiry, and generate the correct ISI mark spec (standard no. + licence no.) per SKU. Alerts fire before every deadline.
tools.regulation: BIS Act 2016; product-specific Quality Control Orders (QCO); ISI marking

tools.title: SPCB Consent (CTE/CTO) & Form V / Hazardous-Waste Returns Tracker
tools.problem: A factory must hold a valid Consent to Establish/Operate, file the Environmental Statement (Form V) by 30 September every year, and, if it generates hazardous waste, keep manifests and file the annual return (Form 4) under the 2016 rules. Consents lapse, Form V is forgotten, and each renewal re-assembles the same documents, risking closure notices.
tools.who: Orange/Red-category MSME factories (engineering, foundry, treatment units) under State Pollution Control Board oversight.
tools.solution: A compliance cockpit storing CTE/CTO with validity, category and conditions; a returns calendar (Form V by 30 Sep, haz-waste Form 4 by 30 Jun); a Form 10 hazardous-waste manifest log with quantities to the authorized TSDF; a document vault that pre-fills the next renewal pack; and alerts before every due date.
tools.regulation: Water Act 1974 & Air Act 1981 Consent (CTE/CTO); Environmental Statement Form V; Hazardous & Other Wastes (M&TM) Rules 2016 (Form 4/Form 10)

tools.title: DOLE OSH Compliance Pack (RA 11058 / DO 198-18)
tools.problem: RA 11058 and DO 198-18 require a trained safety officer, an OSH committee with minutes, a company OSH program, mandatory 8-/40-hour training, periodic risk assessment, and reports (Annual Medical Report, Work Accident/Illness Report within set days). Small shops don't learn what's required until an inspection or an accident, then face stiff per-day penalties.
tools.who: Philippine MSME manufacturers and fabrication shops that must meet DOLE occupational safety and health standards.
tools.solution: A guided pack sized to the shop's worker count and risk level: generates the required OSH program document, tracks safety-officer and worker training with certificate expiry, logs committee meetings and minutes, maintains the hazard/risk register, and prepares the mandated reports (WAIR, Annual Medical/Exposure) with deadlines and alerts.
tools.regulation: RA 11058 and DOLE DO 198-18 (OSH Standards); mandatory WAIR and OSH training/reporting

tools.title: Pre-Production Sample Submission & Approval Tracker
tools.problem: An order dies in the sample stage - proto, fit, SMS, size-set, PP, TOP and red-seal samples go back and forth over email with versions, comments and courier AWBs, and nobody can say which sample is pending whose approval.
tools.who: Garment export merchandisers and sampling rooms serving overseas buyers and buying houses.
tools.solution: A sample register per PO/style: log each sample type and version, courier/AWB, submit date, buyer comments and approve/reject/revise status with the red seal that releases bulk; a board shows what blocks each order and the ageing of pending approvals.

tools.title: Buyer Social-Audit CAPA Tracker
tools.problem: Brands demand SMETA/SEDEX, amfori BSCI, WRAP or SA8000 audits; factories scramble to assemble age proofs, wage registers, fire-drill records and OT consent, then lose the corrective-action list in email and fail the re-audit.
tools.who: Compliance and HR managers at garment export factories facing brand/retailer audits.
tools.solution: A self-assessment against the chosen audit code, an evidence vault (fire NOC, extinguisher refill dates, PF/ESI challans, age documents, wage sheets) with expiry reminders, and a CAPA tracker that gives each non-conformance an owner, due date and closure evidence before the follow-up audit.
tools.regulation: SMETA/SEDEX; amfori BSCI; WRAP; SA8000

tools.title: Textile ZLD & CETP Effluent Compliance Log
tools.problem: Pollution boards and ZLD mandates require daily effluent flow, pH and discharge logs, flow-meter readings and CETP inlet records; a missing log or a lapsed Consent to Operate can get a dye house sealed overnight.
tools.who: Dyeing and processing houses in Tirupur, Pali, Panipat, Surat and other CETP-member clusters.
tools.solution: Log daily effluent flow, pH, TDS and CETP/ZLD meter readings against consented limits, auto-flag excursions, and track Consent-to-Operate and Hazardous-Waste authorisation renewal dates with escalating reminders; export the register in the format the SPCB/CETP inspector expects.
tools.regulation: SPCB Consent to Operate (Water Act 1974); ZLD norms; Hazardous Waste authorisation

tools.title: Dye & Chemical RSL / ZDHC MRSL Compliance Register
tools.problem: Brands enforce ZDHC MRSL and their own RSL and ban azo dyes; a factory must prove every dye and auxiliary is compliant and hold current test reports, but the chemical list lives in the storeroom and reports expire unnoticed.
tools.who: Dye houses, printers and exporters shipping to brands with chemical-compliance demands.
tools.solution: A register of every dye and chemical with CAS number, supplier, ZDHC/bluesign level, azo/APEO/formaldehyde flags and the linked lab or Oeko-Tex report and its expiry; it flags banned or uncertified chemicals before they enter a buyer's order and assembles the compliance pack for the audit.
tools.regulation: ZDHC MRSL; EU REACH SVHC (Reg 1907/2006); azo-dye restriction (BIS/IS)

tools.title: Embroidery Stitch-Count Pricing & Zari Karigar Ledger
tools.problem: Embroidery is priced by stitch count, head-hours or per motif, and precious zari and stones are issued to karigars by weight; without a system, jobs are under-priced and material (including gold/silver zari) goes unaccounted.
tools.who: Machine (Schiffli/multi-head) and hand (aari, zardozi) embroidery units and job-workers.
tools.solution: Price each job by stitch count per 1000, per-motif rate or head-hours; issue material to karigars (zari weighed in and out with permissible wastage), track job status, and compute karigar dues net of advances and any material shortfall.

tools.title: Fabric Bolt (Thaan) Barcode & Remnant-Length Tracker
tools.problem: Cloth is sold by the metre off bolts (thaan); staff cannot tell how many metres remain on a roll without unrolling it, so they over-promise, lose short remnants and cannot value stock accurately.
tools.who: Fabric wholesalers, retailers and warehouse stores selling cloth by the metre.
tools.solution: Give each bolt a barcode tagging design, shade, width and starting length; every cut scans the bolt and deducts metres, so remaining length, rack location and value are always known, with alerts on low remnants and fast-moving designs for reorder.

tools.title: Sewing-Line Bundle Ticket & Operator Piece-Rate
tools.problem: Cut parts move through sewing in bundles with tickets; operators tear coupons per operation for piece-rate pay, but manual coupon counting is slow, error-prone and disputed, and WIP per operation is invisible.
tools.who: Garment sewing units paying operators by piece through the bundle/coupon system.
tools.solution: Generate barcoded bundle tickets per cut lot and size; operators scan as each operation is completed, building piece-rate earnings per operator and live WIP by operation and line, with a shift payout sheet at day end.

tools.title: Apparel Care & Fiber-Content Label Generator
tools.problem: Every market demands a specific care + fibre-content + origin label - EU fibre-name rules, the US care-labelling rule and care symbols - and wrong wording, symbol set or fibre percentages mean rejected or seized shipments.
tools.who: Garment exporters, D2C apparel brands and private-label makers.
tools.solution: Enter fibre composition, care instructions and destination market; generate a compliant label with correct fibre-name wording, the right care-symbol system (GINETEX/ISO vs US), country of origin and size, ready to print or send to the label supplier.
tools.regulation: EU Reg 1007/2011 (fibre names/labelling); US FTC Care Labeling Rule (16 CFR 423) & Textile Fiber Products Identification Act; BIS IS 15351

tools.title: FSSAI Annual Return (D1/D2) Filer
tools.problem: Every FSSAI-licensed manufacturer must file Form D1 by 31 May (D2 half-yearly for milk) declaring product-wise, packaging-wise quantities handled; the penalty for missing it is Rs 100/day accruing indefinitely and it blocks renewal, yet most owners never knew the return existed.
tools.who: Licensed food manufacturers, importers and 100%-export units (plus milk/dairy units for Form D2).
tools.solution: Pull the year's production/sales into product- and packaging-wise quantities, validate them against the licence's product categories, output the exact D1/D2 figures ready to key into FoSCoS, and run a running late-fee meter plus a May-deadline watchdog across every licence held.
tools.regulation: FSSAI FSS (Licensing & Registration) Regulations Form D1/D2 annual return

tools.title: LMPC Packaged-Commodity Declaration & Registration Helper
tools.problem: Beyond the FSSAI label, the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules mandate a separate set of declarations - MRP inclusive of all taxes, standard net-quantity format, unit sale price, month/year of packing, packer/importer identity and minimum character heights - plus LMPC registration; metrology inspectors fine MSMEs who got only the FSSAI label right.
tools.who: Packers, manufacturers and importers of any pre-packaged food sold by weight, volume or number.
tools.solution: A metrology-specific declaration builder that lays out the principal display panel fields, enforces net-quantity rounding and font-height rules, computes and prints unit sale price, and assembles the LMPC/importer-registration pack with the fee and jurisdiction.
tools.regulation: Legal Metrology Act 2009 & Packaged Commodities Rules 2011; LMPC registration

tools.title: Mithai Tray-Date & Festival Production Planner
tools.problem: Since the 2020 FSSAI direction every tray of loose sweets must display a 'best before date', and festival demand (Diwali, Raksha Bandhan) swings five to ten times - owners mislabel trays and either run out or dump unsold mithai.
tools.who: Sweet shops (halwais), namkeen counters and dessert makers selling loose, non-packaged sweets.
tools.solution: Generate dated 'best before' tray cards per sweet from its shelf life, and a festival production plan that scales batch recipes and raw-material buys to a demand forecast built from last year's festival sales.
tools.regulation: FSSAI direction on mandatory 'Best Before Date' display for non-packaged sweets (2020)

tools.title: Fryer-Oil TPM & Used-Cooking-Oil (RUCO) Log
tools.problem: FSSAI bars using frying oil once Total Polar Compounds exceed 25%, and larger users must hand spent oil to registered UCO aggregators under RUCO - but kitchens keep no record of when oil crossed the limit or where it went, failing inspection and forfeiting the biodiesel rebate.
tools.who: QSRs, snack and namkeen fryers, sweet shops and any high-volume frying kitchen.
tools.solution: Log each fryer's oil top-up and TPM test reading against the 25% limit with a change-now alert, and record every used-oil pickup (quantity, aggregator, receipt) to build the RUCO disposal trail and an auditable oil-life report.
tools.regulation: FSSAI Total Polar Compounds 25% frying-oil limit; RUCO / UCO disposal to registered aggregators

tools.title: BIS Packaged-Water ISI Compliance & Test Log
tools.problem: Packaged and mineral water are under mandatory BIS certification (IS 14543 / IS 14544) with a dense battery of periodic chemical and microbiological tests plus BIS surveillance; one lapsed test or expired licence cancels the ISI mark the business cannot sell without.
tools.who: Packaged-drinking-water and mineral-water bottling MSMEs.
tools.solution: A test-schedule register for every mandated parameter with due-date tracking and lab-report storage, BIS licence and marking-fee renewal tracking, and escalating alerts so no periodic or surveillance test is missed, producing an inspector-ready compliance file.
tools.regulation: BIS mandatory certification IS 14543 (packaged drinking water) / IS 14544 (mineral water)

tools.title: Water-Refilling Station Permit & DOH Test Log
tools.problem: A refilling station lives on DOH-standard water quality - periodic bacteriological and physico-chemical potability tests - plus an LGU sanitary permit and operator health cards; a failed or missed potability test or a lapsed permit shuts it, and most run on reminder-by-memory.
tools.who: Water-refilling stations and small purified/alkaline water sellers across the Philippines.
tools.solution: A potability test scheduler tracking each required bacteriological and physico-chemical test with due dates and lab-result storage, LGU sanitary- and business-permit renewal tracking, and operator health-card expiry, all on one alert board.
tools.regulation: DOH PNSDW water-quality testing; LGU sanitary & business permit for water-refilling stations

tools.title: PD 856 Sanitary Permit & Food-Establishment Self-Audit
tools.problem: PH LGUs license and rate food establishments under the Code on Sanitation (PD 856) - a sanitary inspection against a long checklist yields an A/B/C/D sanitary rating and the permit; MSMEs do not know the criteria and fail or get down-rated on repeat visits.
tools.who: Carinderias, restaurants, bakeries, caterers and food stalls operating under an LGU sanitary permit.
tools.solution: A self-inspection app built from the PD 856 food-establishment checklist that scores the likely sanitary rating, lists the exact defects to fix before the inspector arrives, tracks sanitary-permit and food-handler health-certificate renewals, and keeps a photo record of corrections.
tools.regulation: PD 856 Code on Sanitation & IRR Chapter III (food establishments); LGU sanitary permit & rating

tools.title: HACCP Plan & CCP Monitoring Logbook
tools.problem: Schedule 4 (and FDA-PH GMP/HACCP) require a written hazard plan plus daily records of critical control points, but MSMEs keep none or scribble them in a register that fails audit and proves nothing during a complaint or recall.
tools.who: Packaged-food, dairy, meat, catering and cloud-kitchen units an FSSAI/FDA auditor expects to run a documented food-safety plan.
tools.solution: A guided builder that turns the process flow into a HACCP plan (hazards, CCPs, critical limits, corrective actions) then generates the matching daily mobile log cards - cooking/core temp, cold-holding, receiving temp, sanitation - with out-of-limit auto-alerts and a one-tap auditor-ready PDF for any date range.
tools.regulation: FSSAI Schedule 4 / Codex HACCP; FDA-PH GMP & HACCP

tools.title: Food-Handler Health Card & FoSTaC Supervisor Tracker
tools.problem: Schedule 4 requires annual medical fitness and inoculation for every food handler, and FoSTaC requires one trained Food Safety Supervisor per 25 handlers; PH city health offices require a current food-handler's health certificate per worker - all kept on paper and routinely lapsed at inspection.
tools.who: Any food business employing food handlers - restaurants, caterers, cloud kitchens, processing units.
tools.solution: A staff roster storing each handler's medical-fitness date, vaccination and health card/certificate, computing the trained-supervisor-to-handler ratio live and firing escalating reminders before any card or FoSTaC certificate expires, with a printable compliance board for the inspector.
tools.regulation: FSSAI Schedule 4 medical fitness + FoSTaC Food Safety Supervisor (1:25); PH LGU food-handler health certificate

tools.title: Shelf-Life & Stability Study Logbook
