tools.problem: Returned and RTO stock piles up unprocessed with no QC grading and no putback-vs-scrap decision, so recoverable inventory value is lost.
tools.who: D2C sellers, 3PLs and distributors.
tools.solution: Scan each returned item, record reason and a QC grade (resalable / refurb / scrap), route it to a bin or write-off, and track returns on a dashboard.
tools.regulation: GST credit-note tie-in (IN).

tools.title: Artisan Grant & Scheme Finder
tools.problem: Dozens of grants and support schemes exist for artisans, but they're buried across agency sites and most makers never discover the ones they qualify for.
tools.who: Artisans, SHGs, and cooperatives seeking funding and support.
tools.solution: A short questionnaire (craft, location, formal status, need) that matches the maker to relevant schemes with eligibility, benefit, deadline, and application links.
tools.regulation: EPCH/DC-Handicrafts & NABARD & PM Vishwakarma (IN); DOST SSF, DTI SSF, GREAT Women (PH).

tools.title: WhatsApp Catalog to Storefront Importer
tools.problem: Most micro-crafters sell via a WhatsApp Business catalog, which has no real storefront, no SEO, and no order record beyond chat scrollback.
tools.who: WhatsApp-first craft sellers in India and the Philippines.
tools.solution: Import the WhatsApp Business catalog export and generate a lightweight hosted storefront with shareable product links, stock flags, and an order-capture form that still routes to WhatsApp.
tools.regulation: WhatsApp Business commerce policy; GST/BIR invoice fields optional at checkout.

tools.title: Craft Export & Etsy Compliance Checker
tools.problem: Craft exporters unknowingly list items made from restricted materials (certain woods, shells, feathers, ivory-like) or use the wrong HS code, risking seizures and account bans.
tools.who: Cross-border craft sellers on Etsy/Amazon Global and direct exporters.
tools.solution: Answer a few questions about material and destination to get flags for CITES/import-restricted materials, likely HS code, prohibited claims, and a pre-ship checklist.
tools.regulation: CITES; US Lacey Act; destination import bans; India/PH export HS classification.

tools.title: Raw-Material Group-Buy Coordinator
tools.problem: Individually, artisans buy yarn, clay, beads, or abaca in tiny lots at retail prices; they'd get wholesale rates if they pooled demand, but coordinating it by hand fails.
tools.who: Cluster leads and informal maker groups buying common inputs.
tools.solution: Open a group-buy, let members pledge quantities, hit the wholesale threshold, then split cost and coordinate pickup/delivery with a transparent per-member share.
tools.regulation: GST input-credit handling on pooled invoices (IN); BIR official-receipt handling (PH).

tools.title: Handicraft GST Invoice & E-Way Bill Generator
tools.problem: Craft wholesalers and exhibitors struggle with correct HSN codes (many handlooms are exempt/zero-rated, wooden and ceramic articles are not) and with e-way bills for moving stock to melas.
tools.who: GST-registered craft wholesalers, exporters, and exhibition sellers in India.
tools.solution: Generate compliant GST invoices with handicraft HSN autofill and exempt/zero-rated handling, plus e-way bills for consignment movement to exhibitions and job-work.
tools.regulation: GST Act; handicraft HSN chapters (50-63, 4420, 6913, 57); e-way bill rules; e-invoice IRN above threshold.

tools.title: Craft Consignment Settlement Tracker
tools.problem: When a crafter gets into DTI's Go Lokal! or an OTOP mall hub, products go on consignment across multiple outlets and settlement/returns reconciliation becomes a mess.
tools.who: Philippine crafters supplying Go Lokal! stores and OTOP retail hubs.
tools.solution: Track SKUs placed per outlet, record sell-through and returns, and reconcile consignment settlements and margins across outlets with statements ready for each store.
tools.regulation: DTI Go Lokal!/OTOP program terms; BIR invoicing on settled sales.

tools.title: Order-Based Working-Capital Planner
tools.problem: A big order means buying materials now and getting paid much later; artisans say yes, run out of cash mid-order, and either default or borrow at usurious rates.
tools.who: Artisans and small collectives weighing a large order.
tools.solution: Model the order's material and wage outflows against the buyer's advance and payment schedule to reveal the cash gap, the advance to negotiate, and the breakeven.
tools.regulation: Buyer advance/milestone terms; informs any MUDRA/microfinance ask (IN) or microfinance (PH).

tools.title: Homestay Registration Compliance Wizard
tools.problem: First-time homestay and small-hotel owners don't know the registration stack (Udyam, the GST threshold decision, state homestay/B&B registration, trade and fire licences) and every state differs.
tools.who: New and informal homestay and small-hotel operators.
tools.solution: State-aware wizard that outputs a personalised checklist, pre-fills application forms, computes fees, and generates the self-certifications and declarations each scheme needs.
tools.regulation: Udyam (MSME), GST registration threshold, state homestay/B&B policies, NIDHI (Ministry of Tourism)

tools.title: DOT Accreditation Readiness Scorecard
tools.problem: DOT accreditation and star rating gate listing and program access, but the documentary and facility criteria are opaque and consultants charge heavily to interpret them.
tools.who: Homestays, small hotels, resorts and tour operators seeking DOT accreditation.
tools.solution: Self-assessment against the official accommodation and tour-operator criteria that scores readiness, lists missing documents, and assembles an application-prep pack.
tools.regulation: DOT accreditation (Tourism Act of 2009, RA 9593)

tools.title: Event Permit & NOC Tracker
tools.problem: Large weddings and events need a stack of permits (fire NOC, police permission, loudspeaker permit, temporary liquor licence, structural safety) and a single missing one can shut the event down on the day.
tools.who: Event managers, banquet venues and wedding planners.
tools.solution: Per-city permit checklist with application links, document requirements, lead-time deadlines and a status board per event.
tools.regulation: Fire NOC, police/loudspeaker permissions, temporary liquor licence, municipal rules

tools.title: Mayor's-Permit Renewal Autopilot
tools.problem: PH business-permit renewal is an annual January scramble across barangay clearance, mayor's permit, BIR, fire safety and sanitary permits, with steep penalties for late filing.
tools.who: Tourism MSMEs: homestays, small hotels, caterers, tour operators.
tools.solution: Renewal tracker tailored to tourism establishments with the per-LGU document set, fee estimates, deadline reminders and a document vault.
tools.regulation: Local Government Code, LGU permits, BIR annual registration, BFP fire safety, sanitary permit, EODB Act

tools.title: Offline-First Room Booking Board
tools.problem: Rural homestays and small hotels run on a paper diary and a WhatsApp group, double-book rooms, and can't rely on connectivity for a cloud PMS.
tools.who: Homestays and small hotels (3-15 rooms) in low-connectivity areas.
tools.solution: Offline-first booking calendar that prevents double-booking locally, syncs when a connection returns, and generates a WhatsApp-shareable quote and availability.
tools.regulation: DPDP Act (IN) / Data Privacy Act (PH) for guest data

tools.title: Banquet Date-Hold Manager
tools.problem: Wedding and event venues field date enquiries across phone and WhatsApp, hold dates indefinitely, and double-book or lose dates to stale tentative holds.
tools.who: Banquet halls, resorts and event venues.
tools.solution: Date-slot calendar with auto-expiring tentative holds, deposit tracking to confirm, and a public availability view for enquirers.

tools.title: Catering Portion & Production Planner
tools.problem: Caterers over- or under-cook because portion-per-head norms live in one chef's head, causing waste or embarrassing shortfalls.
tools.who: Caterers, event kitchens and large homestay kitchens.
tools.solution: Enter headcount, meal type (buffet vs plated) and menu; it computes quantities to cook and a consolidated shopping list using regional portion norms.

tools.title: Venue Music-Licence Navigator (IPRS/PPL/Novex)
tools.problem: Hotels, banquet halls and event organisers playing recorded or live music need separate licences (IPRS for composition, PPL/Novex for recordings) and get legal notices without them, yet nobody understands which society to pay.
tools.who: Banquet halls, resorts, restaurants and event organisers.
tools.solution: Answer a few questions about venue type and event; it names which licences apply, estimates the tariff, and drafts the application letters.
tools.regulation: Copyright Act 1957; IPRS, PPL, Novex tariffs

tools.title: FDA-PH Food LTO Readiness Helper
tools.problem: PH food businesses need an FDA License to Operate (plus product CPRs and a sanitary permit), but the process is opaque for micro food and catering ventures.
tools.who: Caterers, food-tourism vendors and small food manufacturers.
tools.solution: Guided checklist that identifies whether you need an LTO and/or CPR, lists documentary requirements, and assembles an application-prep pack.
tools.regulation: FDA-PH (RA 9711) LTO and CPR; LGU sanitary permit

tools.title: Festival-Aware Rate Suggester
tools.problem: Small properties use flat year-round rates and under-price during local festivals, melas and fiestas they don't track centrally.
tools.who: Homestays and small hotels in festival and pilgrimage destinations.
tools.solution: Overlays a regional festival/fiesta and long-weekend calendar on your base rate and suggests date-specific adjustments and minimum stays.

tools.title: Festival & Season Indent Planner
tools.problem: Festival buying is done from memory and distributor pressure, so owners either run out of hero SKUs mid-festival or sit on dead stock for months after.
tools.who: Grocers and provision stores that stock up for demand spikes — Diwali/Onam/Raksha Bandhan/Ramadan (IN) and Christmas/fiesta/Undas (PH).
tools.solution: From last year's sales around the same festival plus a growth and budget input, it sizes a festival indent SKU by SKU, caps it to the cash available, and separates safe repeat-sellers from risky one-offs.

tools.title: Mobile & Electronics IMEI / Serial + Warranty Register
tools.problem: IMEI/serials are copied by hand into notebooks, so warranty lookups, duplicate/clone detection and 'which piece did I sell this customer' take ages and disputes go unresolved.
tools.who: Mobile-phone and small electronics retailers who buy and sell handsets, accessories and appliances by IMEI/serial.
tools.solution: Scan the IMEI/serial in at purchase and out at sale, linked to supplier, customer and invoice; the register gives instant warranty-period lookup, flags duplicate or blacklisted IMEIs, and surfaces aged unsold serials.
tools.regulation: DoT IMEI / CEIR registration (IN)

tools.title: Apparel & Footwear Size-Matrix Stock Book
tools.problem: Stock is tracked as a lump per style, so owners discover broken size-sets only when a customer wants the missing size, and then reorder the wrong sizes.
tools.who: Garment, footwear and innerwear retailers who stock each style in a size by colour grid.
tools.solution: Hold every style as a size by colour matrix; sales deplete the exact cell, the book shows which size runs are broken, suggests size-wise reorder quantities, and ages slow colours/sizes for markdown.

tools.title: Hardware & Building-Material Counter Biller
tools.problem: A single bill mixes pieces, metres of wire/pipe, kilos of nails and cut-to-size charges; generic POS forces everything into 'units', so staff bill on paper and margins blur.
tools.who: Hardware, sanitaryware, electrical and building-material shops that sell by piece, length, weight and cut-to-size.
tools.solution: SKUs carry their own unit (piece/metre/kg/bundle) with slab and bundle rates; the counter screen bills mixed-unit lines fast, handles cut/offcut and returns, and keeps a huge SKU list searchable by local name.
tools.regulation: Legal Metrology weights & measures (IN)

tools.title: UPI AutoPay / e-NACH Recurring-Collections Manager
tools.problem: Recurring collections fail silently: mandates expire, get revoked, or debits bounce, and owners only notice when cash is short. Tracking which mandate covers which customer, and retrying failures, is manual.
tools.who: MSMEs with recurring revenue (AMC, subscriptions, EMI, tuition, rent, SaaS) collecting via UPI AutoPay/e-NACH (IN) or GCash/Maya AutoPay (PH)
tools.solution: A mandate register recording each customer's e-mandate/AutoPay (amount cap, frequency, validity, reference), a debit calendar, reconciliation of successful vs failed/returned debits against expected dues, and a retry plus re-mandate dunning ladder that issues a fresh pay-link on failure.
tools.regulation: NPCI UPI AutoPay; RBI e-Mandate framework (IN); BSP e-money/AutoPay rules (PH)

tools.title: Blood Bank Register: Donor, TTI, Cross-Match & e-RaktKosh
tools.problem: Blood banks must keep statutory registers for donor screening, mandatory TTI testing (HIV/HBV/HCV/syphilis/malaria), grouping, cross-matching, component separation, issue and bag expiry, all paper-bound, error-prone and painful to report into e-RaktKosh and at Drugs-Control inspection.
tools.who: Standalone, charitable and small hospital-attached blood banks/centres
tools.solution: An end-to-end register: donor registration and deferral, TTI capture with auto-quarantine of reactive units, grouping and cross-match log, component separation yield, FEFO issue against requisitions, and bag-level expiry alerts (whole blood 35/42 days, platelets 5), with exports aligned to e-RaktKosh fields and inspector register formats.
tools.regulation: Drugs & Cosmetics Act (blood bank licensing, mandatory TTI, records); e-RaktKosh reporting

tools.title: Dialysis Session & Dialyzer-Reuse Log
tools.problem: Dialysis centers must record every session's clinical parameters, strictly limit and document dialyzer reuse counts for patient safety, manage consumables, and bill fixed scheme rates per session, today a mix of registers and whiteboards where a reuse-count error is a real safety and audit risk.
tools.who: Standalone and scheme-funded (PMNDP/PM-JAY) hemodialysis centers
tools.solution: A per-patient session log (pre/post weight, UF goal, BP, heparin, dialyzer, Kt/V), a dialyzer reuse tracker that counts and hard-stops at the reuse limit per patient-labelled dialyzer, consumables draw-down, and session billing against PM-JAY/PMNDP rates with a monthly scheme claim summary.
tools.regulation: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme / PM-JAY dialysis package (session records, rates)

tools.title: Clinical Establishments Act Registration & Display Kit
tools.problem: Clinics must register under the Clinical Establishments Act (or state Nursing Home Act), meet minimum-standard and documentation requirements, display their registration, rate list and citizen's charter, and renew on time, yet owners don't know what their state requires or what must be on the wall.
tools.who: Small clinics, polyclinics and nursing homes in CEA / state Nursing-Home-Act states
tools.solution: A state-aware readiness wizard listing the exact registration documents, minimum standards and fees for the establishment type, a renewal-reminder tracker, and a generator for the mandatory display boards (registration number, rate list, grievance/citizen's charter) formatted to hang at reception.
tools.regulation: Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulation) Act 2010 and state Nursing Home Acts

tools.title: DOH License-to-Operate Readiness Self-Assessment
tools.problem: A DOH License to Operate hinges on meeting technical requirements, floor area and layout, required equipment, qualified personnel, two-way referral, biosafety, and applicants discover gaps only when the licensing inspector arrives, delaying opening and revenue.
tools.who: Primary-care clinics, clinical laboratories and ambulatory facilities applying for or renewing a DOH LTO
tools.solution: A requirement-by-requirement self-assessment for the facility type (clinical lab primary/secondary/tertiary, primary-care clinic) that scores readiness, lists the exact personnel, equipment and document gaps, holds evidence (PRC licences, calibration, floor plan) in a vault, and produces the compliance checklist to walk the DOH assessor through.
tools.regulation: DOH Licensing (AO on Clinical Laboratories; One-Stop-Shop LTO technical requirements)

tools.title: Tool Crib & Cutting-Tool Regrind Tracker
tools.problem: Tools walk off, nobody knows who has what, regrind life is untracked, and the crib over-orders to be safe; tooling is often the second-biggest cost after material.
tools.who: CNC shops bleeding money on lost, hoarded and over-ordered cutting tools and inserts
tools.solution: Issue/return tools to operators, min-stock reorder alerts, regrind cycle logging per tool, and cost-per-cutting-edge analytics.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Operator Skill Matrix & Cert-Expiry Tracker
tools.problem: A wall-chart skill matrix is always stale, and welder/machinist certifications (TESDA NC II in PH, apprentice/NAPS records in IN) expire silently.
tools.who: Shops needing to prove, to auditors and customers, who is qualified to run which machine/process
tools.solution: A grid of operators x machines/processes with skill level and certification expiry dates, with alerts before a certification lapses.
tools.regulation: TESDA NC II (PH), NAPS/apprenticeship records (IN), ISO 9001 competence

tools.title: Die & Mould Shot-Count Tracker
tools.problem: Dies and moulds are capital assets with a finite life, but shot counts, maintenance at thresholds, storage location and cost-per-shot are untracked, so tools fail unexpectedly or get lost.
tools.who: Injection-moulding, die-casting and press shops running expensive tooling
tools.solution: Register each die/mould, log shot counts per run, trigger PM at shot thresholds, record storage location, and amortise cost per shot.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Plating/Anodizing Process & Effluent Log
tools.problem: Bath chemistry, temperature, current and effluent readings per batch must be recorded for quality and environmental audits, and pollution-board consents must be renewed on time; paper logs don't timestamp or alert.
tools.who: Electroplating, anodizing and surface-treatment job units under pollution-control oversight
tools.solution: Log bath parameters and process conditions per batch, record ETP/effluent readings, and keep a consent-document shelf with renewal alerts.
tools.regulation: CPCB/SPCB consent to operate (IN), DENR/ENRO permits (PH)

tools.title: Outsourced-Operation (Subcontract) Tracker
tools.problem: Once an operation is sent out, the parts fall into a black hole: nobody tracks the due-back date, the cost, or the quality on return, and jobs stall.
tools.who: Shops that send out operations like heat-treatment, plating or grinding to other shops
tools.solution: Record each outbound operation with vendor, quantity, due-back date and agreed cost; age overdue returns; capture quality on receipt; and (in India) link it to the job-work challan.
tools.regulation: CGST job-work challan (IN) when applicable

tools.title: RFQ Inbox & Quote Hit-Rate Tracker
tools.problem: RFQs come in through many channels, get lost, and the shop has no record of what it quoted or its win/loss rate, so pricing never improves.
tools.who: Job shops whose enquiries arrive scattered across WhatsApp, email and phone
tools.solution: A single link customers use to submit an RFQ (drawing + quantity); the shop quotes using its costing engine and the system tracks every quote's outcome and hit-rate by customer and price band.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Weighbridge Capture & Party-Ledger Slip
tools.problem: Weighbridge gross/tare/net is recorded on paper slips, and reconciling weights to parties, vehicles and jobs is a manual nightmare.
tools.who: Foundries, forge shops and scrap-handling units billing by weighbridge weight
tools.solution: Capture gross-tare-net per vehicle, link to party and job, print a weight slip, and keep a party-wise weight ledger with daily reconciliation.
tools.regulation: Legal Metrology (IN) weighbridge, local weights-and-measures (PH)

tools.title: Phone Time-Study & Line-Balancer
tools.problem: Time studies are done with a paper form and a stopwatch, then nobody computes the takt, bottleneck or line balance, so improvement stalls.
tools.who: Supervisors and IE staff improving cycle time and balancing manual/assembly lines
tools.solution: A phone app to capture element times across cycles, compute average cycle time, takt vs demand, the bottleneck station, and a line-balance chart; studies are saved.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Speeds, Feeds & Tap-Drill Calculator
tools.problem: Speeds and feeds are picked from dog-eared charts or guesswork, causing tool breakage, poor finish and lost time.
tools.who: CNC and conventional machinists setting cutting parameters
tools.solution: Enter material and tool to get recommended surface speed, RPM, feed/chip load, plus tap-drill sizes and SFM-RPM conversions, all offline.
tools.regulation: None

tools.title: Piece-Rate & Overtime Shop Payroll
tools.problem: Generic payroll can't handle piece-rate plus overtime plus shop-specific allowances, so wages are computed by hand with statutory deductions bolted on inconsistently.
tools.who: Job shops paying a mix of piece-rate, daily-wage and overtime labour
tools.solution: Capture attendance and piece-rate/overtime output, compute wages with the right statutory deductions, and issue payslips.
tools.regulation: EPF & ESI (IN); SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG (PH)

tools.title: ONDC Handloom Seller Onboarding Kit
tools.problem: ONDC can put a weaver in front of the whole country, but its catalog schema, HSN and fulfilment fields are daunting for a cluster with no tech team.
tools.who: Weaver cooperatives, FPOs, small D2C handloom brands.
tools.solution: A guided catalog builder that outputs ONDC-compliant product data (attributes, HSN, GST, serviceability) and validates it before the seller app ingests it.
tools.regulation: ONDC network policy, GST/HSN, GI/Handloom Mark attributes

tools.title: Pina & Abaca Fiber Traceability
tools.problem: Tropical-fabric buyers and government uniform programs need provenance for pina, jusi and abaca, but fiber passes through farmers, strippers and weavers with no record.
tools.who: Pina/abaca weaving communities, PhilFIDA-linked cooperatives, tropical-fabric suppliers.
tools.solution: Record each hop (fiber source, stripping, knotting, weaving) into a traceable batch that produces a provenance sheet for buyers and tenders.
tools.regulation: RA 9242 Tropical Fabrics Law, PhilFIDA, DTI

tools.title: BMBE & DTI Registration Helper
tools.problem: Micro garment and weaving entrepreneurs miss the BMBE income-tax exemption and stall on DTI business-name steps because the requirements are opaque.
tools.who: Micro dressmakers, home weavers, OTOP sellers.
tools.solution: A guided checklist and document-pack builder for DTI business-name registration and BMBE application, with the forms and requirements per step.
tools.regulation: BMBE Act (RA 9178), DTI business name, BIR registration, Negosyo Center

tools.title: Weaver Cooperative Member Ledger & Payout
tools.problem: A handloom cooperative juggles member share capital, yarn distribution, cloth collection and payouts across hundreds of weavers on registers that never reconcile.
tools.who: Primary handloom weaver cooperative societies and apex societies.
tools.solution: Member master with share capital, yarn issued, cloth collected and graded, payout computation, advances and dividend, with per-member passbooks.
tools.regulation: Cooperative Societies Act audit, NHDP/NHDC yarn supply, GST

tools.title: Weaver Income & Scheme-Eligibility Estimator
tools.problem: Weavers miss credit and welfare benefits they qualify for because the schemes, limits and eligibility are scattered and jargon-heavy.
tools.who: Handloom weavers, cooperatives, cluster facilitators.
tools.solution: Estimate annual income from piece-rate/output, then check eligibility and benefits across Weaver MUDRA, NHDP, Pehchan card, e-Shram and weaver welfare/insurance.
tools.regulation: Weaver MUDRA, NHDP, Pehchan ID, e-Shram, Handloom Weavers' Welfare

tools.title: Fabric Meterage Reconciliation
tools.problem: Fabric received, cut and turned into garments rarely reconciles; silent shrinkage and pilferage leak margin no one can pin down.
tools.who: Garment units, cutting masters, production managers.
tools.solution: Record fabric received per lot, cut consumption per order and garments produced, then flag the balance and shrinkage against expected consumption.
tools.regulation: GST stock records, Udyam

tools.title: Garment Size-Set Grading Calculator
tools.problem: Small units grade size sets by hand from a base size and make arithmetic errors that ruin whole cut lots.
tools.who: Pattern makers, tailoring units, dress designers.
tools.solution: Enter base-size measurements and grade rules to get a full graded measurement chart across the size set (S-XXL or numeric), ready to print.
tools.regulation: None (tool)

tools.title: Block-Print Inventory & Repeat Planner
tools.problem: Hand block and screen printers juggle hundreds of blocks/screens and must plan repeats and colour separations, but blocks go missing and repeats misalign.
tools.who: Bagru/Sanganeri block printers, screen-printing units, textile designers.
tools.solution: Catalog blocks/screens with location, plan a design's repeat and colour sequence, and log meters printed per design and colourway.
tools.regulation: GI (Sanganeri/Bagru), GST, OEKO-TEX on inks

tools.title: Saree & Lehenga Rental Manager
tools.problem: Outfit-rental boutiques track bookings in a diary, causing double-bookings, lost deposits, missed returns and no view of which piece is free when.
tools.who: Saree/lehenga/gown/barong rental boutiques and costume rentals.
tools.solution: Manage rental inventory with a booking calendar, security deposits, return-condition and cleaning cycle, and availability per piece per date.
tools.regulation: GST/BIR on rental income, e-wallet deposits (GCash/Maya/UPI)

tools.title: Kitchen Waste Logger
tools.problem: Food waste is 5-15% of food cost but invisible; owners can't see spoilage vs overproduction vs plate waste, so they can't fix it.
tools.who: Cafes, cloud kitchens, canteens and caterers.
tools.solution: A ten-second phone log of wastage (item, qty, reason), costed against recipe prices, with weekly trends and the single biggest leak highlighted.
tools.regulation: Optional link to FSSAI 'Save Food' / surplus-donation pathways.

tools.title: EPR Plastic-Packaging Compliance Tracker
tools.problem: Packaged-food brands are 'producers/brand-owners' under India's Plastic Waste EPR and must register on the CPCB portal, file plastic-use returns and buy EPR credits, yet most small FMCG units don't know they're liable.
tools.who: Packaged-food MSMEs using plastic pouches, bottles or labels.
tools.solution: A liability checker plus a plastic-footprint calculator (categories I-IV) that computes annual EPR targets, tracks credit purchases, and prepares the CPCB return with filing reminders.
tools.regulation: Plastic Waste Management Rules EPR; CPCB EPR portal.

tools.title: Register Me — MSME Registration & Scheme-Eligibility Wizard
tools.problem: Micro owners pay touts for what are free government business registrations because the portals are intimidating.
tools.who: Unregistered kirana/sari-sari owners wanting formal status for loans and B2B.
tools.solution: A guided walkthrough that collects the exact fields and documents for Udyam MSME (IN) or DTI business-name (PH) and hands off to the official portal.
tools.regulation: Udyam Registration (MSME Act, IN); DTI Business Name Registration System (PH).

tools.title: Combo Builder — Dead Stock Rescue
tools.problem: Slow-moving stock ties up cash and eventually expires, while owners have no systematic way to move it.
tools.who: Grocers with ageing or seasonal overstock sitting on the shelf.
tools.solution: From an exported sales log it flags dead/slow SKUs and proposes combo packs pairing them with fast movers, with a blended price and the resulting margin.
tools.regulation: MRP/SRP ceilings must hold on the combo price.

tools.title: Suki Punch — Phone-Number Loyalty
tools.problem: Paper punch cards get lost and QR loyalty schemes assume the customer installs an app, which neighbourhood regulars won't.
tools.who: Shops with a core of loyal suki/regular customers worth rewarding.
tools.solution: The owner taps a phone number at checkout; the customer accrues points and gets a free-nth-purchase reward, nudged by a WhatsApp/SMS message — no customer app.
tools.regulation: SMS DLT templates (IN); WhatsApp BSP; consent for marketing messages (DPDP / Data Privacy Act).

tools.title: Tindahan Storefront
tools.problem: Every shop 'sells on WhatsApp' but orders arrive as unstructured chat that's slow to fulfil and easy to get wrong.
tools.who: Neighbourhood shops taking orders from local customers for pickup/home delivery.
tools.solution: A one-page mobile storefront the owner shares on WhatsApp/Messenger status; customers browse and build an order that comes back as a structured, priced pick-list.
tools.regulation: WhatsApp BSP for order confirmation; FSSAI/FDA food-handling if delivering food.

tools.title: Offer Poster Maker
tools.problem: Shops announce offers with ugly text messages because Canva is English, fiddly, and overkill for a weekly deal.
tools.who: Owners who post weekly offers on WhatsApp/Messenger status.
tools.solution: Pick a few items and prices, choose a festival/seasonal template, and get a clean vernacular offer image (Hindi/Tamil/Tagalog/Cebuano) in three taps.
tools.regulation: MRP/SRP truthful-pricing and no misleading-discount norms.

tools.title: Shelf Label Printer
tools.problem: Handwritten price tags look unprofessional and risk fines for missing MRP or per-unit price display.
tools.who: Grocers wanting tidy, compliant shelf tags without a POS system.
tools.solution: Generate compliant shelf labels showing MRP, your selling price, per-100g/ml unit price and a barcode, printable on thermal or A4 sheets.
tools.regulation: Legal Metrology unit-price and MRP display (IN); DTI price-tag law RA 7394 and SRP (PH).

tools.title: Dispute Shield — Delivery Claims
tools.problem: Damaged, expired or short-supplied goods turn into he-said-she-said arguments the retailer loses to the distributor.
tools.who: Retailers receiving FMCG deliveries on a beat.
tools.solution: At delivery, log the issue with a timestamped photo and batch detail; the app generates a claim the distributor can't brush off.
tools.regulation: Consumer/returns norms; distributor claim-settlement terms; feeds GST credit-note process.

tools.title: Helper Khata — Staff & Advances
tools.problem: Shop helpers take salary advances ('baki') that become a black hole in the cash tally, and attendance/wages are tracked in the owner's head.
tools.who: Shops employing 1-3 assistants paid wages with frequent advances.
tools.solution: Track each helper's attendance, wage accrual and advances taken, netting advances against salary to show true amount payable.
tools.regulation: Minimum-wage and wage-record norms (Shops & Establishments IN; Labor Code PH).

tools.title: Shrink Check — Leakage Audit
tools.problem: Theft, pilferage and ledger mistakes drain margin invisibly, and a full stock-take is too heavy for a small shop to ever do.
tools.who: Owners who suspect leakage but can't afford to shut for a full count.
tools.solution: A guided 10-minute spot-count of top-value SKUs compares counted vs expected stock and flags shrinkage and credit entries that don't reconcile to cash.
tools.regulation: None material (internal controls tool).

tools.title: KCC Limit & Loan-Readiness Pack
tools.problem: Farmers under-draw Kisan Credit Card limits because neither they nor local staff compute the district scale-of-finance entitlement or assemble documents correctly.
tools.who: Farmers and FPO staff helping members get a KCC
tools.solution: Compute the KCC limit from crop, acreage and district scale of finance, and generate a documents checklist and application pack.
tools.regulation: RBI KCC guidelines, district scale of finance

tools.title: Agri E-Way Bill Exemption Checker
tools.problem: Many unprocessed agri goods are GST/e-way-bill exempt but processed or branded consignments are not; dealers and FPOs guess, risking detention or needless paperwork.
tools.who: FPOs and agri traders moving goods between districts or states
tools.solution: Answer a few questions about commodity and movement to get an exemption verdict with the HSN/notification citation, then generate the e-way bill via the NIC API when one is required.
tools.regulation: GST, e-way bill rules, HSN exemptions

tools.title: Container Stuffing & Load Planner
tools.problem: Guessing how much fits in a 20'/40'/40'HC container wastes freight by shipping air or over-commits so it won't fit or goes overweight, and full logistics software is overkill for a small exporter.
tools.who: Small exporters planning cartons and pallets into containers.
tools.solution: Enter carton dimensions, weights and order quantity; it computes the best fit across container types, pallet arrangement and weight limits, and outputs a load plan plus the shippable quantity for the packing list.
tools.regulation: ISO container sizes; SOLAS VGM / gross-weight limits.

tools.title: Export Payment-Terms & Buyer-Risk Advisor
tools.problem: SMEs accept risky payment terms, such as open account to an unknown buyer or an LC they can't comply with, and get burned on non-payment or rejected documents.
tools.who: Exporters negotiating terms with new overseas buyers.
tools.solution: Given buyer country, order value and relationship, it recommends a payment method (advance %, LC confirmed/unconfirmed, DP/DA, open account), flags country risk, and suggests safeguards (confirmation, ECGC cover, credit insurance).
tools.regulation: UCP 600 (LC); ECGC export-credit insurance (IN); FEMA advance-payment norms; BSP (PH).

tools.title: Export FX Margin & Realization Planner
tools.problem: A thin export margin quoted in USD can vanish when the rupee or peso moves, and exporters also miss the regulatory window to realize and report proceeds.
tools.who: Small exporters pricing in foreign currency.
tools.solution: Model your margin across a range of FX rates, see the breakeven rate and the gain/loss from a simple forward cover, and track the realization deadline (FEMA in India, BSP reporting in PH) per shipment.
tools.regulation: FEMA realization timeline, RBI; BSP foreign-exchange reporting (PH); forward contracts.

tools.title: Courier Export Helper (CSB-IV/V)
tools.problem: Small D2C sellers exporting by courier or post are confused by Courier Shipping Bills (CSB-IV/V), value limits and whether they still get RoDTEP, so they overpay intermediaries or misdeclare.
tools.who: D2C and e-commerce micro-exporters shipping parcels abroad.
tools.solution: Builds the CSB-IV/V data set, checks value and category limits, confirms RoDTEP eligibility for courier/postal exports, and produces the invoice and declaration the courier needs.
tools.regulation: CSB-IV/CSB-V courier shipping bill; RoDTEP on courier/postal exports; India Post / courier export.

tools.title: BL / AWB Draft Reviewer
tools.problem: On open-account shipments no bank checks your transport document, so a forwarder's typo on the draft BL/AWB (wrong consignee, description, freight term, on-board date) surfaces only when the buyer refuses the goods.
tools.who: Exporters on open-account or DP/DA terms reviewing a forwarder's draft BL/AWB.
tools.solution: Enter the draft BL/AWB; it cross-checks consignee/notify, goods description, freight term vs your Incoterm and dates against your commercial invoice, listing the corrections to send the forwarder.
tools.regulation: Bill of lading / air waybill norms; Incoterms freight terms; on-board date.

tools.title: Export Scheme & Grant Finder
tools.problem: Governments fund market access, trade fairs and freight for exporters, but discovery is terrible, so MSMEs never claim money they are entitled to.
tools.who: SME exporters seeking market-development support.
tools.solution: Matches your profile to schemes (India's Market Access Initiative, Transport & Marketing Assistance, Districts as Export Hubs; Philippines EMB programs and DTI SME support) with eligibility, benefit and how to apply.
tools.regulation: MAI, TMA, Districts as Export Hubs (IN); DTI/EMB export programs (PH).

tools.title: Dangerous Goods Declaration Helper (IMDG/IATA)
tools.problem: Exporters of chemicals, cosmetics, batteries or aerosols get shipments rejected or fined for wrong dangerous-goods classification and paperwork, and DG consultants are costly.
tools.who: Small chemical, cosmetic and electronics exporters.
tools.solution: A UN-number lookup classifies the goods, determines packing group and sea/air acceptability, and generates the shipper's declaration with the correct marks and labels.
tools.regulation: IMDG Code (sea), IATA DGR (air), UN dangerous-goods list.

tools.title: PEZA/BOI Incentive & Compliance Tracker
tools.problem: Registered export enterprises in PEZA/BOI get tax incentives under the CREATE law but must maintain export ratios and file periodic reports; a missed report or ratio risks the incentive.
tools.who: Small PEZA- and BOI-registered export enterprises in the Philippines.
tools.solution: Tracks incentive entitlements (income-tax holiday/SCIT, VAT zero-rating), monitors required export-ratio thresholds, and reminds of PEZA/BOI periodic report deadlines with a checklist.
tools.regulation: PEZA, BOI, CREATE Act incentives (ITH/SCIT/VAT zero-rating), periodic reporting.

tools.title: Halal Export Certification Organizer
tools.problem: Halal markets (GCC, Malaysia, Indonesia) are huge, but managing the certifying body, product scope, plant-audit dates and certificate expiry by hand costs exporters market access when a cert lapses.
tools.who: Food and consumables exporters targeting Muslim-majority markets.
tools.solution: Tracks halal certificate scope and validity per product and market, schedules plant-audit and renewal reminders, and assembles the halal documentation bundle buyers and customs require.
tools.regulation: India halal certification framework (APEDA / quality council); PH halal export development; destination halal standards (GSO/JAKIM/MUI).

tools.title: GST Late-Fee & Interest Calculator
tools.problem: Late GST filers can't quickly tell what they owe in late fee plus 18% interest, and often over- or under-pay.
tools.who: Small taxpayers and the accountants who file for them.
tools.solution: Choose return type and period, enter the filing date and tax payable to get the exact per-day capped late fee and interest to the paisa.
tools.regulation: CGST Act §47 (late fee) and §50 (interest).

tools.title: Two-Regime (IN+PH) Compliance Calendar for Accountants
tools.problem: Accountants in the large IN-PH outsourced-bookkeeping corridor juggle many clients across two statutory regimes with no single deadline view.
tools.who: CA firms and BPO bookkeeping teams serving IN and PH SME clients.
tools.solution: A per-client statutory calendar and status board spanning GST/TDS/ROC (IN) and BIR/SSS/LGU (PH), with document-request nudges to clients.
tools.regulation: GST/TDS/MCA (IN); BIR/SSS/PhilHealth/LGU (PH).

tools.title: Composition vs Regular GST Breakeven Tool
tools.problem: Small traders can't tell whether the low-rate composition scheme (no input credit, restrictions) beats regular GST for their mix.
tools.who: Traders/manufacturers/restaurants under the composition ceiling.
tools.solution: Enter turnover, margin, B2B share and input GST; it computes net tax and compliance load under both and shows the breakeven.
tools.regulation: CGST Act §10; composition rates (1%/5%/6%).

tools.title: e-Way Bill Generator + Validity/Extension Tracker
tools.problem: Goods movements over ₱50k need an e-way bill with a validity clock tied to distance; expiry mid-transit means detention and penalty.
tools.who: Small logistics, traders and manufacturers dispatching goods.
tools.solution: Generate e-way bills via the NIC API and track each bill's validity with timely extension reminders.
tools.regulation: CGST Rule 138; NIC e-way bill system.

tools.title: RCM Identifier + Self-Invoice/Payment-Voucher Generator
tools.problem: Reverse-charge purchases (GTA, legal, import of services, unregistered buys) require the buyer to self-invoice and pay GST — frequently missed, then disallowed.
tools.who: SMEs with freight, legal or import-of-service spend.
tools.solution: Flag which purchase categories attract RCM and generate the compliant self-invoice and payment voucher with the tax computed.
tools.regulation: CGST Act §9(3)/9(4); §31(3)(f) self-invoice.

tools.title: e-Invoice IRN + QR Generator (NIC IRP)
tools.problem: Businesses crossing the ₱5cr e-invoicing threshold must register every B2B invoice with the IRP for an IRN + signed QR before it's valid.
tools.who: Growing SMEs newly in the e-invoice net without an ERP that does it.
tools.solution: A simple invoice form that calls the NIC IRP (sandbox then prod) to mint the IRN and QR and returns a compliant e-invoice PDF.
tools.regulation: CGST e-invoicing mandate (₱5cr); NIC IRP/IRN/QR.

tools.title: BIR Open-Case / Stop-Filer Self-Audit
tools.problem: MSMEs accumulate 'open cases' for returns they didn't know they had to file, surfacing only at closure or audit with penalties.
tools.who: Sole props and small corporations unsure of their filing obligations.
tools.solution: From your registration date and tax types, derive every return you should have filed to date and list the likely gaps to clear.
tools.regulation: BIR registration-based filing obligations; open-case/stop-filer system.

tools.title: DTI Business-Name Registration Readiness
tools.problem: First-time sole props stumble on DTI business-name rules, territorial scope and fees before they even start.
tools.who: New Filipino sole-proprietor entrepreneurs.
tools.solution: Validate a proposed name against DTI rules, pick the right territorial scope, estimate the fee, and produce a go/no-go checklist.
tools.regulation: DTI Business Name Registration System; name rules; territorial scope.

tools.title: Local Business Tax (LBT) Estimator by City (PH)
tools.problem: The LGU local business tax is a graduated, gross-receipts-based charge that varies by city and line of business, hard to anticipate at renewal.
tools.who: MSMEs budgeting for permit renewal across one or more LGUs.
tools.solution: Pick the city and business type and enter prior-year gross to get an estimated LBT plus the usual regulatory fees.
tools.regulation: Local Government Code 1991 (local business tax); city revenue ordinances.

tools.title: TReDS Eligibility & Upload-Pack Builder
tools.problem: MSMEs that could discount receivables on TReDS (RXIL/M1xchange/Invoicemart) don't know which buyer invoices qualify or how to prepare the data for onboarding.
tools.who: MSME suppliers to large and PSU buyers
tools.solution: A checker: enter buyer type + invoice details to get an eligibility verdict (is the buyer onboarded, is the invoice acceptance-ready), plus a structured upload pack and an estimated cost of discounting.
tools.regulation: RBI TReDS framework; mandatory TReDS for buyers >Rs.250cr turnover; MSMED Act

tools.title: GST Payment Cash-Reserve Calendar
tools.problem: MSMEs get blindsided by bunched GST, TDS and advance-tax outflows because deadlines are known but the amounts are not planned for.
tools.who: GST-registered MSMEs
tools.solution: Enter a turnover pattern + filing frequency to get a calendar of GSTR-3B, GSTR-1, TDS and advance-tax due dates with estimated amounts and a 'set aside this much' running tracker.
tools.regulation: GST return calendar; TDS; advance tax

tools.title: DTI/SEC + BIR Formalization Checker
tools.problem: PH micro-entrepreneurs who want to formalize (the gate to formal credit) don't know the DTI-vs-SEC + BIR + barangay/mayor's-permit sequence.
tools.who: Informal PH sellers going legit to access credit
tools.solution: A wizard: business type + location returns the exact registration sequence, required documents, fees, timelines and which steps must precede the BIR TIN and books of account.
tools.regulation: DTI (sole prop); SEC (corp/partnership); BIR; LGU/barangay permits

tools.title: Field Collections Agent App
tools.problem: MSME lenders and distributors send agents to collect cash and digital payments in the field with no live tracking and manual end-of-day reconciliation.
tools.who: Microfinance field officers and distributor collection agents
tools.solution: A mobile app showing assigned accounts, recording cash/UPI/GCash collection with a geotag and a digital receipt, syncing offline-first, and reconciling against assigned dues each day.
tools.regulation: RBI microfinance norms (IN); BSP (PH); data privacy

tools.title: Export Invoice LUT & FX Realization Tracker
tools.problem: MSME exporters juggle the GST LUT (for zero-rated exports), FIRCs and FX realization timelines with no single view, risking lapsed LUTs and overdue realization.
tools.who: Small exporters and freelancers billing foreign clients
tools.solution: Track each export invoice against LUT validity, expected FX inflow and the FEMA realization deadline, convert at logged rates, and flag unrealized or overdue receipts.
tools.regulation: GST LUT (zero-rated exports); FEMA export realization; RBI

tools.title: Payables Triage (Pay-This-Week)
tools.problem: When cash is tight, MSMEs pay whoever shouts loudest rather than optimally, triggering avoidable penalties and lost discounts.
tools.who: Owner-operators in a cash crunch
tools.solution: List payables with due dates, early-pay discounts, late penalties and supplier criticality; it returns a ranked 'pay this week' list that minimizes penalty while preserving key suppliers.
tools.regulation: None specific

tools.title: Legal Notice & Demand Letter Studio
tools.problem: Small firms re-type the same statutory notices (S.138, Consumer Protection, eviction, recovery) from old Word files and risk stale section numbers and wrong citations.
tools.who: Solo advocates and legal-process outsourcers
tools.solution: A generator with vetted, statute-correct templates that merges party details and outputs a clean notice plus a printable RPAD dispatch register.
tools.regulation: NI Act, Consumer Protection Act 2019, BNSS

tools.title: Client Creative Proofing & Approval (WhatsApp-native)
tools.problem: Agencies collect creative feedback across WhatsApp, email and screenshots, losing versions and approvals.
tools.who: Digital agencies, freelance designers and video editors
tools.solution: Share each asset on a link, collect pinned comments and a recorded approval, version everything, and notify via WhatsApp.

tools.title: Proposal & SOW Builder with E-Sign Acceptance
tools.problem: Consultants send proposals as emailed PDFs with no structured acceptance, then argue scope later.
tools.who: Freelancers, agencies and IT/consulting MSMEs
tools.solution: Build a proposal/SOW from reusable blocks and a rate card, send a tracked link, and capture a timestamped e-signed acceptance.

tools.title: Client KYC/AML for Professionals (PMLA)
tools.problem: CAs, CS and CMAs are now reporting entities under PMLA for specified client transactions and must do client due-diligence and record-keeping they have never done.
tools.who: Practising CA/CS/CMA firms
tools.solution: A client-onboarding workflow capturing identity, beneficial owner, a PEP screen and risk rating, with the record retention the rules require.
tools.regulation: PMLA 2002 (2023 notification covering professionals)

tools.title: Gratuity & Full-and-Final Settlement Calculator
tools.problem: Computing gratuity, notice pay and leave encashment at exit is error-prone and disputes land in labour court.
tools.who: HR consultants and small-firm admins
tools.solution: An F&F calculator handling gratuity eligibility (5-year rule) and the statutory cap, notice recovery and leave encashment, with a signed settlement sheet.
tools.regulation: Payment of Gratuity Act 1972

tools.title: Contract-Labour (CLRA) Register & Muster
tools.problem: Firms engaging contract labour must keep muster rolls, wage registers and CLRA returns, and the principal employer is liable for the contractor's lapses.
tools.who: Small manufacturers, facility/security contractors and their principals
tools.solution: Digital muster roll, wage register and the statutory CLRA register formats with return reminders.
tools.regulation: Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act 1970

tools.title: DPDP Consent & Processor-Agreement Kit
tools.problem: Under the DPDP Act, agencies handling a client's customer data are processors needing data-processing agreements, consent capture and breach procedures they have never built.
tools.who: Digital and performance-marketing agencies
tools.solution: Generate the client-agency DPA, a consent-collection snippet and record, a data inventory, and a breach-response runbook.
tools.regulation: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023

tools.title: Influencer Contract + ASCI Disclosure Pack
tools.problem: Influencer collaborations run on DMs with no contract, and ASCI mandates clear #ad disclosure that brands and agencies routinely violate.
tools.who: Agencies, brand managers and creators
tools.solution: Generate the influencer agreement (deliverables, usage rights, exclusivity, payment) plus platform-correct disclosure labels and a compliance checklist.
tools.regulation: ASCI Influencer Advertising Guidelines, Consumer Protection Act

tools.title: Multi-Marketplace Listing Exporter
tools.problem: Makers want to be on Amazon Karigar, Flipkart Samarth, Etsy, and DTI's retail channels at once, but each wants a different CSV and relisting everything by hand is brutal.
tools.who: Crafters selling across several marketplaces simultaneously.
tools.solution: Maintain one canonical product list and export channel-correct CSV/feed files per marketplace, with per-channel field mapping and price/margin rules.
tools.regulation: Each marketplace's listing schema; GST/HSN and PH BIR fields carried through.

tools.title: e-Prescription QR Handoff
tools.problem: Handwritten prescriptions are misread at the pharmacy counter, causing dispensing errors, and patients routinely lose the paper slip.
tools.who: Single-doctor clinics and the pharmacies their patients visit
tools.solution: Doctor fills a structured prescription and generates a signed QR + PDF; the pharmacy scans the QR to see exact drug, dose and quantity, then marks it dispensed.
tools.regulation: Telemedicine Practice Guidelines 2020 (IN); DOH e-prescribing norms (PH)

tools.title: Patient Recall & Follow-up Scheduler
tools.problem: Solo clinics lose chronic and follow-up patients because nobody reminds them of the next visit, immunization or test.
tools.who: GP and pediatric single-doctor clinics
tools.solution: Tag each patient with a recall date and reason, auto-send SMS/WhatsApp reminders on that date, and surface a missed-recall worklist.
tools.regulation: DPDP consent (IN); Data Privacy Act RA 10173 (PH)

tools.title: Generic Substitution & Interaction Checker
tools.problem: Solo doctors and pharmacists cannot quickly check drug interactions or offer a cheaper Jan Aushadhi generic equivalent at the point of care.
tools.who: Clinics and pharmacies
tools.solution: Enter two or more drugs to get interaction warnings, or enter a brand to see the molecule, its Jan Aushadhi generic, and the rupee price delta.
tools.regulation: Jan Aushadhi / generic-prescribing policy

tools.title: Drug Recall & NSQ Alert Subscriber
tools.problem: Pharmacies miss CDSCO not-of-standard-quality (NSQ) notices and FDA-PH recall advisories and keep selling recalled batches.
tools.who: Pharmacies and diagnostic labs
tools.solution: Subscribe by the molecules and brands you actually stock, then get notified when a CDSCO NSQ list or FDA-PH recall names them, and mark affected stock quarantined.
tools.regulation: CDSCO NSQ / recall alerts (IN); FDA-PH recall advisories (PH)

tools.title: Coaching Ad-Claim & Refund Compliance Checker
tools.problem: Coaching centres routinely publish '100% selection' and inflated rank claims with vague refund terms that now violate the CCPA 2024 coaching-advertising guidelines, inviting notices and fines.
tools.who: Owners and marketing staff of test-prep and tuition coaching centres.
tools.solution: A client-side checker that lints ad copy, banners and success-rate claims against the prohibited-claim ruleset and generates compliant disclaimers, denominator disclosures, and refund-policy plus enrollment-contract templates.
tools.regulation: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisement in Coaching Sector 2024; Consumer Protection Act 2019.

tools.title: Doubt-Ticketing & Searchable Doubt Bank
tools.problem: Student doubts drown in chaotic WhatsApp groups where answers are lost, faculty are pinged at midnight, and the same question is re-answered endlessly.
tools.who: Coaching and test-prep centres and their subject faculty.
tools.solution: Students photograph a doubt; it is routed to the right subject teacher, answered with annotation, and archived into a searchable per-topic doubt bank that serves instant answers to repeats.

tools.title: White-Label Rank/College Predictor Lead Magnet
tools.problem: Centres spend on ads but have no sticky lead magnet; students crave 'what rank or college will my score get me?' and go to big portals that capture the lead.
tools.who: Coaching centres marketing JEE/NEET/CET preparation.
tools.solution: A branded static predictor that maps a student's score or percentile to likely rank and college options using public cutoff data, capturing the lead for the centre.

tools.title: WorksGST — Works-Contract GST/SAC & RCM Finder
tools.problem: Construction SAC codes, 18/12/5/1% rates, ITC eligibility and reverse-charge on works contracts confuse small contractors, who then mis-invoice and lose input credit.
tools.who: civil contractors, sub-contractors
tools.solution: Static decision tree: pick work type (govt / affordable housing / commercial / repair / sub-contract), returns the SAC code, GST rate, ITC eligibility, RCM flag and a plain-language note.
tools.regulation: GST SAC 9954 works-contract notifications + reverse charge

tools.title: DeductTrack — 194C Contractor-TDS Tracker
tools.problem: Builders paying contractors must deduct TDS (1/2%), track the ₹30k single / ₹1L annual thresholds, deposit on time and issue Form 16A; misses trigger notices.
tools.who: builders, developers, main contractors
tools.solution: Go app: log each contractor bill, compute 194C TDS, raise threshold alerts, track challans, and generate Form 16A plus a 26Q filing helper.
tools.regulation: TDS Section 194C, Form 16A, 26Q

tools.title: DSRbuild — BOQ on Schedule-of-Rates Library
tools.problem: Preparing a BOQ from CPWD DSR or a state PWD Schedule of Rates is tedious, with heavy copy-paste rate lookups and manual rate analysis.
tools.who: estimators, small contractors
tools.solution: Java transactional app: searchable DSR/SOR item library, assemble a BOQ with quantities and auto-rates, apply cost-index factor and GST, and export abstract + rate analysis.
tools.regulation: CPWD DSR / state PWD SOR; GST

tools.title: RERAfile — Compliance & Disclosure Helper
tools.problem: Small developers struggle with RERA registration, quarterly progress/financial disclosures and the 70% escrow rule; lapses risk penalties and deregistration.
tools.who: small developers and promoters
tools.solution: Go app: a registration document checklist, a quarterly update builder (units sold, construction %, fund usage), an escrow tracker and deadline alerts.
tools.regulation: RERA Act 2016, 70% escrow rule, quarterly disclosures

tools.title: No-Show Deposit & Policy Collector
tools.problem: No-shows and last-minute cancellations wreck small-property economics, but owners rarely state a clear policy or collect a deposit.
tools.who: Homestays, small hotels and banquet venues.
tools.solution: Send a link that states your cancellation policy, collects a deposit via UPI/GCash, logs consent, and issues a receipt.
tools.regulation: UPI (IN), BSP e-money/GCash (PH); consumer cancellation disclosure

tools.title: Guest-WiFi Contact Capture Portal
tools.problem: Properties never learn who their guest is (the OTA keeps the contact), so they can't remarket for direct repeat stays.
tools.who: Homestays, small hotels, cafes and resorts offering guest WiFi.
tools.solution: Self-hosted captive portal shows a branded splash and, with consent, captures email/phone and a review prompt before granting WiFi.
tools.regulation: DPDP Act (IN), Data Privacy Act (PH) consent

tools.title: Field-Service Rate-Card Quote Builder
tools.problem: Technicians quote verbally and inconsistently, margins swing, and customers distrust a round scribbled number.
tools.who: Electricians, plumbers and AMC firms issuing itemized quotes
tools.solution: Tap line items from a rate card (labor plus materials), auto-add GST/VAT, generate a branded quote PDF, and convert it to an invoice on approval.
tools.regulation: GST (IN), VAT (PH)

tools.title: GeM Seller Kit for Artisan SHGs & Co-ops
tools.problem: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is a large, low-marketing-cost channel with explicit purchase preference for women-led, SC/ST and MSE sellers, but artisan groups cannot navigate catalog creation, bid/BOQ participation, or which preference they qualify for, so they never bid.
tools.who: Handicraft and handloom SHGs, cooperatives and producer companies (and their NRLM/DAY-NULM mentors) trying to sell to government buyers.
tools.solution: A seller operations kit: a guided catalog builder with GeM-correct categories and specs for handicraft and handloom, an eligibility map of the applicable purchase preferences and the certs each needs (Udyam, SC/ST, women-SHG, Startup Runway), and a bid/tender watchlist tracking open opportunities, submission deadlines and bid status.
tools.regulation: GeM + Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012

tools.title: Craftmark & Handmade-Mark Certification Kit
tools.problem: Buyers increasingly discount 'handmade' claims and certification marks like Craftmark exist, but the genuineness criteria, process documentation and photo evidence an application needs are opaque, so makers skip it.
tools.who: Craft enterprises, producer groups and NGOs who want a recognized 'genuinely handmade' mark (Craftmark, and Handloom Mark / Silk Mark where relevant) to command price and buyer trust.
tools.solution: A client-side application kit: a genuineness self-assessment against the mark's craft-process criteria, a guided builder for the required process documentation and stage photos, and a packaged print-ready application and renewal dossier for the certifying body.
tools.regulation: Craftmark (AIACA) / Handloom Mark / Silk Mark

tools.title: Pearl & Shellcraft Export Legality Organizer
tools.problem: Shell and pearl exports hinge on species legality and fisheries paperwork; some shells are regulated or CITES-listed and shipments need DA-BFAR commodity/export clearance, so small shellcraft exporters guess and risk seizure or a blocked buyer order.
tools.who: Capiz (windowpane oyster) shellcraft, mother-of-pearl and pearl-jewelry makers and exporters in the Philippines.
tools.solution: A material-legality and export-clearance organizer: identify the shell/pearl species in a product, flag restricted or CITES-listed materials, assemble the DA-BFAR export/commodity clearance document set and the buyer legality declaration, and keep per-shipment proof of legal sourcing.
tools.regulation: Philippine Fisheries Code (RA 8550) / DA-BFAR; CITES

tools.title: DTI Shared Service Facility (SSF) Booking & Usage Ledger
tools.problem: SSF equipment is shared across many member makers but bookings run on paper, utilization is untracked, and DTI expects utilization and beneficiary reporting the cooperator struggles to produce.
tools.who: Cooperators and association officers running a DTI Shared Service Facility (shared kilns, looms, laser cutters, dryers) for craft MSMEs in a town.
tools.solution: A booking and usage ledger for a shared facility: members reserve equipment slots, each session logs operator, hours, output and any usage fee, and the tool rolls up utilization, unique beneficiaries and fee collection into the periodic report DTI asks cooperators to submit.
tools.regulation: DTI Shared Service Facilities (SSF) Project

tools.title: EUDR Due-Diligence Pack for Wood & Leather Craft Exporters
tools.problem: The EU Deforestation Regulation requires a due-diligence statement with geolocation of where the wood or cattle material was produced and proof of legality before relevant goods enter the EU; small craft exporters cannot capture source geodata or produce the statement, risking lost EU buyers.
tools.who: Exporters of wooden handicrafts, cane/rattan and leather goods shipping to the EU.
tools.solution: A due-diligence pack builder: capture each material lot's source plot geolocation and legality documents, link lots to the finished export order, run the risk self-assessment, and generate the EUDR due-diligence statement and reference-ready submission pack for the importing buyer.
tools.regulation: EU Deforestation Regulation (EU) 2023/1115

tools.title: Visiting-Faculty Session Payout & 194J TDS Ledger
tools.problem: Visiting faculty are professionals, not salaried staff, so pay is per-session or a cut of batch collections and attracts Section 194J TDS; centres compute this on paper, forget to deduct/deposit TDS, and cannot produce Form 16A, inviting disallowance and faculty disputes.
tools.who: Coaching, test-prep and vocational centres paying visiting/part-time faculty per lecture, per hour or on batch revenue-share.
tools.solution: Log each faculty rate (per session/hour or % of batch fee), auto-tally delivered sessions from the timetable, compute gross, deduct 194J TDS with threshold handling, generate the payout statement and Form 16A inputs, and keep a clean per-faculty and per-batch cost ledger.
tools.regulation: Income-tax Act Section 194J (professional fees); TDS deposit and Form 16A rules

tools.title: CBSE Mandatory Public Disclosure Page Builder
tools.problem: CBSE's Affiliation Bye-Laws require every school to publish a specific Mandatory Public Disclosure (MPD) on its website in an exact format; most school sites show stale, incomplete or wrongly-formatted MPD, a recurring affiliation-inspection red flag.
tools.who: CBSE-affiliated private schools and schools preparing for affiliation or renewal.
tools.solution: A form-driven generator that captures the MPD fields (society/affiliation details, land/building, staff counts and qualifications, class-wise enrolment, results, committees, document uploads), validates completeness against the bye-law checklist, and outputs a clean mobile-friendly MPD page to host plus a print copy for the inspection file.
tools.regulation: CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws, Mandatory Public Disclosure (MPD) requirement

tools.title: Education-Services GST Exemption & Fee-Invoice Classifier
tools.problem: Education is a GST minefield: school education up to higher secondary is exempt, approved vocational/skill courses can be exempt, but coaching and most private training are taxable at 18%; owners either wrongly skip GST and get notices, or wrongly charge it, and their receipts are non-compliant.
tools.who: Coaching centres, skilling providers, pre-schools and training institutes unsure whether their fees attract GST.
tools.solution: A short decision tool that classifies each fee head (school tuition, coaching, approved vocational course, hostel/mess, books, transport) as exempt or taxable with the reasoning and notification reference, computes the GST, and generates a compliant fee invoice/receipt template with the right HSN/SAC and exemption notes.
tools.regulation: CGST exemption Notification 12/2017-CT(R) entry 66 (educational institutions / approved vocational education); 18% GST on coaching

tools.title: Senior-High Voucher (QVR) Billing & Liquidation Desk
tools.problem: Participating schools enrol ESC grantees and SHS voucher beneficiaries, then must bill and liquidate those subsidies to PEAC/DepEd with exact enrolment, attendance and billing evidence; errors or late liquidation delay large reimbursements the school's cash flow depends on.
tools.who: Private junior and senior high schools in DepEd's GASTPE/ESC and SHS Voucher Program.
tools.solution: A roster of grantees/voucher beneficiaries that tracks enrolment and retention against billing periods, computes the amount claimable per student, and assembles the PEAC/DepEd billing and liquidation packets, flagging any beneficiary whose documentation would be rejected.
tools.regulation: GASTPE (RA 8545); Education Service Contracting (ESC) and SHS Voucher Program; PEAC billing/liquidation rules

tools.title: Self-Hosted Lockdown Online-Test Proctor
tools.problem: When tests move online, cheating via tab-switching, second screens and phones destroys the credibility of a centre's results, but commercial proctoring is priced per-candidate and overkill for a small institute's weekly tests.
tools.who: Coaching centres, review centres and skilling providers running online tests who can't afford commercial proctoring.
tools.solution: An open, self-hostable test engine that delivers timed papers in browser-lockdown mode, logs tab-switch/focus-loss and optional webcam snapshots, flags suspicious sessions for human review, and auto-scores objective sections with an integrity report per candidate.

tools.title: TenderClock — Govt-Tender Deadline & EMD Vault
tools.problem: Small contractors juggle many live tenders across portals; they miss pre-bid and submission deadlines, lose Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) that is never chased for refund, and lose bids on an incomplete document checklist.
tools.who: contractors bidding GeM, CPWD, PWD and municipal e-tenders
tools.solution: Go app: log each tender (portal, work, ABC, EMD, pre-bid/submission dates), drive a document checklist to bid-ready, track EMD paid and chase its release after award/rejection, and show a single calendar of what closes this week.
tools.regulation: GFR 2017 & GeM bidding; CPWD/PWD e-procurement EMD rules

tools.title: SCurve — Accomplishment Billing & Statement of Work Accomplished
tools.problem: Progress billing is based on weighted % accomplishment against an S-curve, but contractors build the Statement of Work Accomplished in ad-hoc spreadsheets, mis-weight items, and cannot show the planned-vs-actual S-curve slippage the engineer demands.
tools.who: PH contractors on DPWH and private progress-billing projects
tools.solution: Go app: load the bill of quantities with cost weights, enter cumulative quantity per item, compute weighted % accomplishment and this-period billing (less retention and downpayment recoupment), plot planned-vs-actual S-curve, and export the SWA and progress-billing cover.
tools.regulation: DPWH progress-billing & S-curve practice; COA documentation for government projects

tools.title: PermitPath — Building & Occupancy Permit Tracker
tools.problem: A single project needs building, electrical, sanitary, mechanical and fencing permits, then an occupancy permit and Fire Safety Inspection Certificate, each with its own requirements and signatories; micro builders lose weeks to missing documents and unclear status.
tools.who: small builders, design-build contractors, owner-builders
tools.solution: Go app: per project, a requirements checklist for each permit type under the National Building Code, document upload and signatory tracking, status across the LGU Office of the Building Official and Bureau of Fire Protection, and a clear 'blocked on what, with whom' view through to occupancy.
tools.regulation: PD 1096 (National Building Code); RA 9514 (Fire Code) FSIC

tools.title: ToolboxLog — Site Safety, Toolbox-Talk & Incident Register
tools.problem: Daily toolbox talks, PPE issue, work permits, induction and near-miss/incident records are either not kept or scattered on paper; when a client audit or an accident investigation hits, the contractor has no Construction Safety & Health paper trail.
tools.who: site safety officers, contractors, PMCs
tools.solution: Flutter app: run and log daily toolbox talks with worker attendance (photo/thumbprint), issue and track PPE, record inductions, log near-misses and incidents with geotagged photos, and compile the Construction Safety & Health Program file — offline-first, syncing later.
tools.regulation: DOLE Department Order 13-1998 (PH construction safety / CSHP); BOCW safety rules (India)

tools.title: Refrigerant Charge & Recovery Log
tools.problem: Technicians charge and recover refrigerant with no record, venting is unlogged, and firms cannot reconcile cylinder stock or evidence responsible handling as HCFC/HFC phase-downs tighten.
tools.who: HVAC and commercial-refrigeration service technicians and firms
tools.solution: Per-job log of refrigerant type, quantity charged and recovered, leak-test result and cylinder used; a running cylinder-stock balance; and a per-asset refrigerant history with a recovery/handling record for audits and client ESG asks.
tools.regulation: ODS (Regulation & Control) Rules 2000 / Kigali HFC phase-down (IN); Montreal Protocol / DENR-CAMB (PH)

tools.title: AERB eLORA X-ray Service & QA Register
tools.problem: Every diagnostic X-ray unit needs AERB eLORA registration, periodic QA tests and radiation-survey records; service engineers manage this across clinics on scattered files and risk a unit being decommissioned.
tools.who: Service engineers maintaining diagnostic X-ray and radiology equipment for clinics
tools.solution: Per-machine register of AERB eLORA registration/licence status, QA-test schedule and results, and radiation-protection survey, with renewal alerts and a clinic-ready QA/compliance report produced after each service.
tools.regulation: AERB eLORA registration; AERB Radiation Safety Code (diagnostic radiology)
